5.78.m: Thus ends the seventy-eighth chapter, named ‘Description of the Māhātmya of Rudraśīrṣa (Jāgeśvara)’, in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Śrī Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.79.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasyaiva dakṣiṇe bhāge vālakhilyaiḥ pratiṣṭhitam ..
liṃgamasti suvikhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
5.79.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्यैव दक्षिणे भागे वालखिल्यैः प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
लिंगमस्ति सुविख्यातं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
5.79.m: Sūta said: / On the very southern side of it is a renowned liṅga / installed by the Vālakhilyas, which destroys all sins,

5.79.s:
yamārādhya ca taiḥ pūrvaṃ śakrāmarṣasamanvitaiḥ ..
garuḍo janitaḥ pakṣī khyāto viṣṇuratho'tra yaḥ .. 2 ..
5.79.d:
यमाराध्य च तैः पूर्वं शक्रामर्षसमन्वितैः ..
गरुडो जनितः पक्षी ख्यातो विष्णुरथोऽत्र यः .. 2 ..
5.79.m: by worshiping which previously, when filled with wrath toward Śakra, / they generated the bird Garuḍa, known here as Viṣṇu's vehicle.

5.79.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kathaṃ teṣāṃ samutpannaḥ śakrasyopari sūtaja ..
prakopo vālakhilyānāṃ saṃjajñe garuḍaḥ katham .. 3 ..
5.79.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कथं तेषां समुत्पन्नः शक्रस्योपरि सूतज ..
प्रकोपो वालखिल्यानां संजज्ञे गरुडः कथम् .. 3 ..
5.79.m: The seers said: / How did that anger toward Śakra arise in them, / O son of Sūta, and how was Garuḍa born?

5.79.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
purā prajāpatirdakṣastasminkṣetre suśobhane ..
cakāra vidhivadyajñaṃ saṃpūrṇavaradakṣiṇam .. 4 ..
5.79.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
पुरा प्रजापतिर्दक्षस्तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे सुशोभने ..
चकार विधिवद्यज्ञं संपूर्णवरदक्षिणम् .. 4 ..
5.79.m: Sūta said: / Long ago, in that very beautiful sacred field, Prajāpati Dakṣa / performed a sacrifice according to the rules, with full and excellent fees.

5.79.s:
tataḥ śakrādayo devāḥ sahāyārthaṃ nimaṃtritāḥ ..
dakṣeṇa munayaścaiva tathā rājarṣayo'malāḥ .. 5 ..
5.79.d:
ततः शक्रादयो देवाः सहायार्थं निमंत्रिताः ..
दक्षेण मुनयश्चैव तथा राजर्षयोऽमलाः .. 5 ..
5.79.m: Then the gods headed by Śakra were invited for assistance / by Dakṣa, as well as sages and spotless royal seers,

5.79.s:
tathā vedavido viprā yajñakarmavicakṣaṇāḥ ..
gṛhasthāśramiṇo ye ca ye cāraṇyanivāsinaḥ.. 6 ..
5.79.d:
तथा वेदविदो विप्रा यज्ञकर्मविचक्षणाः ..
गृहस्थाश्रमिणो ये च ये चारण्यनिवासिनः.. 6 ..
5.79.m: likewise brahmins knowledgeable in the Veda and skilled in sacrificial rites, / householders, and forest dwellers.

5.79.s:
atha te vālakhilyākhyā munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ..
ekāṃ samidhamādāya sāhāyyārthaṃ prajāpateḥ ..
prasthitā yajñavāṭaṃ taṃ bhārārtāḥ kleśasaṃyutāḥ .. 7 ..
5.79.d:
अथ ते वालखिल्याख्या मुनयः संशितव्रताः..
एकां समिधमादाय साहाय्यार्थं प्रजापतेः ..
प्रस्थिता यज्ञवाटं तं भारार्ताः क्लेशसंयुताः .. 7 ..
5.79.m: Then those sages called Vālakhilyas of rigorous vows, / carrying a single sacrificial stick to assist Prajāpati, / set out for that sacrificial enclosure, afflicted by the burden and beset with hardship.

5.79.s:
atha teṣāṃ samastānāṃ mārge goṣpadamāgatam ..
jalapūrṇaṃ samāyātamakālajaladāgame .. 8 ..
5.79.d:
अथ तेषां समस्तानां मार्गे गोष्पदमागतम् ..
जलपूर्णं समायातमकालजलदागमे .. 8 ..
5.79.m: Then, on the path of them all, a cow's footprint came into view, / filled with water that had come from an unseasonal cloud.

5.79.s:
tatastarītu kāmāste kliśyamānā itastataḥ ..
samidbhāraśramopetā devarājena vīkṣitāḥ .. 9 ..
5.79.d:
ततस्तरीतु कामास्ते क्लिश्यमाना इतस्ततः ..
समिद्भारश्रमोपेता देवराजेन वीक्षिताः .. 9 ..
5.79.m: Then, wishing to cross it and struggling to and fro, / exhausted by the burden of sacrificial wood, they were seen by the king of the gods,

5.79.s:
gacchatā tena mārgeṇa makhe dakṣaprajāpateḥ ..
tataściraṃ samālokya smitaṃ kṛtvā sa kautukāt ..
jagāmātha samullaṃghya aiśvaryamadagarvitaḥ..6.79.10....
5.79.d:
गच्छता तेन मार्गेण मखे दक्षप्रजापतेः ..
ततश्चिरं समालोक्य स्मितं कृत्वा स कौतुकात् ..
जगामाथ समुल्लंघ्य ऐश्वर्यमदगर्वितः..6.79.10....
5.79.m: who was going along that road to the sacrifice of Dakṣa Prajāpati. / Then, looking for a long time and smiling out of amusement, / puffed up with the pride of sovereign power, he leaped across and went on.

5.79.s:
tataste kopasaṃyuktāḥ śakrāddṛṣṭvā parābhavam ..
nivṛtya svāśramaṃ gatvā cakrurmaṃtraṃ saniścayam .. 11...
5.79.d:
ततस्ते कोपसंयुक्ताः शक्राद्दृष्ट्वा पराभवम् ..
निवृत्य स्वाश्रमं गत्वा चक्रुर्मंत्रं सनिश्चयम् .. 11...
5.79.m: Then, filled with rage at seeing that insult from Śakra, / turning back and going to their own hermitage, they made a resolute plan:

5.79.s:
śākraṃ padaṃ samāsādya yasmādetena pāpmanā ..
atikrāṃtā vayaṃ sarve tasmātpātyaḥ sa satpadāt .. 12 ..
5.79.d:
शाक्रं पदं समासाद्य यस्मादेतेन पाप्मना ..
अतिक्रांता वयं सर्वे तस्मात्पात्यः स सत्पदात् .. 12 ..
5.79.m: “Since this sinner, having attained the rank of Śakra, / has insulted us all, therefore he must be cast down from that noble rank.

5.79.s:
anyaḥ śakraḥ prakartavyo maṃtravīryasamudbhavaḥ ..
ātharvaṇairmahāsūktairābhicārikasaṃbhavaiḥ .. 13 ..
5.79.d:
अन्यः शक्रः प्रकर्तव्यो मंत्रवीर्यसमुद्भवः ..
आथर्वणैर्महासूक्तैराभिचारिकसंभवैः .. 13 ..
5.79.m: Another Śakra must be produced through the power of mantras, / with great Atharvan hymns born of magical sorcery,

5.79.s:
yena vyāpādyate tena śakro'yaṃ madagarvitaḥ ..
makhamāhātmyasaṃpannaḥ svalpabuddhiparā kramaḥ .. 14 ..
5.79.d:
येन व्यापाद्यते तेन शक्रोऽयं मदगर्वितः ..
मखमाहात्म्यसंपन्नः स्वल्पबुद्धिपरा क्रमः .. 14 ..
5.79.m: by whom this Śakra, proud with arrogance, / devoid of the māhātmya of sacrifice, and of little intellect and valor, will be destroyed.”

5.79.s:
tataste śucayo bhūtvā skaṃdasūktena pāvakam ..
juhuvuśca divārātrau kṣurikoktena sodyamāḥ .. 158 ..
garbhopaniṣadenaiva nīlarudrairdvijottamāḥ ..
rudraśīrṣeṇa kāmyena viṣṇusūktayutena caṃ .. 16 ..
nidhāya kalaśaṃ madhye maṃḍalasyodakāvṛtam ..
homāṃte tatra saṃsparśaṃ cakrustasya jalaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 17 ..
etasminnaṃtare śakraḥ prapaśyati sudāruṇān ..
utpātānātmanāśāya jāyamānānsamaṃtataḥ .. 18 ..
vāmo bāhuśca netraṃ ca muhuḥ sphurati cāsya vai ..
na ca paśyati nāsāgraṃ jihvāgraṃ ca tathā hanum .. 19 ..
śirohīnāṃ tathā chāyāṃ gagane bhāskaradvayam ..
aruṃdhatīṃ dhruvaṃ caiva na ca viṣṇupadāni saḥ .. 6.79.20 ..
na ca maṃdaṃ na cākāśe saṃsthitāṃ svardhunīṃ hariḥ ..
svapanpaśyati kṛṣṇāṃgīṃ nityaṃ nārīṃ dhṛtāyudhām .. 21 ..
5.79.d:
ततस्ते शुचयो भूत्वा स्कंदसूक्तेन पावकम् ..
जुहुवुश्च दिवारात्रौ क्षुरिकोक्तेन सोद्यमाः .. 158 ..
गर्भोपनिषदेनैव नीलरुद्रैर्द्विजोत्तमाः ..
रुद्रशीर्षेण काम्येन विष्णुसूक्तयुतेन चं .. 16 ..
निधाय कलशं मध्ये मंडलस्योदकावृतम् ..
होमांते तत्र संस्पर्शं चक्रुस्तस्य जलैः शुभैः .. 17 ..
एतस्मिन्नंतरे शक्रः प्रपश्यति सुदारुणान् ..
उत्पातानात्मनाशाय जायमानान्समंततः .. 18 ..
वामो बाहुश्च नेत्रं च मुहुः स्फुरति चास्य वै ..
न च पश्यति नासाग्रं जिह्वाग्रं च तथा हनुम् .. 19 ..
शिरोहीनां तथा छायां गगने भास्करद्वयम् ..
अरुंधतीं ध्रुवं चैव न च विष्णुपदानि सः .. 6.79.20 ..
न च मंदं न चाकाशे संस्थितां स्वर्धुनीं हरिः ..
स्वपन्पश्यति कृष्णांगीं नित्यं नारीं धृतायुधाम् .. 21 ..
5.79.m:
Then, having become purified, making effort day and night, / they made oblations into the fire with the Skandasūkta and according to the Kṣurikā.
with the Garbha Upaniṣad, with the Nīlarudra hymns, O best of brahmins, / with the Rudraśīrṣa recited for desires, and combined with the Viṣṇusūkta.
Having placed a water pot in the center of the diagram, filled with water, / at the end of the fire offering they touched him with its auspicious waters.
Meanwhile, Śakra beheld terrifying / portents arising on all sides, foreboding his destruction:
his left arm and eye twitched repeatedly, / and he could not see the tip of his nose, the tip of his tongue, or his chin;
nor could he see his shadow without a head, nor the two suns in the sky, / nor Arundhatī, nor the pole star, nor the footprints of Viṣṇu;
nor Saturn, nor the celestial river situated in the sky did Hari see. / While sleeping, he continually saw a dark-bodied woman holding a weapon,

5.79.s:
muktakeśīṃ vivastrāṃ ca kṛṣṇadaṃtāṃ bhayānakām ..
tāndṛṣṭvā sa mahotpātāndevarājo bṛhaspatim .. 22 ..
papraccha bhayasaṃtrastaḥ kimetaditi me guro ..
jāyaṃte sumahotpātā durnimittāni vai pṛthak .. 23 ..
kiṃ me bhaviṣyati prājña vināśaḥ sāṃprataṃ vada ..
kiṃ vā trailokya rājyasya kiṃ vā vittādikasya ca .. 24 ..
.. bṛhaspatiruvāca .. ..
ye tvayā madamattena vālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ ..
ullaṃghitāḥ sthitā mārge goṣpadaṃ tarttumicchavaḥ .. 25 ..
tairevātharvaṇairmaṃtraistvakṛte'sti śacīpate ..
kṛto homaḥ susaṃpūrṇaḥ kalaśaścābhimaṃtritaḥ .. 26 ..
yuṣmākaṃ suvināśāya sarvadevādhināyakaḥ ..
bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho maṃtrairātharvaṇairhariḥ .. 27 ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sahasrākṣo bhayānvitaḥ ..
dakṣaṃ gatvā ca dīnāsyaḥ provāca tadanaṃtaram .. 28 ..
5.79.d:
मुक्तकेशीं विवस्त्रां च कृष्णदंतां भयानकाम् ..
तान्दृष्ट्वा स महोत्पातान्देवराजो बृहस्पतिम् .. 22 ..
पप्रच्छ भयसंत्रस्तः किमेतदिति मे गुरो ..
जायंते सुमहोत्पाता दुर्निमित्तानि वै पृथक् .. 23 ..
किं मे भविष्यति प्राज्ञ विनाशः सांप्रतं वद ..
किं वा त्रैलोक्य राज्यस्य किं वा वित्तादिकस्य च .. 24 ..
.. बृहस्पतिरुवाच .. ..
ये त्वया मदमत्तेन वालखिल्या महर्षयः ..
उल्लंघिताः स्थिता मार्गे गोष्पदं तर्त्तुमिच्छवः .. 25 ..
तैरेवाथर्वणैर्मंत्रैस्त्वकृतेऽस्ति शचीपते ..
कृतो होमः सुसंपूर्णः कलशश्चाभिमंत्रितः .. 26 ..
युष्माकं सुविनाशाय सर्वदेवाधिनायकः ..
भविष्यति न संदेहो मंत्रैराथर्वणैर्हरिः .. 27 ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सहस्राक्षो भयान्वितः ..
दक्षं गत्वा च दीनास्यः प्रोवाच तदनंतरम् .. 28 ..
5.79.m:
her hair disheveled, naked, with black teeth, and terrifying. / Seeing those great portents, the king of the gods asked Bṛhaspati,
terrified with fear: "O Guru, what is this? / Immense portents and various evil omens are arising.
What will happen to me now, O wise one? Speak! Will there be ruin? / Will it be of the sovereignty of the three worlds, or of wealth and the rest?"
Bṛhaspati said: / "Those great seers, the Vālakhilyas, who were intoxicated by pride / bypassed by you as they stood in the path wishing to cross a cow's footprint,
by those very [sages], using Atharvan mantras, against you, O lord of Śacī, / a complete fire offering has been performed, and a water pot has been consecrated with mantras.
For your total destruction, an overlord of all the gods, / another Indra, will arise through the Atharvan mantras—there is no doubt."
Having heard those words of his, the thousand-eyed one was filled with fear. / Approaching Dakṣa with a wretched face, he spoke immediately thereafter:

5.79.s:
asmannāśāya munibhirvālakhilyaiḥ prajāpate ..
prodyamo vihitaḥ samyakchakrasyānyasya vai kṛte .. 29 ..
tānvāraya svayaṃ gatvā yāvanno jāyate paraḥ ..
śakro'smaddhvaṃsanārthāya nāsti teṣāmasādhyatā .. 6.79.30 ..
atha dakṣo drutaṃ gatvā śakrādyairamarairvṛtaḥ ..
prahasaṃstānuvācedaṃ vinayena samanvitaḥ .. 31 ..
kimetatkriyate viprāḥ karma raudratamaṃ mahat ..
trailokyaṃ vyākulaṃ yena sarvametadvyavasthitam .. 32 ..
atha te dakṣamālokya samāyātaṃ svamāśrayam ..
saṃmukhāścābhyayustūrṇaṃ pragṛhītārghyapāṇayaḥ .. 33 ..
arghyaṃ dattvā yathānyāyaṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvātha bhaktitaḥ ..
procuśca praṇatā bhūtvā svāgataṃ te prajāpate .. 34 ..
ādeśo dīyatāṃ śīghraṃ yadarthamiha cāgataḥ ..
api prāṇapradānena kariṣyāmaḥ priyaṃ tava .. 35 .. ..
5.79.d:
अस्मन्नाशाय मुनिभिर्वालखिल्यैः प्रजापते ..
प्रोद्यमो विहितः सम्यक्छक्रस्यान्यस्य वै कृते .. 29 ..
तान्वारय स्वयं गत्वा यावन्नो जायते परः ..
शक्रोऽस्मद्ध्वंसनार्थाय नास्ति तेषामसाध्यता .. 6.79.30 ..
अथ दक्षो द्रुतं गत्वा शक्राद्यैरमरैर्वृतः ..
प्रहसंस्तानुवाचेदं विनयेन समन्वितः .. 31 ..
किमेतत्क्रियते विप्राः कर्म रौद्रतमं महत् ..
त्रैलोक्यं व्याकुलं येन सर्वमेतद्व्यवस्थितम् .. 32 ..
अथ ते दक्षमालोक्य समायातं स्वमाश्रयम् ..
संमुखाश्चाभ्ययुस्तूर्णं प्रगृहीतार्घ्यपाणयः .. 33 ..
अर्घ्यं दत्त्वा यथान्यायं पूजां कृत्वाथ भक्तितः ..
प्रोचुश्च प्रणता भूत्वा स्वागतं ते प्रजापते .. 34 ..
आदेशो दीयतां शीघ्रं यदर्थमिह चागतः ..
अपि प्राणप्रदानेन करिष्यामः प्रियं तव .. 35 .. ..
5.79.m:
"For our destruction, O Prajāpati, by the Vālakhilya sages / a concerted effort has been undertaken to create another Śakra.
Go yourself and prevent them before another / Śakra is born to destroy us; nothing is impossible for them!"
Then Dakṣa went swiftly, accompanied by the immortals led by Śakra. / Smiling, he spoke these words to them with humility:
"What is this immensely terrible rite being performed, O brahmins, / by which all these three worlds have been thrown into agitation?"
Then, seeing Dakṣa arrived at their hermitage, / they quickly went to meet him, taking guest water in their hands.
Having offered the guest water according to rule, and having performed worship with devotion, / bowing down, they said: "Welcome to you, O Prajāpati!
Let your command be given quickly, for which purpose you have come here. / Even at the cost of our lives, we will do what is pleasing to you."

5.79.s:
.. dakṣa uvāca .. ..
etadraudratamaṃ karma sarvadevabhayāvaham ..
tyājyaṃ yuṣmābhiravyagrairetadarthamihāgataḥ .. 36 ..
.. munaya ūcuḥ .. ..
vayaṃ śakreṇa te yajñe samāyātāḥ subhaktitaḥ ..
ullaṃghitā madodrekātkṛtvā hāsyaṃ muhurmuhuḥ .. 37 ..
śakrocchedāya cāsmābhiḥ śako'nyo vīryamaṃtrataḥ ..
prārabdhaḥ kartumatyugrairhomāṃtaśca vyavasthitaḥ .. 38 ..
tatkathaṃ maṃtravīryaṃ tatkriyate moghamityaho ..
vedoktaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa tasmādatra vada prabho .. 39 ..
tvameva yadi śaktaḥ syādanyathā kartumeva hi ..
kuruṣva vā svayaṃ nātha nāsmākaṃ śaktirīdṛśī .. 6.79.40 ..
.. dakṣa uvāca .. ..
satyametanmahābhāgā yadyuṣmābhiḥ prakīrtitam ..
nānyathā śakyate kartuṃ vedamantrodbhavaṃ balam .. 41 ..
tadya eṣa kṛto homo yuṣmābhirvedamaṃtrataḥ ..
devarājārthamavyagraiḥ kalaśaścābhimaṃtritaḥ .. 42 ..
5.79.d:
.. दक्ष उवाच .. ..
एतद्रौद्रतमं कर्म सर्वदेवभयावहम् ..
त्याज्यं युष्माभिरव्यग्रैरेतदर्थमिहागतः .. 36 ..
.. मुनय ऊचुः .. ..
वयं शक्रेण ते यज्ञे समायाताः सुभक्तितः ..
उल्लंघिता मदोद्रेकात्कृत्वा हास्यं मुहुर्मुहुः .. 37 ..
शक्रोच्छेदाय चास्माभिः शकोऽन्यो वीर्यमंत्रतः ..
प्रारब्धः कर्तुमत्युग्रैर्होमांतश्च व्यवस्थितः .. 38 ..
तत्कथं मंत्रवीर्यं तत्क्रियते मोघमित्यहो ..
वेदोक्तं च विशेषेण तस्मादत्र वद प्रभो .. 39 ..
त्वमेव यदि शक्तः स्यादन्यथा कर्तुमेव हि ..

5.79.m:
Dakṣa said: / "This most terrible rite, which brings fear to all the gods, / must be abandoned by you without agitation; for this purpose I have come here."
The sages said: / "We had come with great devotion to your sacrifice, / but were transgressed by Śakra out of excess of pride, mocking us repeatedly.
And for the destruction of Śakra, by means of the potency of mantras, another Śakra / has been commenced by us through extremely fierce [rites], and the conclusion of the fire offering is now reached.
Then how can that power of mantras be rendered futile? / Especially since it is spoken in the Veda; therefore, tell us here, O lord!
If you yourself are able to make it otherwise, / do so yourself, O master; such power is not ours."
Dakṣa said: / "This which you have spoken is true, O greatly fortunate ones; / the power born of Vedic mantras cannot be made otherwise.
Therefore, this fire offering which was performed by you with Vedic mantras / for the sake of [producing] a king of the gods, and the jar consecrated by you unperturbed—

5.79.m:
by my word, he shall become the king of birds, / endowed with fire and vigor, even more powerful than Śakra!
This king of the gods should be forgiven on my word / for that action which was done by him through foolishness."
Having spoken thus to them, Dakṣa showed / the thousand-eyed one, who was afflicted with fear, standing bowed down with humility.
Seeing the thousand-eyed one trembling with folded hands, / they said: "O Śakra, do not commit transgression against brahmins again,
if you desire sovereignty over the gods of heaven once more! / Even if a brahmin is slow, foolish, or devoid of ritual acts, / he should never be disrespected anywhere by wise persons desiring both worlds."
Indra said: / "Whether out of ignorance or out of knowledge, whatever misdeed was done by me, / all that should be forgiven by the brahmins, especially on the word of Dakṣa.
Accept a boon from me, whatever dwells always in your heart; / I will grant it, there is no doubt; there is nothing I cannot give."

5.79.m:
The sages said: / "A man who, endowed with faith, performs a fire offering in this fire pit / after worshiping this liṅga—may his heart's desire be fulfilled!"
Indra said: / "Whoever performs a fire offering here in this pit after worshiping this liṅga / shall quickly attain his desired wish fulfilled.
Or if, without desire, he worships this auspicious liṅga, / he shall attain the supreme perfection, difficult even for the gods to attain."
Sūta said: / Having spoken thus to the Vālakhilyas, the best of sages, the thousand-eyed one / mounted Airāvata and then went to Dakṣa's sacrifice.
Dakṣa also performed the sacrifice according to rule, O best of brahmins, / with those delighted Vālakhilyas seated near him.
Thus ends the seventy-ninth chapter, called 'The Narrative of the Greatness of the Vālakhilya Hermitage' in the section on the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

ततस्तस्याः कुमार्या वै अनुरूपं गुणान्वितम् ..
स्वयं चाहर भर्तारमेषा मैत्री ममोद्भवा .. 6.80.20 ..
5.80.m:
Then, for that young maiden,
yourself fetch a suitable husband endowed with virtues; such is my friendship.’ 20

5.80.s:
.. sūta uvāca ..
evamukto'tha vipraḥ sa tatkṣaṇātkanyayā saha ..
ārūḍho gāruḍaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ varārthāya dvijottamāḥ .. 21 ..
5.80.d:
.. सूत उवाच ..
एवमुक्तोऽथ विप्रः स तत्क्षणात्कन्यया सह ..
आरूढो गारुडं पृष्ठं वरार्थाय द्विजोत्तमाः .. 21 ..
5.80.m:
Sūta said:
Thus addressed, O best of brahmins, that brahmin at that moment,
along with his daughter, mounted upon Garuḍa’s back in search of a bridegroom. 21

5.80.s:
yaṃyaṃ paśyati vipraḥ sa kumāraṃ taruṇākṛtim ..
sa sa no tasya cittāṃte vartatesma kathaṃcana .. 22 ..
5.80.d:
यंयं पश्यति विप्रः स कुमारं तरुणाकृतिम् ..
स स नो तस्य चित्तांते वर्ततेस्म कथंचन .. 22 ..
5.80.m:
Whichever youth of youthful appearance that brahmin saw,
he did not at all meet the approval of his mind. 22

5.80.s:
kasyacidrūpamatyugraṃ na kulaṃ ca sunirmalam ..
kulaṃ rūpaṃ ca yasya syāttasya no guṇasaṃcayaḥ .. 23 ..
5.80.d:
कस्यचिद्रूपमत्युग्रं न कुलं च सुनिर्मलम् ..
कुलं रूपं च यस्य स्यात्तस्य नो गुणसंचयः .. 23 ..
5.80.m:
Of someone, the beauty was excessive, but the lineage was not pure;
and if someone had lineage and beauty, he lacked a collection of virtues. 23

5.80.s:
yasya vā guṇasandohastasya no rūpamuttamam ..
pakṣapātaṃ ca vittaṃ ca tathānyadvaralakṣaṇam .. 24 ..
5.80.d:
यस्य वा गुणसन्दोहस्तस्य नो रूपमुत्तमम् ..
पक्षपातं च वित्तं च तथान्यद्वरलक्षणम् .. 24 ..
5.80.m:
Or if someone had an abundance of virtues, he lacked excellent beauty,
or impartiality, or wealth, or other characteristics of an excellent groom. 24

5.80.s:
evaṃ varṣasahasrāṃte bhramatastasyabhūtalam ..
viprasya pakṣināthasya varārthāya drijottamāḥ .. 25 ..
5.80.d:
एवं वर्षसहस्रांते भ्रमतस्तस्यभूतलम् ..
विप्रस्य पक्षिनाथस्य वरार्थाय द्रिजोत्तमाः .. 25 ..
5.80.m:
Thus, at the end of a thousand years of wandering the surface of the earth
for the sake of a groom, O best of brahmins, for that brahmin and the lord of birds, 25

5.80.s:
kadācidatha tau śrāntau bhramamāṇāvitastataḥ ..
kṣetre'traiva samāyātau vāsudevadidṛkṣayā .. 26 ..
5.80.d:
कदाचिदथ तौ श्रान्तौ भ्रममाणावितस्ततः ..
क्षेत्रेऽत्रैव समायातौ वासुदेवदिदृक्षया .. 26 ..
5.80.m:
once, weary from wandering here and there,
the two arrived at this very sacred field desiring to see Vāsudeva; 26

5.80.s:
śvetadvīpaṃ samālokya tathānyāṃ badarīṃ śubhām ..
kṣīrodaṃ ca savaikuṇṭhaṃ tathānyaṃ tasya saṃśrayam .. 27 ..
5.80.d:
श्वेतद्वीपं समालोक्य तथान्यां बदरीं शुभाम् ..
क्षीरोदं च सवैकुण्ठं तथान्यं तस्य संश्रयम् .. 27 ..
5.80.m:
having seen Śvetadvīpa, and likewise the auspicious Badarī,
and the Milk Ocean with Vaikuṇṭha, as well as his other abodes. 27

5.80.s:
atha tābhyāṃ munirdṛṣṭo nārado brahmasaṃbhavaḥ ..
sāṃtvapūrvaṃ tadā pṛṣṭo viṣṇuṃ brahma sanātanam .. .. 28 ..
5.80.d:
अथ ताभ्यां मुनिर्दृष्टो नारदो ब्रह्मसंभवः ..
सांत्वपूर्वं तदा पृष्टो विष्णुं ब्रह्म सनातनम् .. .. 28 ..
5.80.m:
Then the sage Nārada, born of Brahmā, was seen by the two;
he was asked then with gentle words concerning Viṣṇu, the eternal Brahman: 28

5.80.s:
kva devaḥ puṃḍarīkākṣaḥ sāṃprataṃ vartate mune ..
viṣṇusthānāni sarvāṇi vīkṣitāni samaṃtataḥ ..
āvābhyāṃ saṃprahṛṣṭābhyāṃ na saṃdṛṣṭaḥ sa keśavaḥ .. 29 ..
5.80.d:
क्व देवः पुंडरीकाक्षः सांप्रतं वर्तते मुने ..
विष्णुस्थानानि सर्वाणि वीक्षितानि समंततः ..
आवाभ्यां संप्रहृष्टाभ्यां न संदृष्टः स केशवः .. 29 ..
5.80.m:
‘Where is the lotus-eyed god at present, O sage?
All the places of Viṣṇu have been inspected on all sides
by the two of us, eager, yet that Keśava was not seen.’ 29

5.80.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
jalaśāyisvarūpeṇa yāvanmāsacatuṣṭayam ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre sa saṃtiṣṭhati sarvadā .. 6.80.30 ..
5.80.d:
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
जलशायिस्वरूपेण यावन्मासचतुष्टयम् ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे स संतिष्ठति सर्वदा .. 6.80.30 ..
5.80.m:
Nārada said:
‘In the form of the one who sleeps upon the waters, for a period of four months,
he constantly resides in the sacred field arising from Hāṭakeśvara. 30

5.80.s:
tasmāttaddarśanārthāya gamyatāṃ tatra mā ciram ..
yena sandarśanaṃ yāti dvābhyāmapi sa cakradhṛk .. 31 ..
5.80.d:
तस्मात्तद्दर्शनार्थाय गम्यतां तत्र मा चिरम् ..
येन सन्दर्शनं याति द्वाभ्यामपि स चक्रधृक् .. 31 ..
5.80.m:
Therefore, for the sake of his darśana, go there without delay,
so that the wielder of the discus may come into view for both of you. 31

5.80.s:
ahamapyeva tatraiva prasthitastasya darśanāt ..
prasthitaśca tvayā yuko devakāryeṇa kenacit .. 32 ..
5.80.d:
अहमप्येव तत्रैव प्रस्थितस्तस्य दर्शनात् ..
प्रस्थितश्च त्वया युको देवकार्येण केनचित् .. 32 ..
5.80.m:
I too have set out for that very place for his darśana,
and having set out [along] with you on some business of the gods.’ 32

5.80.s:
atha tau pakṣiviprendrau sa ca brahmasuto muniḥ ..
prāptāḥ sarve sthito yatra jalaśāyī janārdanaḥ .. 33 ..
5.80.d:
अथ तौ पक्षिविप्रेन्द्रौ स च ब्रह्मसुतो मुनिः ..
प्राप्ताः सर्वे स्थितो यत्र जलशायी जनार्दनः .. 33 ..
5.80.m:
Then the two, the lord of birds and the eminent brahmin, and the sage, the son of Brahmā—
all arrived where Janārdana, sleeping upon the waters, was present. 33

5.80.s:
atha dṛṣṭvā mahattejo vaiṣṇavaṃ dūrato'pi tam ..
brāhmaṇaṃ garuḍaḥ prāha nāradaśca munīśvaraḥ .. 34 ..
5.80.d:
अथ दृष्ट्वा महत्तेजो वैष्णवं दूरतोऽपि तम् ..
ब्राह्मणं गरुडः प्राह नारदश्च मुनीश्वरः .. 34 ..
5.80.m:
Then, seeing that great Vaiṣṇava luster even from afar,
Garuḍa and Nārada, the lord of sages, said to the brahmin: 34

5.80.s:
atraiva tvaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha tiṣṭha dūre'pi tejasaḥ ..
vaiṣṇavasya sutāyuktaḥ kalpāṃtāgnisamam va (?).. 35 ..
5.80.d:
अत्रैव त्वं द्विजश्रेष्ठ तिष्ठ दूरेऽपि तेजसः ..
वैष्णवस्य सुतायुक्तः कल्पांताग्निसमम् व (?).. 35 ..
5.80.m:
‘Right here, O best of brahmins, remain together with your daughter, far from the luster
of Viṣṇu, which is like the fire of the end of the aeon. 35

5.80.s:
no cetsaṃpatsyase bhasma pataṃga iva pāvakam ..
samāsādya niśāyoge mūḍhaṃ bhāvaṃ samāśritaḥ .. 36 ..
5.80.d:
नो चेत्संपत्स्यसे भस्म पतंग इव पावकम् ..
समासाद्य निशायोगे मूढं भावं समाश्रितः .. 36 ..
5.80.m:
Otherwise, you will become ashes, like a moth approaching fire
at the onset of night, overtaken by foolishness. 36

5.80.s:
āvābhyāṃ tatprasādena soḍhametatsuduḥsaham ..
na karoti śarīrārti tathānyadapi kutsitam .. 37 ..
5.80.d:
आवाभ्यां तत्प्रसादेन सोढमेतत्सुदुःसहम् ..
न करोति शरीरार्ति तथान्यदपि कुत्सितम् .. 37 ..
5.80.m:
By us two, through his grace, this exceedingly unbearable [luster] is endured;
it does not cause bodily affliction or any other evil.’ 37

5.80.s:
evaṃ taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tatra muktvā dūre sutānvitam ..
gatau tau tatra saṃsuptastoye yatra janārdanaḥ .. 38 ..
5.80.d:
एवं तं ब्राह्मणं तत्र मुक्त्वा दूरे सुतान्वितम् ..
गतौ तौ तत्र संसुप्तस्तोये यत्र जनार्दनः .. 38 ..
5.80.m:
Having thus left that brahmin there at a distance together with his daughter,
the two went there where Janārdana was asleep upon the water. 38

5.80.s:
divyastutiparau mūrdhni dhṛtahastāṃjalīpuṭau ..
pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgāvānandāśruplutānanau .. 39 ..
5.80.d:
दिव्यस्तुतिपरौ मूर्ध्नि धृतहस्तांजलीपुटौ ..
पुलकांकितसर्वांगावानन्दाश्रुप्लुताननौ .. 39 ..
5.80.m:
Devoted to divine praise, holding their folded hands upon their heads,
their limbs bristling with hair, their faces bathed in tears of joy, 39

5.80.s:
triḥparikamya taṃ devamaṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇatau harim..
dṛṣṭavantau ca pādāṃte saṃniviṣṭāṃ samudrajām .. 6.80.40 ..
5.80.d:
त्रिःपरिकम्य तं देवमष्टांगं प्रणतौ हरिम्..
दृष्टवन्तौ च पादांते संनिविष्टां समुद्रजाम् .. 6.80.40 ..
5.80.m:
circumambulating that god three times, they bowed down with eight limbs to Hari,
and they saw the daughter of the ocean seated at the end of his feet, 40

5.80.s:
pādasaṃvāhanāsaktāṃ viṣṇu vaktrāhitekṣaṇām..
athāparāṃ vayovṛddhāṃ śvetavastrāvaguṃṭhitām .. 41 ..
5.80.d:
पादसंवाहनासक्तां विष्णु वक्त्राहितेक्षणाम्..
अथापरां वयोवृद्धां श्वेतवस्त्रावगुंठिताम् .. 41 ..
5.80.m:
intent on massaging his feet, with her eyes fixed on Viṣṇu’s face;
and then another woman, advanced in age, veiled in white cloth. 41

5.80.s:
sanniviṣṭāṃ tadabhyāśe samyagdhyānaparāyaṇām ..
dvādaśārkaprabhāyuktāṃ kṛśāṃgīṃ pulakānvitām.. 42 ..
5.80.d:
सन्निविष्टां तदभ्याशे सम्यग्ध्यानपरायणाम् ..
द्वादशार्कप्रभायुक्तां कृशांगीं पुलकान्विताम्.. 42 ..
5.80.m: sitting near Him, absorbed in perfect meditation, / possessing the brilliance of twelve suns, slender-limbed, and her hair standing on end with joy.

5.80.s:
atha tau viṣṇunā harṣādubhāvapi praharṣitau ..
saṃbhāṣitau ca saṃpṛṣṭau yadarthaṃ ca samāgatau .. 43 ..
5.80.d:
अथ तौ विष्णुना हर्षादुभावपि प्रहर्षितौ ..
संभाषितौ च संपृष्टौ यदर्थं च समागतौ .. 43 ..
5.80.m: Then the two were filled with joy by Viṣṇu in His delight; / they were addressed and asked for what purpose they had come.

5.80.s:
.. śrīnārada uvāca .. ..
ahaṃ hi surakāryeṇa saṃprāpyo'tra tavāṃtikam ..
garuḍo vai brāhmaṇāya yanmāṃ pṛcchasi keśava .. 44 ..
5.80.d:
.. श्रीनारद उवाच .. ..
अहं हि सुरकार्येण संप्राप्योऽत्र तवांतिकम् ..
गरुडो वै ब्राह्मणाय यन्मां पृच्छसि केशव .. 44 ..
5.80.m: Śrī Nārada said: / “Indeed, I have arrived here in your presence on the business of the gods; / Garuḍa [has come] for the sake of a brahmin, about which you ask me, O Keśava.”

5.80.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
kaccitkṣemaṃ muniśreṣṭha sarveṣāṃ tridivaukasām ..
kaccinneṃdrasya saṃjātaṃ bhayaṃ dānavasaṃbhavam .. 45 ..
5.80.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
कच्चित्क्षेमं मुनिश्रेष्ठ सर्वेषां त्रिदिवौकसाम् ..
कच्चिन्नेंद्रस्य संजातं भयं दानवसंभवम् .. 45 ..
5.80.m: The Blessed Lord said: / “Is all well, O best of sages, with all the dwellers of heaven? / Has Indra not incurred fear arising from the Dānavas?

5.80.s:
yajñabhāgaṃ labhaṃte sma kacciddevāḥ savāsavāḥ ..
kaccinna dānavaḥ kaścidutkaṭo'bhūddharātale .. 46 ..
5.80.d:
यज्ञभागं लभंते स्म कच्चिद्देवाः सवासवाः ..
कच्चिन्न दानवः कश्चिदुत्कटोऽभूद्धरातले .. 46 ..
5.80.m: Have the gods with Indra received their share of the sacrifice? / Has no formidable Dānava arisen on the surface of the earth?”

5.80.s:
.. śrīnārada uvāca .. ..
sāṃprataṃ dharaṇī prāptā caturvaktrasya saṃnidhau ..
rorūyamāṇā bhārārtā dānavaiḥ pīḍitā bhṛśam ..
provāca padmajaṃ tatra duḥkhena mahatā'nvitā .. 47 ..
5.80.d:
.. श्रीनारद उवाच .. ..
सांप्रतं धरणी प्राप्ता चतुर्वक्त्रस्य संनिधौ ..
रोरूयमाणा भारार्ता दानवैः पीडिता भृशम् ..
प्रोवाच पद्मजं तत्र दुःखेन महताऽन्विता .. 47 ..
5.80.m: Śrī Nārada said: / “Just now the Earth has arrived into the presence of the Four-faced One [Brahmā]; / weeping loudly, oppressed by her burden, and severely tormented by the Dānavas, / filled with great sorrow, she said to the Lotus-born One there:

5.80.s:
.. dharaṇyuvāca .. ..
kālanemirhato yo'sau viṣṇunāprabhaviṣṇunā ..
ugrasenasutaḥ kaṃsaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ sa mahāsuraḥ .. 48 ..
5.80.d:
.. धरण्युवाच .. ..
कालनेमिर्हतो योऽसौ विष्णुनाप्रभविष्णुना ..
उग्रसेनसुतः कंसः संभूतः स महासुरः .. 48 ..
5.80.m: The Earth said: / ‘That Kālanemi who was slain by the all-powerful Viṣṇu / has been born as that great asura Kaṃsa, the son of Ugrasena.

5.80.s:
ariṣṭo dhenukaḥ keśī pralambonāma cāparaḥ ..
tathānyā tu mahāraudrā pūtanā nāma rākṣasī .. 49 ..
5.80.d:
अरिष्टो धेनुकः केशी प्रलम्बोनाम चापरः ..
तथान्या तु महारौद्रा पूतना नाम राक्षसी .. 49 ..
5.80.m: Ariṣṭa, Dhenuka, Keśin, and another named Pralamba, / as well as another most terrifying rākṣasī named Pūtanā—

5.80.s:
itaścetaśca dhāvadbhirdānavairebhireva ca..
vṛthā me jāyate pīḍā tathānyairapi dāruṇaiḥ .. 6.80.50 ..
5.80.d:
इतश्चेतश्च धावद्भिर्दानवैरेभिरेव च..
वृथा मे जायते पीडा तथान्यैरपि दारुणैः .. 6.80.50 ..
5.80.m: by these very Dānavas running here and there, / and by other cruel ones as well, useless suffering is caused to me.

5.80.s:
ūrdhvabāhustathā jāto martyaloke jano'dhunā ..
bahutvānna pramāti sma kathaṃciddhi mamopari .. 51 ..
5.80.d:
ऊर्ध्वबाहुस्तथा जातो मर्त्यलोके जनोऽधुना ..
बहुत्वान्न प्रमाति स्म कथंचिद्धि ममोपरि .. 51 ..
5.80.m: Moreover, the people in the mortal realm have now thrown up their arms [in despair]; / indeed, on account of their multiplicity, they can in no way fit upon me.

5.80.s:
bhārāvataraṇaṃ deva na kariṣyasi cāśu cet ..
rasātalaṃ prayāsyāmi tadā'haṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 52 ..
5.80.d:
भारावतरणं देव न करिष्यसि चाशु चेत् ..
रसातलं प्रयास्यामि तदाऽहं नात्र संशयः .. 52 ..
5.80.m: O lord, if you do not quickly relieve my burden, / then I shall go to Rasātala; of this there is no doubt.’

5.80.s:
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā ..
saṃmaṃtrya vibudhaiḥ sārdhaṃ preṣito'haṃ tavāṃtikam .. 53 ..
5.80.d:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मणा लोककर्तृणा ..
संमंत्र्य विबुधैः सार्धं प्रेषितोऽहं तवांतिकम् .. 53 ..
5.80.m: Having heard those words of hers, Brahmā, the creator of the worlds, / deliberated with the gods and sent me into your presence:

5.80.s:
proktavyo bhagavānvākyaṃ tvayā devo janārdanaḥ ..
yathā'vatīrya bhūpṛṣṭhe bhāramasyāḥ praṇāśayet .. 54 ..
5.80.d:
प्रोक्तव्यो भगवान्वाक्यं त्वया देवो जनार्दनः ..
यथाऽवतीर्य भूपृष्ठे भारमस्याः प्रणाशयेत् .. 54 ..
5.80.m: ‘The Blessed Lord Janārdana should be told by you in these words, / so that descending to the surface of the earth, He may destroy her burden.’

5.80.s:
tasmādbhūbhitale deva kṛtvā janma svayaṃ vibho ..
bhāraṃ nāśaya medinyā etadartha mihāgataḥ .. 55 ..
5.80.d:
तस्माद्भूभितले देव कृत्वा जन्म स्वयं विभो ..
भारं नाशय मेदिन्या एतदर्थ मिहागतः .. 55 ..
5.80.m: Therefore, O all-pervading lord, taking birth yourself on the surface of the earth, / destroy the burden of the Earth. For this purpose I have come here.”

5.80.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
evaṃ mune kariṣyāmi saṃmaṃtrya brahmaṇā saha ..
bhārāvataraṇaṃ bhūmeḥ sākaṃ devaiḥ savāsavaiḥ .. 56 ..
5.80.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
एवं मुने करिष्यामि संमंत्र्य ब्रह्मणा सह ..
भारावतरणं भूमेः साकं देवैः सवासवैः .. 56 ..
5.80.m: The Blessed Lord said: / “So shall I do, O sage, after deliberating with Brahmā, / relieving the burden of the earth together with the gods led by Indra.”

5.80.s:
evamuktvā'tha taṃ viṣṇurnāradaṃ munipuṃgavam ..
tataśca garuḍaṃ prāha tvaṃ kimarthamihāgataḥ .. 57 ..
5.80.d:
एवमुक्त्वाऽथ तं विष्णुर्नारदं मुनिपुंगवम् ..
ततश्च गरुडं प्राह त्वं किमर्थमिहागतः .. 57 ..
5.80.m: Having thus spoken to that Nārada, the best of sages, / Viṣṇu then said to Garuḍa: “For what purpose have you come here?”

5.80.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye suparṇākhyamāhātmye viṣṇudarśanamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 80 .. cha ..
5.80.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सुपर्णाख्यमाहात्म्ये विष्णुदर्शनमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 80 .. छ ..
5.80.m: Thus ends the eightieth chapter, titled “Description of the Māhātmya of the Darśana of Viṣṇu” in the Suparṇākhyamāhātmya, in the Śrī-Hāṭakeśvara-kṣetra-māhātmya, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.81.s:
.. .. śrīgaruḍa uvāca .. ..
mamāsti dayitaṃ mitraṃ brāhmaṇo bhṛguvaṃśajaḥ ..
tasyāsti mādhavīnāma kanyā kamalalocanā .. 1 ..
5.81.d:
.. .. श्रीगरुड उवाच .. ..
ममास्ति दयितं मित्रं ब्राह्मणो भृगुवंशजः ..
तस्यास्ति माधवीनाम कन्या कमललोचना .. 1 ..
5.81.m: Śrī Garuḍa said: / “I have a beloved friend, a brahmin born of the lineage of Bhṛgu. / He has a lotus-eyed daughter named Mādhavī.

5.81.s:
na tasyāḥ sadṛśaḥ kāṃtaḥ prāptastena mahātmanā ..
yatastato'hamādiṣṭaḥ kāṃtamasyāstvamānaya ..
anurūpaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha yadyahaṃ saṃmatastava .. 2 ..
5.81.d:
न तस्याः सदृशः कांतः प्राप्तस्तेन महात्मना ..
यतस्ततोऽहमादिष्टः कांतमस्यास्त्वमानय ..
अनुरूपं द्विजश्रेष्ठ यद्यहं संमतस्तव .. 2 ..
5.81.m: No suitable husband could be found for her by that great-souled one; / therefore I was instructed: ‘Bring a suitable husband for her, / O best of birds, if I am esteemed by you.’

5.81.s:
tato mayā'khilā bhūmistadvarārthaṃ vilokitā ..
na tadarthaṃ varo labdhaḥ sarvaiḥ samucito guṇaiḥ .. 3 ..
5.81.d:
ततो मयाऽखिला भूमिस्तद्वरार्थं विलोकिता ..
न तदर्थं वरो लब्धः सर्वैः समुचितो गुणैः .. 3 ..
5.81.m: Then the entire earth was searched by me for a bridegroom for her; / no bridegroom suitable in every virtue was found for her.

5.81.s:
tatastvaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa mama citte vyavasthitaḥ ..
anurūpaḥ patistasyāḥ sarvaireva guṇairyutaḥ .. 4 ..
5.81.d:
ततस्त्वं पुण्डरीकाक्ष मम चित्ते व्यवस्थितः ..
अनुरूपः पतिस्तस्याः सर्वैरेव गुणैर्युतः .. 4 ..
5.81.m: Then you, O Lotus-eyed One, were settled in my mind / as a suitable husband for her, endowed with all virtues.

5.81.s:
tasmātpāṇigrahaṃ tasyāḥ svīkuruṣva sureśvara ..
atyantarūpayuktāyā mama vākyapraṇoditaḥ .. 5 ..
5.81.d:
तस्मात्पाणिग्रहं तस्याः स्वीकुरुष्व सुरेश्वर ..
अत्यन्तरूपयुक्ताया मम वाक्यप्रणोदितः .. 5 ..
5.81.m: Therefore, O Lord of the gods, prompted by my words, / accept the hand of that girl who possesses extraordinary beauty.”

5.81.s:
.. bhagavānuvāca .. ..
atrānaya dvijaśreṣṭha tāṃ kanyāṃ kamalekṣaṇām..
yena dṛṣṭvā svayaṃ paścātprakaromi yathoditam .. 6 ..
5.81.d:
.. भगवानुवाच .. ..
अत्रानय द्विजश्रेष्ठ तां कन्यां कमलेक्षणाम्..
येन दृष्ट्वा स्वयं पश्चात्प्रकरोमि यथोदितम् .. 6 ..
5.81.m: The Blessed Lord said: / “Bring that lotus-eyed girl here, O best of the twice-born, / so that having seen her myself, I may then do as spoken.”

5.81.s:
.. garuḍa uvāca .. ..
tava tejobhayādeva sā kanyā janakānvitā ..
mayā dūre vinirmuktā tatkathaṃ tāmihānaye .. 7 ..
5.81.d:
.. गरुड उवाच .. ..
तव तेजोभयादेव सा कन्या जनकान्विता ..
मया दूरे विनिर्मुक्ता तत्कथं तामिहानये .. 7 ..
5.81.m: Garuḍa said: / “Only out of fear of your splendour was that girl left far behind / together with her father by me; so how may I bring her here?”

5.81.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
atra tāṃ mama tattejo janakena samanvitām..
na hi dhakṣyati tasmāttvaṃ śīghraṃ dvijavarā''naya .. 8 ..
5.81.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
अत्र तां मम तत्तेजो जनकेन समन्विताम्..
न हि धक्ष्यति तस्मात्त्वं शीघ्रं द्विजवरा'ऽनय .. 8 ..
5.81.m: The Blessed Lord said: / “Here that splendour of mine will not burn her, / accompanied by her father; therefore, O best of the twice-born, bring her quickly.”

5.81.s:
evamuktastatastena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ..
tāṃ kanyā mānayāmāsa taṃ ca viprabhṛgūdvaham.. 9 ..
5.81.d:
एवमुक्तस्ततस्तेन विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ..
तां कन्या मानयामास तं च विप्रभृगूद्वहम्.. 9 ..
5.81.m: Thus addressed then by that all-powerful Viṣṇu, / he brought that maiden and that brahmin, the scion of Bhṛgu.

5.81.s:
athāsau praṇipatyoccairbrāhmaṇo madhusūdanam ..
lakṣmīvannyaviśatpārśve garuḍasya samīpataḥ .. 6.81.10 ..
5.81.d:
अथासौ प्रणिपत्योच्चैर्ब्राह्मणो मधुसूदनम् ..
लक्ष्मीवन्न्यविशत्पार्श्वे गरुडस्य समीपतः .. 6.81.10 ..
5.81.m: Then, having bowed deeply to Madhusūdana, / the illustrious brahmin sat down at the side, near Garuḍa.

5.81.s:
sāpi kanyā varārohā bālyabhāvādaninditā ..
śayyaikāṃte samāviṣṭā dakṣiṇe muravidviṣaḥ .. 11 ..
5.81.d:
सापि कन्या वरारोहा बाल्यभावादनिन्दिता ..
शय्यैकांते समाविष्टा दक्षिणे मुरविद्विषः .. 11 ..
5.81.m: That maiden of shapely hips, blameless due to her childish innocence, / sat down on the right edge of the bed of the foe of Mura.

5.81.s:
atha kopaparītāṃgī mahiṣyādharmamāśritā ..
lakṣmīḥ śaśāpa tāṃ kanyāṃ sapatnīti vicintya ca .. 12 ..
5.81.d:
अथ कोपपरीतांगी महिष्याधर्ममाश्रिता ..
लक्ष्मीः शशाप तां कन्यां सपत्नीति विचिन्त्य च .. 12 ..
5.81.m: Then Lakṣmī, her limbs overcome with anger, adopting the duty of a principal queen / and thinking, ‘She is a co-wife,’ cursed that maiden:

5.81.s:
yasmānme purataḥ pāpe kāṃtasya mama harṣitā..
śayyāyāṃ tvaṃ samāviṣṭā lajjāṃ tyaktvā sudūrataḥ ..
tasmādaśvamukhī nūnaṃ vikṛtā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi .. 13 ..
5.81.d:
यस्मान्मे पुरतः पापे कांतस्य मम हर्षिता..
शय्यायां त्वं समाविष्टा लज्जां त्यक्त्वा सुदूरतः ..
तस्मादश्वमुखी नूनं विकृता त्वं भविष्यसि .. 13 ..
5.81.m: “Since, casting shame far away, you have joyfully sat upon the bed / of my beloved in front of me, O sinful girl, / therefore you shall surely become deformed with the face of a horse!”

5.81.s:
evaṃ śāpe śriyā datte hāhākāro mahānabhūt ..
sarveṣāṃ tatra saṃsthānāṃ kopaścāpi dvijanmanaḥ .. .. 14..
5.81.d:
एवं शापे श्रिया दत्ते हाहाकारो महानभूत् ..
सर्वेषां तत्र संस्थानां कोपश्चापि द्विजन्मनः .. .. 14..
5.81.m: When the curse was thus uttered by Śrī, a great cry of grief arose / among all those standing there, as well as anger in the twice-born.

5.81.s:
.. brāhmaṇa uvāca .. ..
sahasraṃ yācyate kanyā karotyekaḥ karagraham ..
vāṅmātreṇa na tasyāḥ syātpatnībhāvaḥ kathaṃcana .. 19 ..
yāvannāgnidvijātīnāṃ pratyakṣaṃ gurusaṃnidhau ..
sasaṃkalpaṃ svayaṃ dattā gṛhyoktavidhinā janaiḥ .. 16 ..
tasmāttaddoṣanirmuktā sapatnyeṣā samā tvayā ..
kṛtā vājimukhī pāpe tvaṃ gajāsyā bhaviṣyasi ...7..
evamuktvā sa vipreṃdrastataḥ provāca keśavam..
ātithyaṃ vihitaṃ hyetattava patnyā yathocitam ..
tasmāttatra prayāsyāmi yatra syāttādṛśī sutā .. 18 ..
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
na santāpastvayā kāryaḥ kṛtyesmindvijasattama ..
mamāṃtike prayātānāṃ nāśubhaṃ jāyate kvacit .. 19 ..
5.81.d:
.. ब्राह्मण उवाच .. ..
सहस्रं याच्यते कन्या करोत्येकः करग्रहम् ..
वाङ्मात्रेण न तस्याः स्यात्पत्नीभावः कथंचन .. 19 ..
यावन्नाग्निद्विजातीनां प्रत्यक्षं गुरुसंनिधौ ..
ससंकल्पं स्वयं दत्ता गृह्योक्तविधिना जनैः .. 16 ..
तस्मात्तद्दोषनिर्मुक्ता सपत्न्येषा समा त्वया ..
कृता वाजिमुखी पापे त्वं गजास्या भविष्यसि ...7..
एवमुक्त्वा स विप्रेंद्रस्ततः प्रोवाच केशवम्..
आतिथ्यं विहितं ह्येतत्तव पत्न्या यथोचितम् ..
तस्मात्तत्र प्रयास्यामि यत्र स्यात्तादृशी सुता .. 18 ..
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
न सन्तापस्त्वया कार्यः कृत्येस्मिन्द्विजसत्तम ..
ममांतिके प्रयातानां नाशुभं जायते क्वचित् .. 19 ..
5.81.m:
The brahmin said: / “A maiden is asked for by a thousand, [but] one takes her hand; / by mere words, the status of a wife cannot belong to her in any way,
as long as she is not personally given with solemn declaration in the presence of elders, / before the fire and the twice-born, by people according to the rite prescribed in the Gṛhyasūtras.
Therefore, she is free from that fault; [though] innocent, she was made horse-faced by you / as an equal co-wife, O sinful one; you shall become elephant-faced!”
Having spoken thus, that foremost among brahmins then said to Keśava: / “Indeed, such hospitality was rendered by your wife as she saw fit; / therefore I shall go to that place where my daughter may remain in such a state.”
The Blessed Lord said: / “You should not grieve over this deed, O best of brahmins; / for those who have come into my presence, misfortune never occurs anywhere.

5.81.s:
tasmānnāśvamukhī hyeṣā janmanyasminbhaviṣyati ..
gṛhītvemāṃ gṛhaṃ gaccha prayaccha svepsitāya ca .. 6.81.20 ..
śayane vāmadigbhāgaḥ kalatrāṇāmudāhṛtaḥ ..
dakṣiṇe bandhulokānāṃ tatkālocitaśāyinām..2...
5.81.d:
तस्मान्नाश्वमुखी ह्येषा जन्मन्यस्मिन्भविष्यति ..
गृहीत्वेमां गृहं गच्छ प्रयच्छ स्वेप्सिताय च .. 6.81.20 ..
शयने वामदिग्भागः कलत्राणामुदाहृतः ..
दक्षिणे बन्धुलोकानां तत्कालोचितशायिनाम्..2...
5.81.m:
Therefore, she shall certainly not be horse-faced in this birth; / taking her, go home and give her to whomever you desire.
In sleeping, the left side is designated for wives, / and the right for kin who lie down appropriately at that time.

5.81.s:
seyaṃ tava sutā vipra baṃdhusthānaṃ samāśritā ..
bhaviṣyati tato jāmiḥ kaniṣṭhā me'nyajanmani .. 22 ..
5.81.d:
सेयं तव सुता विप्र बंधुस्थानं समाश्रिता ..
भविष्यति ततो जामिः कनिष्ठा मेऽन्यजन्मनि .. 22 ..
5.81.m: This daughter of yours, O brahmin, took refuge in the place of kin; / therefore, in another birth she shall become my younger sister.”

5.81.s:
avatīrṇasya bhūpṛṣṭhe devakāryeṇa kenacit ..
vājivaktradharā proktā yadyeṣā mama kāṃtayā ..23..
5.81.d:
अवतीर्णस्य भूपृष्ठे देवकार्येण केनचित् ..
वाजिवक्त्रधरा प्रोक्ता यद्येषा मम कांतया ..23..
5.81.m: When I descend onto the surface of the earth for some divine purpose, / if she is said by my beloved to have a horse's face,

5.81.s:
tato'haṃ sumahatkṛtvā tapaścaivānayā saha ..
kariṣyāmi śubhāsyāṃ ca tathā lakṣmīmapi dvija .. 24 ..
5.81.d:
ततोऽहं सुमहत्कृत्वा तपश्चैवानया सह ..
करिष्यामि शुभास्यां च तथा लक्ष्मीमपि द्विज .. 24 ..
5.81.m: then, having performed very great austerity together with her, / I shall make both her and Lakṣmī possess auspicious faces, O brahmin.

5.81.s:
evaṃ sa bhagavānvipraṃ taṃ santoṣya tadā girā ..
garuḍena samaṃ cakre kathāścitrā manoramāḥ .. 25 ..
5.81.d:
एवं स भगवान्विप्रं तं सन्तोष्य तदा गिरा ..
गरुडेन समं चक्रे कथाश्चित्रा मनोरमाः .. 25 ..
5.81.m: Having thus pleased that brahmin with his speech at that time, the Blessed One / held strange and charming conversations together with Garuḍa.

5.81.s:
atha tasminkathāṃte sa garuḍaḥ puruṣottamam ..
provāca tāṃ striyaṃ dṛṣṭvā vṛddhāṃ tejaḥsamanvitām .. .. 26 ..
5.81.d:
अथ तस्मिन्कथांते स गरुडः पुरुषोत्तमम् ..
प्रोवाच तां स्त्रियं दृष्ट्वा वृद्धां तेजःसमन्विताम् .. .. 26 ..
5.81.m: Then, at the end of that conversation, Garuḍa, seeing that woman / who was aged and endowed with fiery brilliance, spoke to the Supreme Person:

5.81.s:
apūrveyaṃ suraśreṣṭha strī vṛddhā tava pārśvagā ..
kimarthaṃ keyamākhyāhi kutaḥ prāptā janārdana .. 27 ..
5.81.d:
अपूर्वेयं सुरश्रेष्ठ स्त्री वृद्धा तव पार्श्वगा ..
किमर्थं केयमाख्याहि कुतः प्राप्ता जनार्दन .. 27 ..
5.81.m: “This is unprecedented, O best of gods, this old woman standing at your side. / Why is she here, who is she, tell me, and from where has she come, O Janārdana?”

5.81.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
eṣā khyātā khagaśreṣṭha loke'sminvṛddhakanyakā ..
śāṃḍilīnāma sarvajñā brahmacaryaparāyaṇā .. 28 ..
5.81.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
एषा ख्याता खगश्रेष्ठ लोकेऽस्मिन्वृद्धकन्यका ..
शांडिलीनाम सर्वज्ञा ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणा .. 28 ..
5.81.m: The Blessed One said: / “She is known in this world, O best of birds, as the elder maiden / named Śāṇḍilī, all-knowing and devoted to celibacy.

5.81.s:
tapovīryasamopetā sarvadevābhivaṃditā ..
nāsti vai cedṛśī nārī khagendrātra jagattraye .. 29 ..
5.81.d:
तपोवीर्यसमोपेता सर्वदेवाभिवंदिता ..
नास्ति वै चेदृशी नारी खगेन्द्रात्र जगत्त्रये .. 29 ..
5.81.m: She is endowed with the power of austerity and revered by all the gods. / Indeed, there is no such woman in the three worlds, O king of birds.”

5.81.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vihasya vihagādhipaḥ ..
provāca vāsudevaṃ ca tāṃ vilokya ciraṃ dvijāḥ .. 6.81.30 ..
5.81.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विहस्य विहगाधिपः ..
प्रोवाच वासुदेवं च तां विलोक्य चिरं द्विजाः .. 6.81.30 ..
5.81.m: Sūta said: / Having heard his speech and laughing, the king of birds, / having looked at her for a long time, spoke to Vāsudeva, O brahmins:

5.81.s:
.. garuḍa uvāca .. ..
naitaccitraṃ tapo yacca kriyate sumahattaram ..
yathā ca dīyate dānaṃ yacca tatrāsti cādbhutam..
tathā ca kriyate yuddhaṃ saṃgrāme yuddhaśālibhiḥ .. 31 ..
5.81.d:
.. गरुड उवाच .. ..
नैतच्चित्रं तपो यच्च क्रियते सुमहत्तरम् ..
यथा च दीयते दानं यच्च तत्रास्ति चाद्भुतम्..
तथा च क्रियते युद्धं संग्रामे युद्धशालिभिः .. 31 ..
5.81.m: Garuḍa said: / “It is no wonder that very great austerity is performed, / or that gifts are given, and whatever wonder there may be in that, / or that a battle is fought in war by warriors skilled in combat.

5.81.s:
nāścaryaṃ citrametacca brahmacaryaṃ tadadbhutam ..
viśeṣādyauvanāvasthāṃ saṃprāpya puruṣottama .. 32 ..
5.81.d:
नाश्चर्यं चित्रमेतच्च ब्रह्मचर्यं तदद्भुतम् ..
विशेषाद्यौवनावस्थां संप्राप्य पुरुषोत्तम .. 32 ..
5.81.m: Celibacy is not surprising, not wondrous, yet it is a marvel / especially after reaching the stage of youth, O Supreme Person,

5.81.s:
viśeṣeṇa ca nārībhiratra na śraddadhāmyaham ..
avaśyaṃ yauvanasthena tiryagyonigatena ca .. 33 ..
5.81.d:
विशेषेण च नारीभिरत्र न श्रद्दधाम्यहम् ..
अवश्यं यौवनस्थेन तिर्यग्योनिगतेन च .. 33 ..
5.81.m: and especially in the case of women—in this matter I do not believe it. / Inevitably, one who is in youth, even among animals,

5.81.s:
vikāraḥ khalu kartavyo nādhi kārāya yauvanam ..
yadi na prāpnuvaṃtyetāḥ puruṣaṃ yoṣitaḥ kvacit .. 34 ..
5.81.d:
विकारः खलु कर्तव्यो नाधि काराय यौवनम् ..
यदि न प्राप्नुवंत्येताः पुरुषं योषितः क्वचित् .. 34 ..
5.81.m: must experience agitation; youth does not exist for self-restraint. / If women do not find a man anywhere,

5.81.s:
anyonyaṃ maithunaṃ cakruḥ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitāḥ ..
kuṣṭhinaṃ vyādhitaṃ vāpi sthaviraṃ vyaṃgameva ca ..
apyetāḥ puruṣābhāve manyaṃte paṃcasāyakam .. 35 ..
5.81.d:
अन्योन्यं मैथुनं चक्रुः कामबाणप्रपीडिताः ..
कुष्ठिनं व्याधितं वापि स्थविरं व्यंगमेव च ..
अप्येताः पुरुषाभावे मन्यंते पंचसायकम् .. 35 ..
5.81.m: they perform intercourse with one another, tormented by the arrows of desire. / In the absence of a man, they regard even a leper, a diseased man, / an old man, or a crippled one as the Five-Arrowed God of Love.

5.81.s:
nāgnistṛpyati kāṣṭhānāṃ nāpagānāṃ mahodadhiḥ ..
nāṃtakaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ na puṃsāṃ vāmalocanā .. 36 ..
5.81.d:
नाग्निस्तृप्यति काष्ठानां नापगानां महोदधिः ..
नांतकः सर्वभूतानां न पुंसां वामलोचना .. 36 ..
5.81.m: Fire is never satiated with logs, nor the great ocean with rivers; / the End-maker is not satiated with all beings, nor is a fair-eyed woman with men.

5.81.s:
na paratra bhayādetā maryādāṃ vidadhuḥ striyaḥ ..
muktvā bhūpabhayaṃ caikamathavā gurujaṃ bhayam .. 37 ..
5.81.d:
न परत्र भयादेता मर्यादां विदधुः स्त्रियः ..
मुक्त्वा भूपभयं चैकमथवा गुरुजं भयम् .. 37 ..
5.81.m: These women do not observe proper bounds out of fear for the next world, / but only out of fear of the king, or fear born of an elder.”

5.81.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ tasya vacaḥ śrutvā śāṃḍilī brahmacāriṇī ..
maunavratadharā'pyevaṃ hṛdi kopaṃ dadhāra sā .. 38 ..
5.81.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शांडिली ब्रह्मचारिणी ..
मौनव्रतधराऽप्येवं हृदि कोपं दधार सा .. 38 ..
5.81.m: Sūta said: / Having thus heard his words, the celibate Śāṇḍilī, / though observing a vow of silence, harbored anger in her heart.

5.81.s:
etasminnaṃtare tasya pakṣināthasya tatkṣaṇāt ..
ubhau pakṣau gatau nāśaṃ ruṇḍākāro'tra so'bhavat .. 39 ..
5.81.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तस्य पक्षिनाथस्य तत्क्षणात् ..
उभौ पक्षौ गतौ नाशं रुण्डाकारोऽत्र सोऽभवत् .. 39 ..
5.81.m: In that very moment, both wings of that king of birds / were destroyed instantly, and he became like a headless torso there,

5.81.s:
māṃsapiṃḍamayo raudraḥ sarvarogavivarjitaḥ ..
aśaktaśca tathā gantuṃ padamātramapi kvacit .. .. 6.81.40 ..
5.81.d:
मांसपिंडमयो रौद्रः सर्वरोगविवर्जितः ..
अशक्तश्च तथा गन्तुं पदमात्रमपि क्वचित् .. .. 6.81.40 ..
5.81.m: consisting of a lump of flesh, dreadful, though free of all disease, / and incapable of moving even a single step anywhere.

5.81.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye suparṇapakṣapātavarṇanaṃnāmaikāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 81 .. .. cha ..
5.81.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सुपर्णपक्षपातवर्णनंनामैकाशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 81 .. .. छ ..
5.81.m: Thus ends the eighty-first chapter, titled “The Description of the Falling of the Wings of the Bird of Fair Wings,” in the Hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmya of the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.82.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
taddṛṣṭvā puṃḍarīkākṣo garuḍasya viceṣṭitam ..
vismitaściṃtayāmāsa kimidaṃ sāṃprataṃ sthitam .. 1 ..
5.82.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तद्दृष्ट्वा पुंडरीकाक्षो गरुडस्य विचेष्टितम् ..
विस्मितश्चिंतयामास किमिदं सांप्रतं स्थितम् .. 1 ..
5.82.m: Sūta said: / Seeing that plight of Garuḍa, the Lotus-Eyed One / was astonished and thought: “What is this that has now occurred?

5.82.s:
api vajraprahāreṇa yasya romāpi na cyutam ..
tau pakṣau sahasā cāsya kathaṃ nipatitau bhuvi .. 2 ..
5.82.d:
अपि वज्रप्रहारेण यस्य रोमापि न च्युतम् ..
तौ पक्षौ सहसा चास्य कथं निपतितौ भुवि .. 2 ..
5.82.m: He, from whom not even a hair fell by the blow of the thunderbolt— / how have both his wings suddenly fallen to the ground?

5.82.s:
nūnametena yā strīṇāṃ kṛtā niṃdā mahātmanā..
dūṣitaṃ brahmacaryaṃ yacchāṃḍilīṃ samavekṣya ca..3..
5.82.d:
नूनमेतेन या स्त्रीणां कृता निंदा महात्मना..
दूषितं ब्रह्मचर्यं यच्छांडिलीं समवेक्ष्य च..3..
5.82.m: Surely, because censure of women was uttered by this noble one, / and celibacy was questioned by him while looking at Śāṇḍilī,

5.82.s:
anayā pātitau pakṣau tapaḥśaktiprabhāvataḥ..
nānyasya vidyate śaktirīdṛśī bhuvanatraye .. 4 ..
5.82.d:
अनया पातितौ पक्षौ तपःशक्तिप्रभावतः..
नान्यस्य विद्यते शक्तिरीदृशी भुवनत्रये .. 4 ..
5.82.m: his wings were felled by her through the majesty of the power of her austerity. / No one else possesses such power in the three worlds.”

5.82.s:
tataḥ prasādayāmāsa śāṃḍilīṃ garuḍadhvajaḥ ..
tadarthaṃ vinayopetaḥ smitaṃ kṛtvā dvijottamāḥ .. 5 ..
5.82.d:
ततः प्रसादयामास शांडिलीं गरुडध्वजः ..
तदर्थं विनयोपेतः स्मितं कृत्वा द्विजोत्तमाः .. 5 ..
5.82.m: Then the god whose banner is Garuḍa propitiated Śāṇḍilī / for his sake, having smiled and become endowed with humility, O best of brahmins.

5.82.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
sāmānyavacanaṃ proktaṃ sarvastrīṇāmanena hi ..
tatkimarthaṃ mahābhāge tvayā caivedṛśaḥ kṛtaḥ .. 6 ..
5.82.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
सामान्यवचनं प्रोक्तं सर्वस्त्रीणामनेन हि ..
तत्किमर्थं महाभागे त्वया चैवेदृशः कृतः .. 6 ..
5.82.m: The Blessed One said: / “Indeed, a general statement regarding all women was uttered by him. / Then why, O highly fortunate lady, has he been made like this by you?”

5.82.s:
.. śāṃḍilyuvāca .. ..
mama vaktraṃ samālokya smitaṃ cakre janārdana ..
strīniṃdā vihitānena svamatyāpi jagadguro .. 7 ..
5.82.d:
.. शांडिल्युवाच .. ..
मम वक्त्रं समालोक्य स्मितं चक्रे जनार्दन ..
स्त्रीनिंदा विहितानेन स्वमत्यापि जगद्गुरो .. 7 ..
5.82.m: Śāṇḍilī said: / “Looking closely at my face, Janārdana, he smiled; / and censure of women was uttered by him using his own wit, O teacher of the universe.

5.82.s:
etasmātkāraṇādasya nigraho'yaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ ..
manasā na ca vākyena na ca keśava karmaṇā .. 8 ..
5.82.d:
एतस्मात्कारणादस्य निग्रहोऽयं मया कृतः ..
मनसा न च वाक्येन न च केशव कर्मणा .. 8 ..
5.82.m: For this reason this punishment was inflicted upon him by me / in mind alone, and not by word nor by deed, O Keśava.”

5.82.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
tathāpi kuru cāsya tvaṃ prasādaṃ gatakalmaṣe..
mama vākyānurodhena yadimāṃ manyase śubhe .. 9 ..
5.82.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
तथापि कुरु चास्य त्वं प्रसादं गतकल्मषे..
मम वाक्यानुरोधेन यदिमां मन्यसे शुभे .. 9 ..
5.82.m: The Blessed One said: / “Even so, show him grace, O sinless one, / out of regard for my word, if you have regard for me, O auspicious lady.”

5.82.s:
.. śāṃḍilyuvāca .. ..
manasāpi mayā dhyātaṃ śubhaṃ vā yadivā'śubham ..
nānyathā jāyate deva viśeṣātkopayuktayā .. 6.82.10 ..
5.82.d:
.. शांडिल्युवाच .. ..
मनसापि मया ध्यातं शुभं वा यदिवाऽशुभम् ..
नान्यथा जायते देव विशेषात्कोपयुक्तया .. 6.82.10 ..
5.82.m: Śāṇḍilī said: / “Whatever good or bad has been conceived by me even in thought / does not turn out otherwise, O god, especially when I am filled with anger.

5.82.s:
tasmādeṣa mamādeśādārādha yatu śaṃkaram ..
pakṣalābhāya nānyasya śaktirdātuṃ vyavasthitā .. 11 ..
5.82.d:
तस्मादेष ममादेशादाराध यतु शंकरम् ..
पक्षलाभाय नान्यस्य शक्तिर्दातुं व्यवस्थिता .. 11 ..
5.82.m: Therefore, by my command, let him worship Śaṃkara / to regain his wings; no other possesses the power to bestow them.

5.82.s:
athavā puṃḍarīkākṣa rūpamīdṛgvyavasthitaḥ ..
eṣa saṃsthāsyate loke satyametadbravīmyaham .. 12 ..
5.82.d:
अथवा पुंडरीकाक्ष रूपमीदृग्व्यवस्थितः ..
एष संस्थास्यते लोके सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीम्यहम् .. 12 ..
5.82.m: Otherwise, O Lotus-Eyed One, he shall remain in this world / fixed in such a form; this truth I speak.”

5.82.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā taṃ provāca janārdanaḥ ..
garuḍaṃ dainyasaṃyuktaṃ bhāsapiṃḍopamaṃ sthitam .. 13 ..
5.82.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा तं प्रोवाच जनार्दनः ..
गरुडं दैन्यसंयुक्तं भासपिंडोपमं स्थितम् .. 13 ..
5.82.m: Sūta said: / Having heard her words, Janārdana said to Garuḍa, / who was filled with dejection and stood looking like a lump of meat:

5.82.s:
eṣa eva varaścāsyā dvipadeśyā dvijottama ..
pakṣalābhāya yatproktaṃ tava śaṃbhuprasādanam .. 14 ..
5.82.d:
एष एव वरश्चास्या द्विपदेश्या द्विजोत्तम ..
पक्षलाभाय यत्प्रोक्तं तव शंभुप्रसादनम् .. 14 ..
5.82.m: “This indeed is her boon, O best of birds, disguised as a curse, / that propitiation of Śambhu has been prescribed for you to regain your wings.

5.82.s:
tasmādārādhaya kṣipraṃ tvaṃ devaṃ śaśiśekharam ..
avyagraṃ cittamāsthāya divārātramataṃdritaḥ .. 15 ..
5.82.d:
तस्मादाराधय क्षिप्रं त्वं देवं शशिशेखरम् ..
अव्यग्रं चित्तमास्थाय दिवारात्रमतंद्रितः .. 15 ..
5.82.m: Therefore, quickly worship the god who bears the crescent moon on his crest, / fixing your mind untroubled, unwearied day and night,

5.82.s:
yena te tatprabhāvena bhūyaḥ syāttādṛśaṃ vapuḥ ..
tasya devasya māhātmyādacirādapi kāśyapa .. 16 ..
5.82.d:
येन ते तत्प्रभावेन भूयः स्यात्तादृशं वपुः ..
तस्य देवस्य माहात्म्यादचिरादपि काश्यप .. 16 ..
5.82.m: so that, by his power, such a body may become yours once more, / without delay, through the majesty of that god, O descendant of Kaśyapa.”

5.82.s:
tacchrutvā garuḍastūrṇaṃ dhṛtapāśupatavrataḥ ..
saṃsthāpya devamīśānaṃ tatastaṃ toṣamānayat .. 17 ..
5.82.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा गरुडस्तूर्णं धृतपाशुपतव्रतः ..
संस्थाप्य देवमीशानं ततस्तं तोषमानयत् .. 17 ..
5.82.m: Having heard that, Garuḍa quickly undertook the Pāśupata vow; / having installed the god Īśāna, he then satisfied him.

5.82.s:
cāṃdrāyaṇāni kṛcchrāṇi tathā sāṃtapanāni ca ..
prājāpatyāni cakre'tha pārākāṇi tadagrataḥ .. 18 ..
5.82.d:
चांद्रायणानि कृच्छ्राणि तथा सांतपनानि च ..
प्राजापत्यानि चक्रेऽथ पाराकाणि तदग्रतः .. 18 ..
5.82.m: He performed cāndrāyaṇa penances, kṛcchra penances, and sāntapana penances, / as well as prājāpatya penances and parāka penances before him.

5.82.s:
snātvā triṣavaṇaṃ paścādbhasmasnāna parāyaṇaḥ ..
japanrudraśiro rudrānnīlarudrāṃstathāparān .. 19 ..
5.82.d:
स्नात्वा त्रिषवणं पश्चाद्भस्मस्नान परायणः ..
जपन्रुद्रशिरो रुद्रान्नीलरुद्रांस्तथापरान् .. 19 ..
5.82.m: Bathing at the three junctures of the day, subsequently devoted to bathing in ashes, / reciting the Rudraśiras, the Rudras, the Nīlarudras, and others,

5.82.s:
cakre pūjāṃ svayaṃ tasya snāpayitvā yathāvidhi ..
balipūjopahārāṃśca vidhānena prayacchati .. 6.82.20 ..
5.82.d:
चक्रे पूजां स्वयं तस्य स्नापयित्वा यथाविधि ..
बलिपूजोपहारांश्च विधानेन प्रयच्छति .. 6.82.20 ..
5.82.m: he performed worship himself, having bathed him according to the rules, / and offered oblations, worship, and offerings according to proper injunction.

5.82.s:
evaṃ tasya vratasthasya japapūjāparasya ca ..
tato varṣasahasrāṃte gatastuṣṭiṃ maheśvaraḥ ..
abravīdvarado'smīti vṛṇuṣveṣṭaṃ dvijottama .. .. 21 ..
5.82.d:
एवं तस्य व्रतस्थस्य जपपूजापरस्य च ..
ततो वर्षसहस्रांते गतस्तुष्टिं महेश्वरः ..
अब्रवीद्वरदोऽस्मीति वृणुष्वेष्टं द्विजोत्तम .. .. 21 ..
5.82.m: Thus, as he remained fixed in the vow, devoted to recitation and worship, / Maheśvara became pleased at the end of a thousand years, / and said, ‘I am a granter of boons; choose your desired wish, O best of birds!’”

5.82.s:
.. garuḍa uvāca .. ..
paśyāvasthāṃ mameśāna śāṃḍilyā yā vinirmitā ..
pakṣapātaḥ kṛto'smākaṃ tamahaṃ prārthayāmi vai .. 22 ..
5.82.d:
.. गरुड उवाच .. ..
पश्यावस्थां ममेशान शांडिल्या या विनिर्मिता ..
पक्षपातः कृतोऽस्माकं तमहं प्रार्थयामि वै .. 22 ..
5.82.m:
Garuḍa said:
“Behold my condition, O Īśāna, which was brought about by Śāṇḍilyā!
A loss of wings was inflicted upon me; indeed, I pray to you for that.

5.82.s:
tvayātraiva sadā liṃge stheyaṃ hara mamādhunā ..
mama vākyādasaṃdigdhaṃ yadi ceṣṭaṃ prayacchasi .. 23 ..
5.82.d:
त्वयात्रैव सदा लिंगे स्थेयं हर ममाधुना ..
मम वाक्यादसंदिग्धं यदि चेष्टं प्रयच्छसि .. 23 ..
5.82.m:
You must always remain right here in this liṅga now for me, O Hara,
undoubtedly at my word, if you grant me what I desire.”

5.82.s:
.. bhagavānuvāca .. ..
adyaprabhṛti me cātra liṃge vāso bhaviṣyati ..
tvaṃ ca tadrūpasaṃpanno viśeṣādbalavegabhāk .. 24 ..
5.82.d:
.. भगवानुवाच .. ..
अद्यप्रभृति मे चात्र लिंगे वासो भविष्यति ..
त्वं च तद्रूपसंपन्नो विशेषाद्बलवेगभाक् .. 24 ..
5.82.m:
The Lord said:
“From this day onward, my dwelling shall be here in this liṅga.
And you, endowed with that [original] form, possessing extraordinary strength and speed,

5.82.s:
bhaviṣyasi na saṃdeho matprasādādvihaṃgama ..
evamuktvātha taṃ devaḥ svayaṃ pasparśa pāṇinā .. 25 ..
5.82.d:
भविष्यसि न संदेहो मत्प्रसादाद्विहंगम ..
एवमुक्त्वाथ तं देवः स्वयं पस्पर्श पाणिना .. 25 ..
5.82.m:
shall become, without doubt, by my grace, O bird!”
Having spoken thus, the god personally touched him with his hand.

5.82.s:
tato'sya pakṣau saṃjātau tatkṣaṇādeva sundarau ..
tathā romāṇi divyāni jātarūpopamāni ca .. 26 ..
5.82.d:
ततोऽस्य पक्षौ संजातौ तत्क्षणादेव सुन्दरौ ..
तथा रोमाणि दिव्यानि जातरूपोपमानि च .. 26 ..
5.82.m:
Then his two beautiful wings arose at that very moment,
as well as divine feathers resembling gold.

5.82.s:
tataḥ praṇamya taṃ devaṃ prahaṣṭaḥ sa vihaṃgamaḥ ..
gataḥ svabhavanaṃ paścādanujñāpya maheśvaram .. 27 ..
devopi vacanāttasya tasmim̐lliṃge sadā haraḥ ..
nivāsamakarotsamyakprāpte saṃdhyātraye sadā ..2 ..
5.82.d:
ततः प्रणम्य तं देवं प्रहष्टः स विहंगमः ..
गतः स्वभवनं पश्चादनुज्ञाप्य महेश्वरम् .. 27 ..
देवोपि वचनात्तस्य तस्मिम्̐ल्लिंगे सदा हरः ..
निवासमकरोत्सम्यक्प्राप्ते संध्यात्रये सदा ..2 ..
5.82.m:
Then, having bowed to that god, that bird, overjoyed,
took leave of Maheśvara and afterwards went to his own home.
And the god Hara, at his word, always made his dwelling properly
in that liṅga whenever the three junctures of the day arrived.

5.82.s:
tasya cāyatane puṇye yogātprāṇānparityajet ..
prāyopaveśanaṃ kṛtvā na sa bhūyo'pi jāyate 29 ..
5.82.d:
तस्य चायतने पुण्ये योगात्प्राणान्परित्यजेत् ..
प्रायोपवेशनं कृत्वा न स भूयोऽपि जायते 29 ..
5.82.m:
And if one should cast off his life-breaths in its holy sanctuary through yoga,
having undertaken fasting unto death, he is not born again.

5.82.s:
api pāpa samācāraḥ kaulo vā nirghṛṇo'pi vā ..
brahmaghno vā surāpo vā cauro vā bhrūṇahā'pi vā .. 6.82.30 ..
5.82.d:
अपि पाप समाचारः कौलो वा निर्घृणोऽपि वा ..
ब्रह्मघ्नो वा सुरापो वा चौरो वा भ्रूणहाऽपि वा .. 6.82.30 ..
5.82.m:
Even a person of sinful conduct, or an outcaste, or pitiless,
or a slayer of a brahmin, a drinker of liquor, a thief, or an aborticide,

5.82.s:
trikālaṃ pūjayanyastu śraddhāpūtena cetasā ...
saṃvatsaraṃ vasetso'pi śivaloke mahīyate .. 31 ..
5.82.d:
त्रिकालं पूजयन्यस्तु श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा ...
संवत्सरं वसेत्सोऽपि शिवलोके महीयते .. 31 ..
5.82.m:
who worships at the three times of the day with a heart purified by faith,
and resides there for a year, is honored in the world of Śiva.

5.82.s:
athavā somavāreṇa yastaṃ paśyati mānavaḥ ..
kṛtvā kṣaṇaṃ subhaktyā yo yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ dvijāḥ ... .. 32 ..
5.82.d:
अथवा सोमवारेण यस्तं पश्यति मानवः ..
कृत्वा क्षणं सुभक्त्या यो यावत्संवत्सरं द्विजाः ... .. 32 ..
5.82.m:
Or whatever person beholds him on a Monday,
having devoted a single moment with sincere devotion for up to a year, O twice-born ones,

5.82.s:
so'pi yāti na saṃdehaḥ puruṣaḥ śivamandire ..
vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ sevyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ..33..
5.82.d:
सोऽपि याति न संदेहः पुरुषः शिवमन्दिरे ..
विमानवरमारूढः सेव्यमानोऽप्सरोगणैः..33..
5.82.m:
that man also goes to the temple of Śiva, there is no doubt,
mounted upon an excellent aerial chariot and attended by hosts of apsarases.

5.82.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kalikāle viśeṣataḥ..
draṣṭavyo vai suparṇākhyo devaḥ śraddhāsamanvitaiḥ ..34..
5.82.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन कलिकाले विशेषतः..
द्रष्टव्यो वै सुपर्णाख्यो देवः श्रद्धासमन्वितैः ..34..
5.82.m:
Therefore, by every effort, especially in the Kali age,
the god named Suparṇa should indeed be beheld by those endowed with faith.

5.82.s:
saṃtyājyāśca tathā prāṇāstadagreprāyasaṃśritaiḥ ..
vāṃchadbhiḥ śivasāṃnidhyaṃ satyametanmayoditam ... .. 35 ..
5.82.d:
संत्याज्याश्च तथा प्राणास्तदग्रेप्रायसंश्रितैः ..
वांछद्भिः शिवसांनिध्यं सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् ... .. 35 ..
5.82.m:
And likewise, life-breaths should be abandoned before him by those resorting to fasting unto death
who desire the presence of Śiva; this truth has been spoken by me.

5.82.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye suparṇeśvarākhyamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 82 .. .. cha ..
5.82.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सुपर्णेश्वराख्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्व्यशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 82 .. .. छ ..
5.82.m: Thus ends the eighty-second chapter, titled ‘Description of the Māhātmya Named Suparṇeśvara,’ in the Māhātmya of the Holy Hāṭakeśvara Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [book] in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.83.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tatrāścaryamabhūtpūrvaṃ yattadbrāhmaṇasattamāḥ ..
ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi purāṇe yadudāhṛtam .. 1 ..
5.83.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तत्राश्चर्यमभूत्पूर्वं यत्तद्ब्राह्मणसत्तमाः ..
अहं वः कीर्तयिष्यामि पुराणे यदुदाहृतम् .. 1 ..
5.83.m:
Sūta said:
“There occurred a wonder there formerly, which, O best of brahmins,
I will proclaim to you as it has been related in the Purāṇa.

5.83.s:
veṇurnāma mahīpālaḥ purāsītsūryavaṃśajaḥ ..
sadaiva pāpasaṃyukto durmedhāḥ kāmapīḍitaḥ .. 2 ..
5.83.d:
वेणुर्नाम महीपालः पुरासीत्सूर्यवंशजः ..
सदैव पापसंयुक्तो दुर्मेधाः कामपीडितः .. 2 ..
5.83.m:
Formerly there was a king named Veṇu, born in the Solar race,
always associated with sin, foolish, and tormented by lust.

5.83.s:
śāsanāni pradattāni brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām ..
anyaiḥ pārthivaśārdūlaistena tāni hṛtānyalam .. 3 ..
5.83.d:
शासनानि प्रदत्तानि ब्राह्मणानां महात्मनाम् ..
अन्यैः पार्थिवशार्दूलैस्तेन तानि हृतान्यलम् .. 3 ..
5.83.m:
Charters granted to great-souled brahmins
by other tiger-like monarchs were completely confiscated by him.

5.83.s:
vidhvaṃsitāḥ striyo naikā vidhavāśca viśeṣataḥ 4
kumāryo rūpavatyaśca tathā nija kulodbhavāḥ .. 4 ..
5.83.d:
विध्वंसिताः स्त्रियो नैका विधवाश्च विशेषतः 4
कुमार्यो रूपवत्यश्च तथा निज कुलोद्भवाः .. 4 ..
5.83.m:
Many women were violated, especially widows,
beautiful maidens, and even those born in his own family.

5.83.s:
devatārādhanaṃ pūjāṃ kartuṃ naiva dadāti saḥ ..
na ca yajñaṃ na homaṃ ca svādhyāyaṃ na ca pāpakṛt .. 5 ..
5.83.d:
देवताराधनं पूजां कर्तुं नैव ददाति सः ..
न च यज्ञं न होमं च स्वाध्यायं न च पापकृत् .. 5 ..
5.83.m:
He did not at all permit the worship and adoration of the deities to be performed,
nor sacrifice, nor oblations, nor Vedic recitation—that evildoer.

5.83.s:
provācātha janānsarvānmāṃ pūjayata sarvadā ..
na māmabhyadhiko'nyo'sti devo vā brāhmaṇo'pi vā .. 6 ..
5.83.d:
प्रोवाचाथ जनान्सर्वान्मां पूजयत सर्वदा ..
न मामभ्यधिकोऽन्योऽस्ति देवो वा ब्राह्मणोऽपि वा .. 6 ..
5.83.m:
Then he proclaimed to all the people: ‘Always worship me!
There is no one else greater than me, whether a god or a brahmin.

5.83.s:
mayā tuṣṭena sarveṣāṃ saṃpatsyati hṛdi sthitam ..
iha lokeṣvasaṃdigdhaṃ śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham .. 7 ..
5.83.d:
मया तुष्टेन सर्वेषां संपत्स्यति हृदि स्थितम् ..
इह लोकेष्वसंदिग्धं शुभं वा यदि वाऽशुभम् .. 7 ..
5.83.m:
When I am pleased, whatever is in the heart of all people
shall be accomplished in these worlds, without doubt, whether auspicious or inauspicious.’

5.83.s:
tena śastravihīnānāṃ viśvastānāṃ vadhaḥ kṛtaḥ ..
saṃtyaktāḥ śaraṇaṃ prāptāḥ puruṣā bhayavihvalāḥ .. 9 ..
naṣṭo mahāhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā śatrusaṃghānupasthitān ..
kṣātraṃ dharmaṃ parityajya prāṇarakṣārthameva hi .. 9 ..
5.83.d:
तेन शस्त्रविहीनानां विश्वस्तानां वधः कृतः ..
संत्यक्ताः शरणं प्राप्ताः पुरुषा भयविह्वलाः .. 9 ..
नष्टो महाहवं दृष्ट्वा शत्रुसंघानुपस्थितान् ..
क्षात्रं धर्मं परित्यज्य प्राणरक्षार्थमेव हि .. 9 ..
5.83.m:
By him was committed the slaughter of those who were unarmed and trusting;
men distraught with fear who had sought refuge were abandoned.
Having seen a great battle and hordes of enemies present, he fled,
having abandoned the duty of a kṣatriya, merely for the sake of saving his life.

5.83.s:
acaurāḥ pragṛhītāśca caurāḥ saṃrakṣitāḥ sadā ..
sādhavaḥ kleśitā nityaṃ teṣāṃ saṃharatā dhanam .. 6.83.10 ..
5.83.d:
अचौराः प्रगृहीताश्च चौराः संरक्षिताः सदा ..
साधवः क्लेशिता नित्यं तेषां संहरता धनम् .. 6.83.10 ..
5.83.m:
Those who were not thieves were arrested, while thieves were constantly protected;
the virtuous were always tormented as he seized their wealth.

5.83.s:
na kṛtaṃ ca vrataṃ tena śraddhāpūtena cetasā ..
na dattaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaśca na ca yaṣṭaṃ kadācana ... .. 11 ..
5.83.d:
न कृतं च व्रतं तेन श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा ..
न दत्तं ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च न च यष्टं कदाचन ... .. 11 ..
5.83.m:
No vow was observed by him with a heart purified by faith;
no gift was given to brahmins, nor did he ever sacrifice.

5.83.s:
evaṃ tasya narendrasya pāpāsaktasya nityaśaḥ ..
kuṣṭhavyādhirabhūdugro vaṃśocchedaśca saddvijāḥ .. 12 ..
5.83.d:
एवं तस्य नरेन्द्रस्य पापासक्तस्य नित्यशः ..
कुष्ठव्याधिरभूदुग्रो वंशोच्छेदश्च सद्द्विजाः .. 12 ..
5.83.m:
Thus, of that king who was constantly addicted to sin,
there arose a terrible disease of leprosy and the destruction of his lineage, O virtuous twice-born ones.

5.83.s:
tatastaṃ vyādhinā grastaṃ putrapautravivarjitam ..
dāyādāḥ sahasopetā rājyaṃ jahrustataḥ param .. 13 ..
5.83.d:
ततस्तं व्याधिना ग्रस्तं पुत्रपौत्रविवर्जितम् ..
दायादाः सहसोपेता राज्यं जह्रुस्ततः परम् .. 13 ..
5.83.m:
Then, as he was seized by disease and deprived of sons and grandsons,
his heirs suddenly arrived and thereafter took away the kingdom.

5.83.s:
taṃ ca nirvāsayāmāsustasmāddeśātpadātikam ..
ekākinaṃ parityaktaṃ sarvairapi suhṛdgaṇaiḥ .. 14 ..
5.83.d:
तं च निर्वासयामासुस्तस्माद्देशात्पदातिकम् ..
एकाकिनं परित्यक्तं सर्वैरपि सुहृद्गणैः .. 14 ..
5.83.m:
And they banished him on foot from that country,
alone, abandoned by all his circles of friends.

5.83.s:
so'pi sarvaiḥ parityaktastena pāpena karmaṇā ..
kalatrairapi cātmīyaiḥ smṛtvā pūrvaviceṣṭitam .. 15 ..
5.83.d:
सोऽपि सर्वैः परित्यक्तस्तेन पापेन कर्मणा ..
कलत्रैरपि चात्मीयैः स्मृत्वा पूर्वविचेष्टितम् .. 15 ..
5.83.m:
Even he, abandoned by all because of that sinful deed,
even by his own wives, remembered his past conduct.

5.83.s:
ekākī bhramamāṇo'tha so'pi kaṣṭavaśaṃ gataḥ ..
kṣuttṛṣṇāsupariśrāṃtaḥ kṣetre'traiva samāgataḥ .. 16 ..
5.83.d:
एकाकी भ्रममाणोऽथ सोऽपि कष्टवशं गतः ..
क्षुत्तृष्णासुपरिश्रांतः क्षेत्रेऽत्रैव समागतः .. 16 ..
5.83.m:
Wandering alone, having fallen under the power of distress,
utterly exhausted by hunger and thirst, he arrived at this very sacred field.

5.83.s:
tataḥ prāsādamāsādya suparṇākhyasamudbhavam ..
yāvatprāptaḥ parityaktastāva tprāṇairupoṣitaḥ .. 17 ..
5.83.d:
ततः प्रासादमासाद्य सुपर्णाख्यसमुद्भवम् ..
यावत्प्राप्तः परित्यक्तस्ताव त्प्राणैरुपोषितः .. 17 ..
5.83.m:
Then, having reached the temple belonging to the one named Suparṇa,
no sooner had he arrived than, fasting, he was deserted by his life-breaths.

5.83.s:
tato divyavapurbhūtvāvimānavaramāśritaḥ ..
jagāma śivalokaṃ sa durlabhaṃ dhārmikairapi .. 18 ..
5.83.d:
ततो दिव्यवपुर्भूत्वाविमानवरमाश्रितः ..
जगाम शिवलोकं स दुर्लभं धार्मिकैरपि .. 18 ..
5.83.m:
Then, having assumed a divine body, mounted upon an excellent aerial chariot,
he went to the world of Śiva, which is difficult to attain even by the righteous.

5.83.s:
sevyamānopsarobhiśca stūyamānaśca kinnaraiḥ ..
gīyamānaśca gandharvaiḥ śivapārśve vyavasthitaḥ .. 19 ..
5.83.d:
सेव्यमानोप्सरोभिश्च स्तूयमानश्च किन्नरैः ..
गीयमानश्च गन्धर्वैः शिवपार्श्वे व्यवस्थितः .. 19 ..
5.83.m:
Attended by apsarases, praised by kinnaras,
and sung of by gandharvas, he stood at the side of Śiva.

5.83.s:
atha taṃ saṃnidhau dṛṣṭvā gaurī papraccha sādaram..
ko'yaṃ deva samāyātaḥ sukṛtī tava mandire ..
anena kiṃ kṛtaṃ karma yatprāpto'tra vibhūtidhṛk .. 6.83.20 ..
5.83.d:
अथ तं संनिधौ दृष्ट्वा गौरी पप्रच्छ सादरम्..
कोऽयं देव समायातः सुकृती तव मन्दिरे ..
अनेन किं कृतं कर्म यत्प्राप्तोऽत्र विभूतिधृक् .. 6.83.20 ..
5.83.m:
Then, seeing him in his presence, Gaurī asked with respect:
‘Who is this virtuous person that has arrived in your temple, O Lord?
What deed was performed by him that he has arrived here bearing such glory?’

5.83.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
eṣa pāpasamācāraḥ sadā''sītpṛthivīpatiḥ ..
veṇusaṃjño dharāpṛṣṭhe kuṣṭhavyādhisamākulaḥ .. 21 ..
5.83.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
एष पापसमाचारः सदा'ऽसीत्पृथिवीपतिः ..
वेणुसंज्ञो धरापृष्ठे कुष्ठव्याधिसमाकुलः .. 21 ..
5.83.m:
The Lord said:
‘This one was constantly an earthly ruler of sinful conduct,
named Veṇu upon the surface of the earth, afflicted with the disease of leprosy.

5.83.s:
sa saṃtyakto nijairdāraiḥ śatruvargeṇa dharṣitaḥ ..
bhramamāṇaḥ samāyātaḥ suparṇākhyasya mandire .. 22 ..
5.83.d:
स संत्यक्तो निजैर्दारैः शत्रुवर्गेण धर्षितः ..
भ्रममाणः समायातः सुपर्णाख्यस्य मन्दिरे .. 22 ..
5.83.m:
Abandoned by his own wives, assaulted by the host of his enemies,
he arrived, while wandering, at the temple of the one named Suparṇa.

5.83.s:
upavāsapariśrāṃtaḥ sāṃnidhyaṃ mama yatra ca ..
sarvaprāṇaiḥ parityaktastasminnāyatane śubhe .. 23 ..
5.83.d:
उपवासपरिश्रांतः सांनिध्यं मम यत्र च ..
सर्वप्राणैः परित्यक्तस्तस्मिन्नायतने शुभे .. 23 ..
5.83.m:
Exhausted by fasting, in that auspicious sanctuary
where my presence is, he was abandoned by all his life-breaths.

5.83.s:
tatprabhāvādiha prāptaḥ satyametanmayoditam ..
anyo'pyanaśanaṃ kṛtvā prāṇānyastatra saṃtyajet .. 24 ..
5.83.d:
तत्प्रभावादिह प्राप्तः सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् ..
अन्योऽप्यनशनं कृत्वा प्राणान्यस्तत्र संत्यजेत् .. 24 ..
5.83.m:
By that power he has arrived here; this truth has been spoken by me.
Whoever else, having undertaken fasting, casts off his life-breaths there,

5.83.s:
sa sarvābhyadhikāṃ bhūtiṃ prāpnuyādvaravarṇini ..
yānetānvīkṣase devi gaṇānme pārśvasaṃsthitān .. 25 ..
5.83.d:
स सर्वाभ्यधिकां भूतिं प्राप्नुयाद्वरवर्णिनि ..
यानेतान्वीक्षसे देवि गणान्मे पार्श्वसंस्थितान् .. 25 ..
5.83.m:
he shall obtain glory surpassing all, O fair-complexioned lady!
These attendants of mine whom you behold standing at my side, O goddess—

5.83.s:
etaistatra kṛtaṃ sarvairdevi prāyopaveśanam ..
api kīṭapataṃgā ye paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo mṛgāḥ ..
prāsāde tatra nirmuktāḥ prāṇairyāṃti mamāṃtikam .. 26 ..
5.83.d:
एतैस्तत्र कृतं सर्वैर्देवि प्रायोपवेशनम् ..
अपि कीटपतंगा ये पशवः पक्षिणो मृगाः ..
प्रासादे तत्र निर्मुक्ताः प्राणैर्यांति ममांतिकम् .. 26 ..
5.83.m:
by all of these was fasting unto death performed there, O goddess.
Even worms, moths, beasts, birds, and deer,
when released from their life-breaths in that temple, come into my presence.’

5.83.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā pārvatī vākyaṃ proktaṃ devena śambhunā ..
vismayāviṣṭahṛdayā sādhu sādhviti sā'bravīt .. 27 ..
5.83.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा पार्वती वाक्यं प्रोक्तं देवेन शम्भुना ..
विस्मयाविष्टहृदया साधु साध्विति साऽब्रवीत् .. 27 ..
5.83.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that speech uttered by the god Śambhu, / Pārvatī, her heart filled with wonder, said, "Well done! Well done!"

5.83.s:
tataḥprabhṛti loke'tra puruṣā muktimicchavaḥ ..
dūrato'pi samabhyetya svānprāṇāṃstatra tatyajuḥ .. 28 ..
5.83.d:
ततःप्रभृति लोकेऽत्र पुरुषा मुक्तिमिच्छवः ..
दूरतोऽपि समभ्येत्य स्वान्प्राणांस्तत्र तत्यजुः .. 28 ..
5.83.m: From that time forward in this world, men desirous of liberation, / even having come from afar, gave up their lives there.

5.83.s:
prāyopaveśanaṃ kṛtvā śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ ..
gacchanti ca parāṃ siddhimapi pāpaparāyaṇāḥ .. 29 ..
5.83.d:
प्रायोपवेशनं कृत्वा श्रद्धया परया युताः ..
गच्छन्ति च परां सिद्धिमपि पापपरायणाः .. 29 ..
5.83.m: Having undertaken fasting unto death, filled with supreme faith, / even those intent on sin attain the highest perfection.

5.83.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam ..
suparṇākhyasya māhātmyaṃ yanmayā svapituḥ śrutam .. 6.83.30 ..
5.83.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..
सुपर्णाख्यस्य माहात्म्यं यन्मया स्वपितुः श्रुतम् .. 6.83.30 ..
5.83.m: All this, which destroys every sin, has been told to you— / the māhātmya of the [tīrtha] named Suparṇa, which I heard from my own father.

5.83.s: iti śrīskande mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye suparṇākhyamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 83 ..
5.83.d: इति श्रीस्कन्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सुपर्णाख्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्र्यशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 83 ..
5.83.m: Thus ends the eighty-third chapter, named 'Description of the Suparṇa Māhātmya', in the glorious Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field Māhātmya, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

5.84.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ devadevena viṣṇunā ..
mādhavīṃ bhaginīṃ prāpya janmāṃtaramupasthitām .. 1 ..
5.84.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
यदेतद्भवता प्रोक्तं देवदेवेन विष्णुना ..
माधवीं भगिनीं प्राप्य जन्मांतरमुपस्थिताम् .. 1 ..
5.84.m: The seers said: / That which was declared by you: by Viṣṇu, god of gods, / having found Mādhavī as his sister who had arrived in another birth,

5.84.s:
aśvavaktrāṃ kariṣyāmi tapasā suśubhānanām ..
sā kathaṃ vihitā tena tapastaptaṃ tathā katham ..
sarvaṃ vistarato brūhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ .. 2 ..
5.84.d:
अश्ववक्त्रां करिष्यामि तपसा सुशुभाननाम् ..
सा कथं विहिता तेन तपस्तप्तं तथा कथम् ..
सर्वं विस्तरतो ब्रूहि परं कौतूहलं हि नः .. 2 ..
5.84.m: "I will make her, who has a horse's face, possess a beautiful face through austerity"— / how was she made [so] by him, and how was the austerity performed? / Tell everything in detail, for our curiosity is indeed great.

5.84.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
nāradasya samākarṇya taṃ sandeśaṃ surodbhavam ..
gatvā viṣṇuḥ suraiḥ sārddhaṃ pracakre maṃtraniścayam .. 3 ..
5.84.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
नारदस्य समाकर्ण्य तं सन्देशं सुरोद्भवम् ..
गत्वा विष्णुः सुरैः सार्द्धं प्रचक्रे मंत्रनिश्चयम् .. 3 ..
5.84.m: Sūta said: / Having heard that message of Nārada originating from the gods, / Viṣṇu, having gone together with the gods, made a firm deliberation in counsel.

5.84.s:
bhārāvataraṇārthāya dānavānāṃ vadhāya ca ..
vasudevagṛhe śrīmāndvāparāṃte tato hariḥ .. 4 ..
5.84.d:
भारावतरणार्थाय दानवानां वधाय च ..
वसुदेवगृहे श्रीमान्द्वापरांते ततो हरिः .. 4 ..
5.84.m: In order to relieve the burden [of the earth] and to slay the Dānavas, / the glorious Hari then, at the end of the Dvāpara [yuga], in the house of Vasudeva,

5.84.s:
devakyā jaṭhare devaḥ saṃjāto daityadarpahā ..
tathānyā rohiṇīnāma bhāryā tasya ca yā'bhavat .. 5 ..
5.84.d:
देवक्या जठरे देवः संजातो दैत्यदर्पहा ..
तथान्या रोहिणीनाम भार्या तस्य च याऽभवत् .. 5 ..
5.84.m: the god who destroys the arrogance of the Daityas, was born in the womb of Devakī. / Likewise, another wife whom he had was named Rohiṇī;

5.84.s:
tasyāṃ jajñe halīnāma balabhadraḥ pratāpavān ..
tṛtīyā suprabhānāma vasudevapriyā ca yā .. 6 ..
5.84.d:
तस्यां जज्ञे हलीनाम बलभद्रः प्रतापवान् ..
तृतीया सुप्रभानाम वसुदेवप्रिया च या .. 6 ..
5.84.m: in her was born the plow-wielder named Balabhadra, endowed with majesty. / And a third, who was the beloved of Vasudeva, was named Suprabhā;

5.84.s:
tasyāṃ sā mādhavī jajñe aśvavaktrasvarūpadhṛk ..
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vikṛtākārāṃ sutāṃ jātāṃ ca suprabhā ..
vāsudevasamāyuktā viṣādaṃ paramaṃ gatā .. 7 ..
5.84.d:
तस्यां सा माधवी जज्ञे अश्ववक्त्रस्वरूपधृक् ..
तां दृष्ट्वा विकृताकारां सुतां जातां च सुप्रभा ..
वासुदेवसमायुक्ता विषादं परमं गता .. 7 ..
5.84.m: in her was born that Mādhavī, possessing the form of a horse-faced one. / Seeing that daughter born with a deformed appearance, Suprabhā, / together with Vasudeva, fell into the deepest sorrow.

5.84.s:
atha te yādavāḥ sarve kṛtaśāntikapauṣṭikāḥ ..
svastisvastīti saṃtrastāḥ procurbhūyātkule'tra naḥ ..8..
5.84.d:
अथ ते यादवाः सर्वे कृतशान्तिकपौष्टिकाः ..
स्वस्तिस्वस्तीति संत्रस्ताः प्रोचुर्भूयात्कुलेऽत्र नः ..8..
5.84.m: Then all those Yādavas, having performed rites of pacification and nourishment, / terrified, said, "May there be well-being, well-being in our family!"

5.84.s:
evaṃ sā yauvanopetā tathā duḥkhasamanvitā ..
na kaścidvarayāmāsa vājivaktrāṃ vilokya tām .. 9 ..
5.84.d:
एवं सा यौवनोपेता तथा दुःखसमन्विता ..
न कश्चिद्वरयामास वाजिवक्त्रां विलोक्य ताम् .. 9 ..
5.84.m: Thus she attained youth, and likewise was accompanied by sorrow; / seeing that horse-faced woman, no one chose her [in marriage].

5.84.s:
tataśca bhagavānviṣṇurjñātvā tāṃ bhaginīṃ tathā ..
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ caiva tathā duḥkhasamanvitau .. 6.84.10 ..
5.84.d:
ततश्च भगवान्विष्णुर्ज्ञात्वा तां भगिनीं तथा ..
मातरं पितरं चैव तथा दुःखसमन्वितौ .. 6.84.10 ..
5.84.m: And then, Lord Viṣṇu, knowing that sister to be so, / and likewise his mother and father to be accompanied by sorrow,

5.84.s:
tāmādāya gatastūrṇaṃ baladevasamanvitaḥ ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre tapastaptuṃ tataḥ param .. 11 ..
5.84.d:
तामादाय गतस्तूर्णं बलदेवसमन्वितः ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे तपस्तप्तुं ततः परम् .. 11 ..
5.84.m: taking her, went swiftly, accompanied by Baladeva, / to the sacred field born of Hāṭakeśvara, in order to perform supreme austerity thereafter.

5.84.s:
brahmāṇaṃ toṣayāmāsa samyagyajñaparāyaṇaḥ ..
vrataiśca vividhairdānairbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ .. 12 ..
5.84.d:
ब्रह्माणं तोषयामास सम्यग्यज्ञपरायणः ..
व्रतैश्च विविधैर्दानैर्ब्राह्मणानां च तर्पणैः .. 12 ..
5.84.m: Devoted completely to sacrifices, he pleased Brahmā / by various vows, gifts, and offerings to satisfy brahmins.

5.84.s:
tatastuṣṭiṃ gato brahmā varṣāṃte tasya śārṅgiṇaḥ ..
uvāca varado'smīti prārthayasvābhivāṃchitam .. 13 ..
5.84.d:
ततस्तुष्टिं गतो ब्रह्मा वर्षांते तस्य शार्ङ्गिणः ..
उवाच वरदोऽस्मीति प्रार्थयस्वाभिवांछितम् .. 13 ..
5.84.m: Then, at the end of a year, Brahmā attained satisfaction with that wielder of the Śārṅga bow, / and said, "I am a giver of boons; ask for what is desired."

5.84.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
eṣā me bhaginī deva jātā'śvavadanā kila ..
tava prasādātsadvaktrā bhūyādetanmamepsitam .. 14 ..
5.84.d:
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
एषा मे भगिनी देव जाताऽश्ववदना किल ..
तव प्रसादात्सद्वक्त्रा भूयादेतन्ममेप्सितम् .. 14 ..
5.84.m: Viṣṇu said: / "O god, this sister of mine was indeed born with a horse's face; / by your grace may she become one with a beautiful face; this is my wish."

5.84.s:
.. śrībrahmovāca .. ..
eṣā śubhānanā sādhvī matprasādādbhaviṣyati ..
subhadrā nāma vikhyātā vīrasūḥ pativallabhā .. 15 ..
5.84.d:
.. श्रीब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
एषा शुभानना साध्वी मत्प्रसादाद्भविष्यति ..
सुभद्रा नाम विख्याता वीरसूः पतिवल्लभा .. 15 ..
5.84.m: Glorious Brahmā said: / "This virtuous woman will become beautiful-faced by my grace, / renowned by the name Subhadrā, the mother of a hero, beloved to her husband.

5.84.s:
etadrūpāṃ pumānyo'tra pūjayiṣyati bhaktitaḥ ..
etāṃ viṣṇo tvayā sārdhaṃ tathānena ca sīriṇā .. 16 ..
5.84.d:
एतद्रूपां पुमान्योऽत्र पूजयिष्यति भक्तितः ..
एतां विष्णो त्वया सार्धं तथानेन च सीरिणा .. 16 ..
5.84.m: Whatever person will worship her here in this form with devotion— / her, O Viṣṇu, together with you, and likewise with this plow-wielder—

5.84.s:
dvādaśyāṃ māghamāsasya gaṃdhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ ..
so'pyavāpsyati yaccitte vartate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 17 ..
5.84.d:
द्वादश्यां माघमासस्य गंधपुष्पानुलेपनैः ..
सोऽप्यवाप्स्यति यच्चित्ते वर्तते नात्र संशयः .. 17 ..
5.84.m: on the twelfth day of the month of Māgha, with fragrant substances, flowers, and unguents, / he too shall obtain whatever is in his heart, there is no doubt in this.

5.84.s:
yā nārī patinā tyaktā vaṃdhyā vā bhaktisaṃyutā ..
tṛtīyādivase caitāṃ pūjayiṣyati keśava .. 18 ..
5.84.d:
या नारी पतिना त्यक्ता वंध्या वा भक्तिसंयुता ..
तृतीयादिवसे चैतां पूजयिष्यति केशव .. 18 ..
5.84.m: Whatever woman, abandoned by her husband or barren, endowed with devotion, / will worship her on the third day, O Keśava,

5.84.s:
