bhaviṣyati suputrāḍhyā subhagā sā sukhānvitā ..
aiśvaryasahitā nityaṃ sarvaiḥ samuditā guṇaiḥ .. 19 ..
5.84.d:
भविष्यति सुपुत्राढ्या सुभगा सा सुखान्विता ..
ऐश्वर्यसहिता नित्यं सर्वैः समुदिता गुणैः .. 19 ..
5.84.m: she will become endowed with good sons, fortunate, happy, / always accompanied by sovereignty, and rich in all virtues."

5.84.s:
evamuktvā caturvaktro virarāma tataḥ param ..
vāsudevo'pi hṛṣṭātmā yayau dvāravatīṃ purīm .. 6.84.20 ..
5.84.d:
एवमुक्त्वा चतुर्वक्त्रो विरराम ततः परम् ..
वासुदेवोऽपि हृष्टात्मा ययौ द्वारवतीं पुरीम् .. 6.84.20 ..
5.84.m: Having spoken thus, the four-faced one ceased thereafter. / Vāsudeva too, with a joyful soul, went to the city of Dvāravatī,

5.84.s:
tāmādāya viśālākṣīṃ caṃdrabiṃbasamānanām ..
baladevasamāyukto hyanujñāpya pitāma ham.. 21 ..
5.84.d:
तामादाय विशालाक्षीं चंद्रबिंबसमाननाम् ..
बलदेवसमायुक्तो ह्यनुज्ञाप्य पिताम हम्.. 21 ..
5.84.m: taking that large-eyed woman whose face was like the orb of the moon, / accompanied by Baladeva, having taken leave of the grandfather [Brahmā].

5.84.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ sā mādhavī viprāḥ subhagārūpamāsthitā ..
avatīrṇā dharāpṛṣṭhe lakṣmīśāpaprapīḍitā .. 22 ..
5.84.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं सा माधवी विप्राः सुभगारूपमास्थिता ..
अवतीर्णा धरापृष्ठे लक्ष्मीशापप्रपीडिता .. 22 ..
5.84.m: Sūta said: / Thus, O brahmins, that Mādhavī, having assumed an auspicious form, / descended upon the surface of the earth, afflicted by the curse of Lakṣmī.

5.84.s:
upayeme sutaḥ pāṃḍoryāṃ pārthaścāruhāsinīm ..
jajñe tasyāḥ suto vīro'bhimanyuriti viśrutaḥ .. 23 ..
5.84.d:
उपयेमे सुतः पांडोर्यां पार्थश्चारुहासिनीम् ..
जज्ञे तस्याः सुतो वीरोऽभिमन्युरिति विश्रुतः .. 23 ..
5.84.m: The son of Pāṇḍu, Pārtha, married her who had a charming smile; / to her was born a heroic son renowned as Abhimanyu.

5.84.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ mādhabījanmasambhavam ..
suparṇākhyasya devasya kathāsaṃgāddvijottamāḥ .. 24 ..
5.84.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं माधबीजन्मसम्भवम् ..
सुपर्णाख्यस्य देवस्य कथासंगाद्द्विजोत्तमाः .. 24 ..
5.84.m: All this regarding the birth of Mādhavī has been told to you, / O best of brahmins, in connection with the story of the god named Suparṇa.

5.84.s:
yaścaitatpaṭhate martyo bhaktyā yuktaḥ śṛṇoti vā ..
mucyate sa naraḥ pāpāttaddinaikasamudbhavāt .. 25..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye suparṇākhyatīrthamāhātmye mādhavyā aśvamukhyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇatapaścaryayā padmādattaśāpavimuktipūrvaka subhadrātvaprāptivarṇanaṃnāma caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 84 .. .. cha ..
5.84.d:
यश्चैतत्पठते मर्त्यो भक्त्या युक्तः शृणोति वा ..
मुच्यते स नरः पापात्तद्दिनैकसमुद्भवात् .. 25..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सुपर्णाख्यतीर्थमाहात्म्ये माधव्या अश्वमुख्याः श्रीकृष्णतपश्चर्यया पद्मादत्तशापविमुक्तिपूर्वक सुभद्रात्वप्राप्तिवर्णनंनाम चतुरशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 84 .. .. छ ..
5.84.m: And whatever mortal recites this or hears it endowed with devotion, / that man is freed from the sin arising on that one day. / Thus ends the eighty-fourth chapter, named 'Description of the Attainment of the State of Subhadrā after Liberation from the Curse Given by Padmā through the Practice of Austerity by Śrī Kṛṣṇa for Mādhavī the Horse-Faced One', in the Suparṇākhyatīrtha Māhātmya, in the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field Māhātmya, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

5.85.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
mādhavyāḥ padmayā datto yaḥ śāpastasya yatphalam ..
pariṇāmodbhavaṃ sarvaṃ śrutamasmābhiradya tat .. 1 ..
5.85.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
माधव्याः पद्मया दत्तो यः शापस्तस्य यत्फलम् ..
परिणामोद्भवं सर्वं श्रुतमस्माभिरद्य तत् .. 1 ..
5.85.m: The seers said: / That which was the curse given to Mādhavī by Padmā, and whatever result of it / arose from the outcome—all that has been heard by us today.

5.85.s:
tena yatkamalā śaptā brāhmaṇena mahātmanā ..
sā kathaṃ gaja vaktrā'tha punarjātā śubhānanā .. 2 ..
5.85.d:
तेन यत्कमला शप्ता ब्राह्मणेन महात्मना ..
सा कथं गज वक्त्राऽथ पुनर्जाता शुभानना .. 2 ..
5.85.m: In that Kamalā was cursed by that great-souled brahmin, / how did she, having an elephant's face, then become beautiful-faced again?

5.85.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
śāpena tasya viprasya tatkṣaṇādeva sā dvijāḥ ..
gajavaktrā samutpannā mahāvismayakāriṇī .. 3 ..
5.85.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
शापेन तस्य विप्रस्य तत्क्षणादेव सा द्विजाः ..
गजवक्त्रा समुत्पन्ना महाविस्मयकारिणी .. 3 ..
5.85.m: Sūta said: / By the curse of that brahmin, O brahmins, at that very moment / she arose with an elephant's face, causing great astonishment.

5.85.s:
sā proktā hariṇā tiṣṭha kiñcitkālāṃtare śubhe ..
anenaiva tu rūpeṇa yāvatsyāddvāparakṣayaḥ .. 4 ..
5.85.d:
सा प्रोक्ता हरिणा तिष्ठ किञ्चित्कालांतरे शुभे ..
अनेनैव तु रूपेण यावत्स्याद्द्वापरक्षयः .. 4 ..
5.85.m: She was told by Hari: "Remain for some time, O auspicious one, / in this very form, until the end of the Dvāpara [yuga] occurs.

5.85.s:
tato'haṃ medinīpṛṣṭhe hyavatīrya samudraje ..
tapaḥ śaktyā kariṣyāmi bhūyastvāṃ tu śubhānanām .. 5 ..
5.85.d:
ततोऽहं मेदिनीपृष्ठे ह्यवतीर्य समुद्रजे ..
तपः शक्त्या करिष्यामि भूयस्त्वां तु शुभाननाम् .. 5 ..
5.85.m: Then, having descended to the surface of the earth, O daughter of the ocean, / I will make you beautiful-faced again through the power of austerity."

5.85.s:
avajñāyātha sā tasya tadvākyaṃ śārṅgadhanvinaḥ ..
śubhāsyatvakṛte tepe tapastīvraṃ suharṣitā.. .. 6..
5.85.d:
अवज्ञायाथ सा तस्य तद्वाक्यं शार्ङ्गधन्विनः ..
शुभास्यत्वकृते तेपे तपस्तीव्रं सुहर्षिता.. .. 6..
5.85.m: Then, disregarding that speech of the wielder of the Śārṅga bow, / she performed severe austerity, highly delighted, for the sake of having a beautiful face.

5.85.s:
etatkṣetraṃ samāsādya trikālaṃ snānamācarat..
brahmāṇaṃ toṣayāmāsa divārātrimataṃdritā.. 7..
5.85.d:
एतत्क्षेत्रं समासाद्य त्रिकालं स्नानमाचरत्..
ब्रह्माणं तोषयामास दिवारात्रिमतंद्रिता.. 7..
5.85.m: Having reached this sacred field, she performed ritual ablution at the three divisions of the day; / unwearied day and night, she pleased Brahmā.

5.85.s:
tāmuvāca tato brahmā varṣāṃte tuṣṭimāgataḥ ..
varaṃ prārthaya tuṣṭo'haṃ tava keśavavallabhe .. 8 ..
5.85.d:
तामुवाच ततो ब्रह्मा वर्षांते तुष्टिमागतः ..
वरं प्रार्थय तुष्टोऽहं तव केशववल्लभे .. 8 ..
5.85.m: Then, at the end of a year, Brahmā, having attained satisfaction, said to her: / "Ask for a boon; I am pleased with you, O beloved of Keśava!"

5.85.s:
.. lakṣmīruvāca .. ..
gajāsyāhaṃ kṛtā deva śāpaṃ dattvā sudāruṇam ..
brāhmaṇena sukruddhena kasmiścitkāraṇāṃtare ..9..
5.85.d:
.. लक्ष्मीरुवाच .. ..
गजास्याहं कृता देव शापं दत्त्वा सुदारुणम् ..
ब्राह्मणेन सुक्रुद्धेन कस्मिश्चित्कारणांतरे ..9..
5.85.m: Lakṣmī said: / "O Lord, I was given an elephant's face by an enraged brahmin / who uttered a terrible curse upon me for a certain reason.

5.85.s:
tasmāttadrūpiṇīṃ bhūyo māṃ kuruṣva pitāmaha ..
yadi me tuṣṭimāpanno nānyatkiṃcidvṛṇomyaham .. 6.85.10 ..
5.85.d:
तस्मात्तद्रूपिणीं भूयो मां कुरुष्व पितामह ..
यदि मे तुष्टिमापन्नो नान्यत्किंचिद्वृणोम्यहम् .. 6.85.10 ..
5.85.m: Therefore, O Grandfather, make me possess my original form once more. / If you are pleased with me, I choose nothing else."

5.85.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
bhaviṣyati śubhaṃ vaktraṃ matprasādādasaṃśayam ..
tava bhadre viśeṣeṇa tasmāttvaṃ svagṛhaṃ vraja .. 11 ..
5.85.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
भविष्यति शुभं वक्त्रं मत्प्रसादादसंशयम् ..
तव भद्रे विशेषेण तस्मात्त्वं स्वगृहं व्रज .. 11 ..
5.85.m: Brahmā said: / "By my grace your face shall undoubtedly become auspicious, / especially for you, O blessed one; therefore go to your home.

5.85.s:
mahattvaṃ te mayā dattamadyaprabhṛti śobhane ..
mahālakṣmīti te nāma tasmādatra bhaviṣyati .. 12 ..
5.85.d:
महत्त्वं ते मया दत्तमद्यप्रभृति शोभने ..
महालक्ष्मीति ते नाम तस्मादत्र भविष्यति .. 12 ..
5.85.m: Greatness has been granted to you by me from this day forth, O fair one; / therefore your name here shall be Mahālakṣmī.

5.85.s:
gajavaktrāṃ naro yastvāṃ pūjayiṣyati bhaktitaḥ ..
sa gajādhipatirbhūpo bhaviṣyati ca bhūtale .. 13 ..
5.85.d:
गजवक्त्रां नरो यस्त्वां पूजयिष्यति भक्तितः ..
स गजाधिपतिर्भूपो भविष्यति च भूतले .. 13 ..
5.85.m: The man who worships you with devotion while you have an elephant's face / will become a king, a lord of elephants, upon the surface of the earth.

5.85.s:
dvitīyādivase yastvāṃ mahālakṣmīriti bruvan ..
śrīsūktena subhaktyā'tha devi saṃpūjayiṣyati .. 14 ..
5.85.d:
द्वितीयादिवसे यस्त्वां महालक्ष्मीरिति ब्रुवन् ..
श्रीसूक्तेन सुभक्त्याऽथ देवि संपूजयिष्यति .. 14 ..
5.85.m: The one who worships you on the second day [of the lunar fortnight], addressing you as 'Mahālakṣmī', / with the Śrīsūkta and with pure devotion, O goddess,

5.85.s:
saptajanmāṃtarāṇyeva na bhaviṣyati so'dhanaḥ..
evamuktvā caturvaktro virarāma tataḥ param.. 15 ..
5.85.d:
सप्तजन्मांतराण्येव न भविष्यति सोऽधनः..
एवमुक्त्वा चतुर्वक्त्रो विरराम ततः परम्.. 15 ..
5.85.m: shall never be impoverished for seven successive births." / Having spoken thus, the four-faced one then ceased.

5.85.s: sā'pi hṛṣṭā gatā devī yatra tiṣṭhati keśavaḥ .. 16 ..
5.85.d: साऽपि हृष्टा गता देवी यत्र तिष्ठति केशवः .. 16 ..
5.85.m: Delighted, the goddess also went to where Keśava stayed.

5.85.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgara khaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye mahālakṣmīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ.. 85 ..cha..
5.85.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागर खण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये महालक्ष्मीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चाशीतितमोऽध्यायः.. 85 ..छ..
5.85.m: Thus ends the eighty-fifth chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of Mahālakṣmī', in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] in the Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

5.86.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
athānyāpi ca tatrāsti saptaviṃśatikā tathā ..
nakṣatraiḥ sthāpitā devī vāṃchitasya pradāyinī .. 1 ..
5.86.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथान्यापि च तत्रास्ति सप्तविंशतिका तथा ..
नक्षत्रैः स्थापिता देवी वांछितस्य प्रदायिनी .. 1 ..
5.86.m: Sūta said: / Now, there is also another [goddess] there, named Saptaviṃśatikā, / installed by the lunar mansions, the giver of what is desired.

5.86.s:
dakṣasya tanayā pūrvaṃ saptaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā ..
udvāhitā hi somena pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇasattamāḥ .. 2 ..
5.86.d:
दक्षस्य तनया पूर्वं सप्तविंशतिसंख्यया ..
उद्वाहिता हि सोमेन पूर्वं ब्राह्मणसत्तमाः .. 2 ..
5.86.m: Formerly, the daughters of Dakṣa, twenty-seven in number, / were married to Soma, O best of brahmins.

5.86.s:
tāsāṃ madhye 'bhavaccaikā rohiṇī tasya vallabhā ..
prāṇebhyo'pi sadāsaktastayā sārdhaṃ sa tiṣṭhati .. 3 ..
5.86.d:
तासां मध्ये ऽभवच्चैका रोहिणी तस्य वल्लभा ..
प्राणेभ्योऽपि सदासक्तस्तया सार्धं स तिष्ठति .. 3 ..
5.86.m: Among them, Rohiṇī alone was his beloved, / dearer to him than his own life; he remained constantly attached to her.

5.86.s:
tato daurbhāgyasaṃtaptāḥ sarvā stā dakṣakanyakāḥ ..
vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gatvā kṣetre'smiṃstapasi sthitāḥ .. 4 ..
5.86.d:
ततो दौर्भाग्यसंतप्ताः सर्वा स्ता दक्षकन्यकाः ..
वैराग्यं परमं गत्वा क्षेत्रेऽस्मिंस्तपसि स्थिताः .. 4 ..
5.86.m: Then, distressed by their misfortune, all those daughters of Dakṣa / attained extreme detachment and engaged in austerity in this sacred field.

5.86.s:
saṃsthāpya devatāṃ durgāṃ śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ ..
balipūjopahāraistāṃ pūjayaṃtyaḥ sureśvarīm .. 5 ..
5.86.d:
संस्थाप्य देवतां दुर्गां श्रद्धया परया युताः ..
बलिपूजोपहारैस्तां पूजयंत्यः सुरेश्वरीम् .. 5 ..
5.86.m: Having installed the goddess Durgā, endowed with supreme faith, / they worshipped that ruler of the gods with animal offerings, rites, and gifts.

5.86.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā tāsāṃ sā tuṣṭimabhyagāt ..
abravīcca pratuṣṭo'haṃ varaṃ dāsyāmi putrikāḥ .. 6 ..
5.86.d:
ततः कालेन महता तासां सा तुष्टिमभ्यगात् ..
अब्रवीच्च प्रतुष्टोऽहं वरं दास्यामि पुत्रिकाः .. 6 ..
5.86.m: Then, after a great deal of time, she was pleased with them, / and said: "I am highly pleased; I will grant a boon, O daughters!

5.86.s:
tasmāttatprārthyatāṃ citte yadyuṣmākaṃ vyavasthitam ..
sarvaṃ dāsyāmyasaṃdigdhaṃ yadyuṣmākaṃ hṛdi sthitam .. 7 ..
5.86.d:
तस्मात्तत्प्रार्थ्यतां चित्ते यद्युष्माकं व्यवस्थितम् ..
सर्वं दास्याम्यसंदिग्धं यद्युष्माकं हृदि स्थितम् .. 7 ..
5.86.m: Therefore, ask for whatever is in your mind; / I shall grant without a doubt whatever is established in your heart."

5.86.s:
tataḥ procuśca tāḥ sarvāḥ prasādāttava vāṃchitam ..
asmākaṃ vidyate devi yāvattrailokyasaṃsthitam .. 8 ..
5.86.d:
ततः प्रोचुश्च ताः सर्वाः प्रसादात्तव वांछितम् ..
अस्माकं विद्यते देवि यावत्त्रैलोक्यसंस्थितम् .. 8 ..
5.86.m: Then all of them said: "By your favor, O goddess, / we have everything desired that exists in the three worlds,

5.86.s:
ekaṃ patyuḥ sukhaṃ muktvā yatsaubhāgyasamudbhavam ..
tasmāttaddehi cāsmākaṃ yadi tuṣṭāsi caṃḍike .. 9 ..
5.86.d:
एकं पत्युः सुखं मुक्त्वा यत्सौभाग्यसमुद्भवम् ..
तस्मात्तद्देहि चास्माकं यदि तुष्टासि चंडिके .. 9 ..
5.86.m: except for the single happiness of a husband which arises from good fortune in marriage. / Therefore grant that to us, if you are pleased, O Caṇḍikā.

5.86.s:
vayaṃ daurbhāgyadoṣeṇa sarvāḥ kleśaṃ paraṃ gatāḥ ..
na śaknumaḥ priyānprāṇāndehe dhartuṃ kathaṃcana .. 6.86.10 ..
5.86.d:
वयं दौर्भाग्यदोषेण सर्वाः क्लेशं परं गताः ..
न शक्नुमः प्रियान्प्राणान्देहे धर्तुं कथंचन .. 6.86.10 ..
5.86.m: Owing to the fault of misfortune in love, we have all fallen into supreme misery; / we are unable to preserve our dear breath in our bodies by any means."

5.86.s:
.. śrīdevyuvāca .. ..
adyaprabhṛti yuṣmākaṃ saubhāgyaṃ patisaṃbhavam..
matprasādādasaṃdigdhaṃ bhaviṣyati sukhodayam.. 11 ..
5.86.d:
.. श्रीदेव्युवाच .. ..
अद्यप्रभृति युष्माकं सौभाग्यं पतिसंभवम्..
मत्प्रसादादसंदिग्धं भविष्यति सुखोदयम्.. 11 ..
5.86.m: The goddess said: / "From this day forward, by my grace, the good fortune / derived from a husband and bringing joy will undoubtedly be yours.

5.86.s:
anyāpi yā patityaktā strī māmatra sthitāṃ sadā ..
pūjayiṣyati sadbhaktayā caturdaśyāmupoṣitā .. 12 ..
5.86.d:
अन्यापि या पतित्यक्ता स्त्री मामत्र स्थितां सदा ..
पूजयिष्यति सद्भक्तया चतुर्दश्यामुपोषिता .. 12 ..
5.86.m: Any other woman abandoned by her husband who worships me residing here always, / with true devotion, having fasted on the fourteenth day,

5.86.s:
sā bhaviṣyati saubhāgyayuktā putravatī satī ..
yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ tāvadekabhaktaparāyaṇā .. 13 ..
5.86.d:
सा भविष्यति सौभाग्ययुक्ता पुत्रवती सती ..
यावत्संवत्सरं तावदेकभक्तपरायणा .. 13 ..
5.86.m: shall be endowed with good fortune, virtuous, and blessed with sons, / if she remains devoted to eating only one meal a day for a year.

5.86.s:
akṣāralavaṇāśā yā nārī māṃ pūjayiṣyati ..
na tasyāḥ patijaṃ duḥkhaṃ daurbhāgyaṃ vā bhaviṣyati .. 14 ..
5.86.d:
अक्षारलवणाशा या नारी मां पूजयिष्यति ..
न तस्याः पतिजं दुःखं दौर्भाग्यं वा भविष्यति .. 14 ..
5.86.m: The woman who worships me eating food without alkaline substances or salt / shall have no sorrow caused by her husband, nor misfortune.

5.86.s:
āśvinasya site pakṣe saṃprāpte navamīdine ..
upavāsaparā yā māṃ niśīthe pūjayiṣyati ..
tasyāḥ saubhāgyamatyugraṃ sarvadā vai bhaviṣyati .. 15 ..
5.86.d:
आश्विनस्य सिते पक्षे संप्राप्ते नवमीदिने ..
उपवासपरा या मां निशीथे पूजयिष्यति ..
तस्याः सौभाग्यमत्युग्रं सर्वदा वै भविष्यति .. 15 ..
5.86.m: When the ninth day arrives in the bright fortnight of Āśvina, / she who, intent on fasting, worships me at midnight / shall certainly have immense good fortune for all time."

5.86.s:
evamuktvā tu sā devī virarāma dvijottamāḥ ..
tāśca sarvāḥ susaṃhṛṣṭā jagmurdakṣasya maṃdiram.. 16 ..
5.86.d:
एवमुक्त्वा तु सा देवी विरराम द्विजोत्तमाः ..
ताश्च सर्वाः सुसंहृष्टा जग्मुर्दक्षस्य मंदिरम्.. 16 ..
5.86.m: Having spoken thus, O best of the twice-born, the goddess fell silent; / and all of them, extremely delighted, went to Dakṣa's house.

5.86.s:
etasminnaṃtare dakṣa āhūtaḥ śūlapāṇinā ..
proktaḥ kasmāttvayā candro yakṣmaṇā saṃniyojitaḥ ..
tadayuktaṃ kṛtaṃ dakṣa jāmātā'yaṃ yatastava .. 17 ..
5.86.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे दक्ष आहूतः शूलपाणिना ..
प्रोक्तः कस्मात्त्वया चन्द्रो यक्ष्मणा संनियोजितः ..
तदयुक्तं कृतं दक्ष जामाताऽयं यतस्तव .. 17 ..
5.86.m: In the meantime, Dakṣa was summoned by the trident-bearer / and asked: "Why have you afflicted Candra with consumption? / That was an improper act done by you, O Dakṣa, since he is your son-in-law."

5.86.s:
.. dakṣa uvāca .. ..
anena tanayā mahyamaṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyayā ..
ūḍhā akhaṇḍacāritrāstāstyaktā doṣavarjitāḥ ..
muktvaikāṃ rohiṇīṃ deva niṣiddhena mayā'sakṛt .. 18 ..
5.86.d:
.. दक्ष उवाच .. ..
अनेन तनया मह्यमष्टाविंशतिसंख्यया ..
ऊढा अखण्डचारित्रास्तास्त्यक्ता दोषवर्जिताः ..
मुक्त्वैकां रोहिणीं देव निषिद्धेन मयाऽसकृत् .. 18 ..
5.86.m: Dakṣa said: / "He married my daughters, twenty-eight in number, / women of unbroken conduct; but he abandoned those faultless ones, / except for Rohiṇī alone, O God, though repeatedly forbidden by me.

5.86.s:
tato mayā'tikopena niyukto rājayakṣmaṇā ..
asatyajalpako mandaḥ kāmadevavaśaṃ gataḥ .. 19 ..
5.86.d:
ततो मयाऽतिकोपेन नियुक्तो राजयक्ष्मणा ..
असत्यजल्पको मन्दः कामदेववशं गतः .. 19 ..
5.86.m: Therefore, in intense anger, I afflicted him with pulmonary consumption, / as he was a speaker of untruth, a fool subjugated by Kāmadeva."

5.86.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
adyaprabhṛti sarvāsāṃ samaṃ sa pracariṣyati ..
madvākyānnātra saṃdehaḥ satyametanmayoditam.. 6.86.20 ..
5.86.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
अद्यप्रभृति सर्वासां समं स प्रचरिष्यति ..
मद्वाक्यान्नात्र संदेहः सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम्.. 6.86.20 ..
5.86.m: The blessed Lord said: / "From this day forward he will treat all of them equally, / on my word; of this there is no doubt; this truth has been spoken by me.

5.86.s:
tvayāpi yadvacaḥ proktamasatyaṃ syānna tatkvacit ..
tasmādeṣa kṣayaṃ pakṣaṃ vṛddhiṃ pakṣaṃ prayāsyati .. 21 ..
5.86.d:
त्वयापि यद्वचः प्रोक्तमसत्यं स्यान्न तत्क्वचित् ..
तस्मादेष क्षयं पक्षं वृद्धिं पक्षं प्रयास्यति .. 21 ..
5.86.m: Even so, the word spoken by you should never become untrue anywhere; / therefore he shall undergo waning for one fortnight, and waxing for one fortnight."

5.86.s:
dakṣo'pi bāḍhamityeva tatproktvā ca yayau gṛham ..
caṃdrastu dakṣakanyāstāḥ samaṃ paśyati sarvadā .. 22 ..
5.86.d:
दक्षोऽपि बाढमित्येव तत्प्रोक्त्वा च ययौ गृहम् ..
चंद्रस्तु दक्षकन्यास्ताः समं पश्यति सर्वदा .. 22 ..
5.86.m: Dakṣa also said, "So be it," and having spoken that, went home. / Candra, however, treats those daughters of Dakṣa equally at all times,

5.86.s:
gacchamānaḥ kṣayaṃ pakṣaṃ vṛddhiṃ pakṣaṃ ca saddvijāḥ ..
sāpi devī tataḥ proktā saptaviṃśatikā kṣitau ..
sarvasaubhāgyadā strīṇāṃ tasminkṣetre vyavasthitā .. 23 ..
5.86.d:
गच्छमानः क्षयं पक्षं वृद्धिं पक्षं च सद्द्विजाः ..
सापि देवी ततः प्रोक्ता सप्तविंशतिका क्षितौ ..
सर्वसौभाग्यदा स्त्रीणां तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे व्यवस्थिता .. 23 ..
5.86.m: undergoing waning for one fortnight and waxing for one fortnight, O good twice-born. / That goddess, established in that sacred field, / is therefore called Saptaviṃśatikā on earth, granting all good fortune to women.

5.86.s:
yaścaitatpuratastasyāḥ saṃprāpte cāṣṭamīdine ..
śucirbhūtvā paṭhedbhaktyā sa saubhāgyamavāpnuyāt .. 24 ..
5.86.d:
यश्चैतत्पुरतस्तस्याः संप्राप्ते चाष्टमीदिने ..
शुचिर्भूत्वा पठेद्भक्त्या स सौभाग्यमवाप्नुयात् .. 24 ..
5.86.m: And whoever, having purified himself, recites this [text] with devotion in her presence / when the eighth day arrives, shall obtain good fortune.

5.86.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye saptaviṃśatikāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 86 .. .. cha ..
5.86.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सप्तविंशतिकामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षडशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 86 .. .. छ ..
5.86.m: Thus ends the eighty-sixth chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of Saptaviṃśatikā', in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] in the Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

5.87.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tathā tatrāsti viprendrāḥ somasyāyatanaṃ śubham..
yasyāpi darśanādeva mucyate pātakairnaraḥ .. 1 ..
5.87.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तथा तत्रास्ति विप्रेन्द्राः सोमस्यायतनं शुभम्..
यस्यापि दर्शनादेव मुच्यते पातकैर्नरः .. 1 ..
5.87.m: Sūta said: / Likewise, O leaders among brahmins, there is an auspicious sanctuary of Soma there, / through whose very sight a man is freed from sins.

5.87.s:
somavāre tu saṃprāpte somasya grahaṇe naraḥ ..
yastaṃ paśyati pāpo'pi narakaṃ na sa paśyati .. 2 ..
5.87.d:
सोमवारे तु संप्राप्ते सोमस्य ग्रहणे नरः ..
यस्तं पश्यति पापोऽपि नरकं न स पश्यति .. 2 ..
5.87.m: When Monday arrives, or during an eclipse of the moon, / the man who gazes upon him, even if he is a sinner, does not see hell.

5.87.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ dṛśyaṃte'tra samāśrayāḥ ..
atra caṃdrasya caivaikaḥ kathaṃ jātaḥ samāśrayaḥ .. 3 ..
5.87.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
सर्वेषामेव देवानां दृश्यंतेऽत्र समाश्रयाः ..
अत्र चंद्रस्य चैवैकः कथं जातः समाश्रयः .. 3 ..
5.87.m: The seers said: / "Sanctuaries of all the gods are seen here; / how did a sanctuary of Candra alone come to be established here?

5.87.s:
etannaḥ sūtaputrāticitraṃ manasi vartate ..
tasmādvada mahābhāga sarvaṃ tvaṃ vetsyaśeṣataḥ .. 4 ..
5.87.d:
एतन्नः सूतपुत्रातिचित्रं मनसि वर्तते ..
तस्माद्वद महाभाग सर्वं त्वं वेत्स्यशेषतः .. 4 ..
5.87.m: This is a great wonder in our minds, O son of Sūta; / therefore tell us, O fortunate one, for you know everything completely."

5.87.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
enajjagaddvijaśreṣṭhāḥ sarvaṃ somamayaṃ smṛtam ..
tasmātpratiṣṭhite tasmiṃstrailokyaṃ syātpratiṣṭhitam .. 5 ..
5.87.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एनज्जगद्द्विजश्रेष्ठाः सर्वं सोममयं स्मृतम् ..
तस्मात्प्रतिष्ठिते तस्मिंस्त्रैलोक्यं स्यात्प्रतिष्ठितम् .. 5 ..
5.87.m: Sūta said: / "This entire universe, O best of the twice-born, is traditionally known to consist of Soma; / therefore, when he is established, the three worlds are established.

5.87.s:
etāścauṣadhayaḥ sarvāḥ sasyādyāśceha bhūtale ..
sarvāḥ somamayāstāśca yābhirjīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ .. 6 ..
5.87.d:
एताश्चौषधयः सर्वाः सस्याद्याश्चेह भूतले ..
सर्वाः सोममयास्ताश्च याभिर्जीवंति जंतवः .. 6 ..
5.87.m: And all these medicinal herbs, crops, and the like here on the surface of the earth, / are all imbued with Soma, by which living beings survive.

5.87.s:
tasmādbrahmādayo devāḥ somaṃ prāpya kramāddvijāḥ ..
tṛptiṃ yāṃti parāṃ hṛṣṭā yatastasmādvaro'tra saḥ .. 7 .
5.87.d:
तस्माद्ब्रह्मादयो देवाः सोमं प्राप्य क्रमाद्द्विजाः ..
तृप्तिं यांति परां हृष्टा यतस्तस्माद्वरोऽत्र सः .. 7 .
5.87.m: Therefore, O brahmins, Brahmā and the other gods, having obtained Soma in due order, / become delighted and attain supreme satisfaction; hence he is the foremost here.

5.87.s:
agniṣṭomādayo yajñāstathā some pratiṣṭhitāḥ ..
tasya pānādyatastṛptiṃ tatra yāṃti dvijottamāḥ .. 8 ..
5.87.d:
अग्निष्टोमादयो यज्ञास्तथा सोमे प्रतिष्ठिताः ..
तस्य पानाद्यतस्तृप्तिं तत्र यांति द्विजोत्तमाः .. 8 ..
5.87.m: Likewise, sacrifices such as the Agniṣṭoma are established in Soma; / for by drinking it, O best of brahmins, they attain satisfaction there.

5.87.s:
etasmātkāraṇātsomaḥ sarveṣāmadhikaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca sa hi pūjyatamaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 9 ..
5.87.d:
एतस्मात्कारणात्सोमः सर्वेषामधिकः स्मृतः ..
देवानां दानवानां च स हि पूज्यतमः स्मृतः .. 9 ..
5.87.m: For this reason, Soma is held to be superior to all; / indeed, he is considered most worthy of worship among both gods and Dānavas.

5.87.s:
yathānyeṣāṃ surendrāṇāṃ harmyāṇi dharaṇītale ..
kriyante rātrināthasya tadvatkurvaṃti mānavāḥ .. 6.87.10 ..
5.87.d:
यथान्येषां सुरेन्द्राणां हर्म्याणि धरणीतले ..
क्रियन्ते रात्रिनाथस्य तद्वत्कुर्वंति मानवाः .. 6.87.10 ..
5.87.m: Just as mansions are erected on the surface of the earth for other chiefs of gods, / men likewise build [them] for the lord of the night.

5.87.s:
yairyernarairniśeśasya prāsādo vihitaḥ kṣitau ..
tete muktipadaṃ prāptāḥ kṛtvā'tha śubhasaṃcayam .. 11 ..
5.87.d:
यैर्येर्नरैर्निशेशस्य प्रासादो विहितः क्षितौ ..
तेते मुक्तिपदं प्राप्ताः कृत्वाऽथ शुभसंचयम् .. 11 ..
5.87.m: Whatever men have built a temple on earth for the lord of night, / having accumulated auspicious merit, they have attained the realm of liberation.

5.87.s:
yanmaheśvaraharmyāṇāṃ sahasreṇa bhavecchubham ..
tadeke naiva caṃdrasya prāpnuvaṃti śubhaṃ narāḥ .. 12 ..
5.87.d:
यन्महेश्वरहर्म्याणां सहस्रेण भवेच्छुभम् ..
तदेके नैव चंद्रस्य प्राप्नुवंति शुभं नराः .. 12 ..
5.87.m: Whatever auspicious merit would arise from a thousand temples to Maheśvara, / men attain that auspicious merit through just a single one to the Moon.

5.87.s:
atha candrotthaharmyasya māhātmyaṃ taddvijottamāḥ ..
jñātvā brahmādayo devā bhayasaṃtrastamānasāḥ ..
tadvighnārthamidaṃ procurmerumūrdhānamāśritāḥ .. 13 ..
5.87.d:
अथ चन्द्रोत्थहर्म्यस्य माहात्म्यं तद्द्विजोत्तमाः ..
ज्ञात्वा ब्रह्मादयो देवा भयसंत्रस्तमानसाः ..
तद्विघ्नार्थमिदं प्रोचुर्मेरुमूर्धानमाश्रिताः .. 13 ..
5.87.m: Then, O best of brahmins, realizing that greatness of a temple raised to the Moon, / Brahmā and the other gods, their minds terrified with fear, / took refuge on the peak of Meru and declared this in order to obstruct it:

5.87.s:
saumyarkṣe somavāreṇa saumye māsi ca saṃsthite ..
tithau ca somadevatye prāpte somagrahe tathā ..
sakāraiḥ paṃcabhiryukte kāle somasya maṃdiram .. 14 ..
5.87.d:
सौम्यर्क्षे सोमवारेण सौम्ये मासि च संस्थिते ..
तिथौ च सोमदेवत्ये प्राप्ते सोमग्रहे तथा ..
सकारैः पंचभिर्युक्ते काले सोमस्य मंदिरम् .. 14 ..
5.87.m: “In a lunar constellation, on a Monday, when the month is Saumya (Mārgaśīrṣa), / on a lunar day dedicated to Soma, and likewise when a lunar eclipse has occurred, / at a time possessed of the five ‘sa’s, a temple of Soma—

5.87.s:
ya ekāhena saṃpādya prāsādaṃ sthāpayiṣyati ..
caṃdraṃ sa sarvadevotthaharmyasyāpnoti satphalam .. 15 ..
5.87.d:
य एकाहेन संपाद्य प्रासादं स्थापयिष्यति ..
चंद्रं स सर्वदेवोत्थहर्म्यस्याप्नोति सत्फलम् .. 15 ..
5.87.m: whoever, having completed the temple in a single day, installs [the idol of] the Moon, / he obtains the true fruit of temples raised to all the gods,

5.87.s:
sahasraguṇitaṃ samyakchraddhāpūtena cetasā ..
anyathā yastu caṃdrasya prāsādaṃ prakariṣyati .. 16 ..
5.87.d:
सहस्रगुणितं सम्यक्छ्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा ..
अन्यथा यस्तु चंद्रस्य प्रासादं प्रकरिष्यति .. 16 ..
5.87.m: multiplied a thousandfold, with a mind purified by complete faith. / Whoever, on the other hand, builds a temple to the Moon otherwise,

5.87.s:
vaṃśocchedaṃ samāsādya narakaṃ sa prayāsyati ..
etasmātkāraṇādbhītā na kurvaṃti narā bhuvi .. 17 ..
5.87.d:
वंशोच्छेदं समासाद्य नरकं स प्रयास्यति ..
एतस्मात्कारणाद्भीता न कुर्वंति नरा भुवि .. 17 ..
5.87.m: suffering the destruction of his lineage, he shall go to hell.” / Terrified for this reason, men on earth do not build

5.87.s:
prāsādaṃ rātrināthasya supuṇyamapi saddvijāḥ ..
ya eṣa rātrināthasya kṣetre'traiva vyavasthitaḥ .. 18 ..
5.87.d:
प्रासादं रात्रिनाथस्य सुपुण्यमपि सद्द्विजाः ..
य एष रात्रिनाथस्य क्षेत्रेऽत्रैव व्यवस्थितः .. 18 ..
5.87.m: a temple to the lord of the night, even though it brings great merit, O noble brahmins. / This temple of the lord of the night which stands in this very sacred field,

5.87.s:
prāsādastvaṃbarīṣeṇa bhūbhujā sa vinirmitaḥ ..
kathaṃcitsamayaṃ prāpya yathoktaṃ śāstraciṃtakaiḥ .. 19 ..
5.87.d:
प्रासादस्त्वंबरीषेण भूभुजा स विनिर्मितः ..
कथंचित्समयं प्राप्य यथोक्तं शास्त्रचिंतकैः .. 19 ..
5.87.m: that temple was built by King Ambarīṣa, / somehow finding the [proper] time as taught by scholars of the scriptures.

5.87.s:
tasyaivottaradigbhāge dvitīyo'nyaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
candramā dhaṃdhumāreṇa tadvatso'pi pratiṣṭhitaḥ .. 6.87.20 ..
5.87.d:
तस्यैवोत्तरदिग्भागे द्वितीयोऽन्यः प्रतिष्ठितः ..
चन्द्रमा धंधुमारेण तद्वत्सोऽपि प्रतिष्ठितः .. 6.87.20 ..
5.87.m: In the northern quarter from it, another, second Moon was installed; / it was likewise installed by Dhandhumāra.

5.87.s:
tataśca tau mahīpālau tatprabhāvādubhau dvijāḥ ..
gatau ca paramāṃ siddhiṃ janmamṛtyuvivarjitām .. .. 21 ..
5.87.d:
ततश्च तौ महीपालौ तत्प्रभावादुभौ द्विजाः ..
गतौ च परमां सिद्धिं जन्ममृत्युविवर्जिताम् .. .. 21 ..
5.87.m: And then, O brahmins, through that power, both those rulers of the earth / attained the supreme perfection, devoid of birth and death.

5.87.s:
prāsādo'nyastṛtīyastu kṣetre prābhāsike tathā ..
ikṣvākuṇā nareṃdreṇa śraddhāyuktena nirmitaḥ .. 22 ..
5.87.d:
प्रासादोऽन्यस्तृतीयस्तु क्षेत्रे प्राभासिके तथा ..
इक्ष्वाकुणा नरेंद्रेण श्रद्धायुक्तेन निर्मितः .. 22 ..
5.87.m: A third, different temple in the sacred field of Prabhāsa / was built with faith by the ruler of men, Ikṣvāku.

5.87.s:
prāsādatrayametaddhi muktvātra dharaṇītale ..
aparo nāsti candrasya satyametanmayoditam ..
eko'sti narmadātīre puṇye revorisaṃgame .. 23 ..
5.87.d:
प्रासादत्रयमेतद्धि मुक्त्वात्र धरणीतले ..
अपरो नास्ति चन्द्रस्य सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् ..
एकोऽस्ति नर्मदातीरे पुण्ये रेवोरिसंगमे .. 23 ..
5.87.m: Except for these three temples, indeed, on the surface of the earth / there is no other to the Moon; this is the truth spoken by me. / There is [yet] one on the bank of the Narmadā, at the holy confluence of the Revā and the sea.

5.87.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ candramāhātmyamuttamam ..
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ cāpi sarvapātakanāśanam .. 24 ..
5.87.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं चन्द्रमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् ..
पठतां शृण्वतां चापि सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 24 ..
5.87.m: All this excellent māhātmya of the Moon has been recounted to you; / for those who recite or listen to it, it destroys all sins.

5.87.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhenāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhatmye somaprāsādamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 87 ..
5.87.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठेनागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहत्म्ये सोमप्रासादमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्ताशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 87 ..
5.87.m: Thus ends the eighty-seventh chapter, entitled “Description of the Greatness of the Temple of Soma,” in the Great Purāṇa of Skanda, in the compilation of eighty-one thousand [verses], in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the Hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmya.

5.88.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
yāstvayā devatāḥ proktāścatasraḥ sūtanaṃdana ..
camatkārī mahitthā ca mahālakṣmīstathā'parā .. 1 ..
5.88.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
यास्त्वया देवताः प्रोक्ताश्चतस्रः सूतनंदन ..
चमत्कारी महित्था च महालक्ष्मीस्तथाऽपरा .. 1 ..
5.88.m: The sages said: / Regarding the four goddesses mentioned by you, O son of Sūta— / Camatkārī, Mahitthā, and the other, Mahālakṣmī,

5.88.s:
aṃbāvṛddhā caturthī ca tāsāṃ tisraḥ prakīrtitāḥ..
vistareṇa caturthī ca aṃbāvṛddhā na kīrtitā .. 2 ..
5.88.d:
अंबावृद्धा चतुर्थी च तासां तिस्रः प्रकीर्तिताः..
विस्तरेण चतुर्थी च अंबावृद्धा न कीर्तिता .. 2 ..
5.88.m: and the fourth, Ambāvṛddhā—three of them have been praised / in detail, but the fourth, Ambāvṛddhā, has not been described.

5.88.s:
etasyāḥ sarvamācakṣva prabhāvaṃ sūtasaṃbhava ..
kenaiṣā nirmitā yātrā sarvaṃ vistarato vada .. 3 ..
5.88.d:
एतस्याः सर्वमाचक्ष्व प्रभावं सूतसंभव ..
केनैषा निर्मिता यात्रा सर्वं विस्तरतो वद .. 3 ..
5.88.m: Tell us all about her power, O son of Sūta; / by whom this pilgrimage festival was instituted, tell all in detail.

5.88.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
eṣā tapomayī śaktirambāvṛddhā sureśvarī ..
yathātra saṃsthitā pūrvaṃ tatsarvaṃ śrūyatāṃ mama .. 4 ..
5.88.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एषा तपोमयी शक्तिरम्बावृद्धा सुरेश्वरी ..
यथात्र संस्थिता पूर्वं तत्सर्वं श्रूयतां मम .. 4 ..
5.88.m: Sūta said: / This Goddess Ambāvṛddhā is a power made of austerity. / Hear from me all about how she previously took up residence here.

5.88.s:
camatkāramahīpena purametadyadā kṛtam..
tadā tadrakṣaṇārthāya nirmitā bhāvitātmanā ..
catasro devatā hyetāḥ saṃmatena dvijanmanām .. 5 ..
5.88.d:
चमत्कारमहीपेन पुरमेतद्यदा कृतम्..
तदा तद्रक्षणार्थाय निर्मिता भावितात्मना ..
चतस्रो देवता ह्येताः संमतेन द्विजन्मनाम् .. 5 ..
5.88.m: When this city was founded by King Camatkāra, / these four deities were established by that purified soul for its protection, / with the assent of the twice-born.

5.88.s:
atha tasya mahīpasya aṃbānāmābhavatsutā ..
tathānyā vṛddhasaṃjñā ca rūpaudāryaguṇānvite .. 6 ..
5.88.d:
अथ तस्य महीपस्य अंबानामाभवत्सुता ..
तथान्या वृद्धसंज्ञा च रूपौदार्यगुणान्विते .. 6 ..
5.88.m: Now, that king had a daughter named Ambā, / and another named Vṛddhā, endowed with beauty, generosity, and virtues.

5.88.s:
ubhe te kāśirājena pariṇīte dvijottamāḥ ..
gṛhyoktena vidhānena devaviprāgnisaṃnidhau .. 7 ..
5.88.d:
उभे ते काशिराजेन परिणीते द्विजोत्तमाः ..
गृह्योक्तेन विधानेन देवविप्राग्निसंनिधौ .. 7 ..
5.88.m: Both of them were married by the King of Kāśi, O best of brahmins, / according to the ritual prescribed in the domestic manuals, in the presence of the gods, brahmins, and fire.

5.88.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya kāśirājasya bhūpateḥ ..
taiḥ kālayavanaiḥ sārdhamabhavatsaṃgaro mahān .. 8 ..
5.88.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य काशिराजस्य भूपतेः ..
तैः कालयवनैः सार्धमभवत्संगरो महान् .. 8 ..
5.88.m: Then, after some time, a great battle took place / between the King of Kāśi and the Kālayavanas.

5.88.s:
atha tairnihataḥ saṃkhye sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ ..
haralabdhavarai raudraiḥ kāśirājaḥ pratāpavān .. 9 ..
5.88.d:
अथ तैर्निहतः संख्ये सभृत्यबलवाहनः ..
हरलब्धवरै रौद्रैः काशिराजः प्रतापवान् .. 9 ..
5.88.m: Then the powerful King of Kāśi, along with his attendants, army, and mounts, / was slain in battle by those ferocious [warriors] who had received boons from Hara.

5.88.s:
athāṃbā caiva vṛddhā ca vaidhavyaṃ prāpya duḥkhadam ..
hāṭakeśvarajaṃ kṣetraṃ gatvā te vāṃchitapradam .. 6.88.10 ..
5.88.d:
अथांबा चैव वृद्धा च वैधव्यं प्राप्य दुःखदम् ..
हाटकेश्वरजं क्षेत्रं गत्वा ते वांछितप्रदम् .. 6.88.10 ..
5.88.m: Then Ambā and Vṛddhā, having incurred sorrowful widowhood, / went to the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, which grants whatever is desired.

5.88.s:
devyā ārādhane yatnaṃ kṛtavatyau tataḥ param ..
nāśārthaṃ patiśatrūṇāṃ dhṛtavatyau śubhavratam .. 11 ..
5.88.d:
देव्या आराधने यत्नं कृतवत्यौ ततः परम् ..
नाशार्थं पतिशत्रूणां धृतवत्यौ शुभव्रतम् .. 11 ..
5.88.m: Thereafter, they made effort in the worship of the Goddess; / to destroy their husband's enemies, they undertook an auspicious vow.

5.88.s:
yāvadvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ na ca tuṣṭā sureśvarī ..
tato vairāgyamāsādya vāṃchaṃtyau svatanukṣayam .. 12 ..
5.88.d:
यावद्वर्षशतं साग्रं न च तुष्टा सुरेश्वरी ..
ततो वैराग्यमासाद्य वांछंत्यौ स्वतनुक्षयम् .. 12 ..
5.88.m: Even when a full hundred years had passed, the Goddess was not pleased; / thereupon, attaining dispassion, and desiring the destruction of their own bodies,

5.88.s:
maṃtrairātharvaṇairviprāḥ kṣurikāsūktasaṃbhavaiḥ ..
chittvācchittvā svamāṃsāni maṃtrapūtāni bhaktitaḥ .. 13 ..
5.88.d:
मंत्रैराथर्वणैर्विप्राः क्षुरिकासूक्तसंभवैः ..
छित्त्वाच्छित्त्वा स्वमांसानि मंत्रपूतानि भक्तितः .. 13 ..
5.88.m: with Atharvan mantras derived from the Kṣurikāsūkta, O brahmins, / they repeatedly cut off their own flesh, consecrated with mantras, and with devotion

5.88.s:
kṛtavatyau tato homaṃ susamiddhe hutāśane ..
agnikuṇḍāttatastasmāścaturhastā śubhānanā .. 14 ..
5.88.d:
कृतवत्यौ ततो होमं सुसमिद्धे हुताशने ..
अग्निकुण्डात्ततस्तस्माश्चतुर्हस्ता शुभानना .. 14 ..
5.88.m: they made oblations into the well-kindled fire. / Then, from that sacrificial pit, a four-armed woman with a lovely face,

5.88.s:
śvetavastrā viniṣkrāṃtā nārī bālārkasavribhā ..
tathānyā ca sunetrāsyā taptahāṭakasannibhā . 15 ..
5.88.d:
श्वेतवस्त्रा विनिष्क्रांता नारी बालार्कसव्रिभा ..
तथान्या च सुनेत्रास्या तप्तहाटकसन्निभा . 15 ..
5.88.m: clad in white garments, resembling the morning sun, emerged; / and likewise another, with beautiful eyes and face, resembling molten gold,

5.88.s:
tasmātkuṇḍādviniṣkrāṃtā dhṛtakhaḍgā bhayāvahā ..
sā'parāpi tathārūpā śaktiḥ paramadāruṇā .. 16 ..
5.88.d:
तस्मात्कुण्डाद्विनिष्क्रांता धृतखड्गा भयावहा ..
साऽपरापि तथारूपा शक्तिः परमदारुणा .. 16 ..
5.88.m: holding a sword, terrifying, emerged from that pit; / that other power was of a similar form, exceedingly fierce.

5.88.s: procatuste varaṃ hṛtsthaṃ prārthyatāmiti durlabham .. .. 17 ..
5.88.d: प्रोचतुस्ते वरं हृत्स्थं प्रार्थ्यतामिति दुर्लभम् .. .. 17 ..
5.88.m: The two said: “Ask for a boon in your hearts, difficult to obtain though it be.”

5.88.s:
.. te ūcatuḥ .. ..
asmākaṃ dayito bharttā kāśirājaḥ pratāpavān ..
nihataḥ saṃgare kruddhairyavanaiḥ kālapūrvakaiḥ .. 18 ..
5.88.d:
.. ते ऊचतुः .. ..
अस्माकं दयितो भर्त्ता काशिराजः प्रतापवान् ..
निहतः संगरे क्रुद्धैर्यवनैः कालपूर्वकैः .. 18 ..
5.88.m: The two said: / “Our beloved husband, the powerful King of Kāśi, / was slain in battle by the enraged Kālayavanas.

5.88.s:
yuṣmadīya prasādena yathā teṣāṃ parikṣayaḥ ..
sañjāyate mahādevyau tathā kāryamasaṃśayam .. 19 ..
5.88.d:
युष्मदीय प्रसादेन यथा तेषां परिक्षयः ..
सञ्जायते महादेव्यौ तथा कार्यमसंशयम् .. 19 ..
5.88.m: Undoubtedly, O great goddesses, that must be done / whereby their destruction may be brought about through your grace.

5.88.s:
sthātavyaṃ ca tathātraiva ubhābhyāmapi sādaram ..
svapurasya prarakṣārthametatkṛtyaṃ mataṃ hi nau .. 6.88.20 ..
5.88.d:
स्थातव्यं च तथात्रैव उभाभ्यामपि सादरम् ..
स्वपुरस्य प्ररक्षार्थमेतत्कृत्यं मतं हि नौ .. 6.88.20 ..
5.88.m: And likewise, both of you must respectfully remain right here / for the protection of our city; this indeed is the duty intended by the two of us.”

5.88.s:
tayostadvacanaṃ śrutvā ubhe te devate tataḥ..
saṃprocya bāḍhamityevaṃ tasminkuṇḍe vyavasthite .. 21 ..
5.88.d:
तयोस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा उभे ते देवते ततः..
संप्रोच्य बाढमित्येवं तस्मिन्कुण्डे व्यवस्थिते .. 21 ..
5.88.m: Having heard their words, both those goddesses then, / having said, “So be it,” remained in that pit.

5.88.s:
etasminnaṃtare tasmātkuṇḍācchatasahasraśaḥ ..
niṣkrāṃtāḥ saṃkhyayā hīnā mātaro naikarūpikāḥ .. 22 ..
5.88.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तस्मात्कुण्डाच्छतसहस्रशः ..
निष्क्रांताः संख्यया हीना मातरो नैकरूपिकाः .. 22 ..
5.88.m: Meanwhile, from that pool, by hundreds of thousands, / countless Mothers of diverse forms emerged: 22

5.88.s:
ekā gajamukhī tatra tathānyā turagānanā ..
sārameya mukhāścānyāḥ pakṣicchāgamukhāḥ parāḥ .. 23 ..
5.88.d:
एका गजमुखी तत्र तथान्या तुरगानना ..
सारमेय मुखाश्चान्याः पक्षिच्छागमुखाः पराः .. 23 ..
5.88.m: one had an elephant face, another a horse face; / others had dog faces, and others had the faces of birds and goats; 23

5.88.s:
tiryañca vapuṣaścānyā vaktrairmānuṣasaṃbhavaiḥ ..
triśīrṣāḥ pañcaśīrṣāśca daśaśīrṣāstathā parāḥ .. 24 ..
5.88.d:
तिर्यञ्च वपुषश्चान्या वक्त्रैर्मानुषसंभवैः ..
त्रिशीर्षाः पञ्चशीर्षाश्च दशशीर्षास्तथा पराः .. 24 ..
5.88.m: others had animal bodies with faces born of humans; / some were three-headed, five-headed, and others ten-headed; 24

5.88.s:
guhya sthānasthitairvaktrairekāścānyā hṛdisthitaiḥ ..
pārśvasaṃsthaiḥ sthitāścānyā anyāḥ pṛṣṭhigatairmukhaiḥ .. 25 ..
5.88.d:
गुह्य स्थानस्थितैर्वक्त्रैरेकाश्चान्या हृदिस्थितैः ..
पार्श्वसंस्थैः स्थिताश्चान्या अन्याः पृष्ठिगतैर्मुखैः .. 25 ..
5.88.m: some had faces situated on their private parts, others on their chests; / others stood with faces on their sides, and others with faces on their backs; 25

5.88.s:
ekahastā dvihastāśca pañcahastāstathāparāḥ ..
anyā viṃśatihastāśca vihastāśca tathāparāḥ .. 26 ..
5.88.d:
एकहस्ता द्विहस्ताश्च पञ्चहस्तास्तथापराः ..
अन्या विंशतिहस्ताश्च विहस्ताश्च तथापराः .. 26 ..
5.88.m: some had one arm, some two arms, and others five arms; / others had twenty arms, and others were armless; 26

5.88.s:
bahupādā vipādāśca ekapādāstathāparāḥ ..
tathānyāścārdhapādāśca adhovaktrā vibhīṣaṇāḥ .. .. 27 ..
5.88.d:
बहुपादा विपादाश्च एकपादास्तथापराः ..
तथान्याश्चार्धपादाश्च अधोवक्त्रा विभीषणाः .. .. 27 ..
5.88.m: some had many legs, some were legless, and others had a single leg; / and others had half-legs, facing downward, terrifying; 27

5.88.s:
ekanetrā dvinetrāśca trinetrāśca tathāparāḥ ..
kāścidgajasamārūḍhā hayārūḍhāstathāparāḥ .. 28 ..
5.88.d:
एकनेत्रा द्विनेत्राश्च त्रिनेत्राश्च तथापराः ..
काश्चिद्गजसमारूढा हयारूढास्तथापराः .. 28 ..
5.88.m: some were one-eyed, two-eyed, and others three-eyed; / some rode on elephants, and others mounted horses; 28

5.88.s:
vṛṣavānarasiṃhājavyāghrasarpāsthitāḥ parāḥ ..
godhāśvarāsabhārūḍhāstathā ca vihagāśritāḥ .. 29 ..
5.88.d:
वृषवानरसिंहाजव्याघ्रसर्पास्थिताः पराः ..
गोधाश्वरासभारूढास्तथा च विहगाश्रिताः .. 29 ..
5.88.m: others were mounted on bulls, monkeys, lions, goats, tigers, and serpents; / others rode on monitor lizards, horses, and donkeys, and some relied on birds; 29

5.88.s:
kūrmakukkuṭasarpādisamārūḍhāḥ sahasraśaḥ ..
prakurvaṃtyo rudantyaśca gāyantyaśca tathā parāḥ ..
nṛtyaṃtyaśca hasaṃtyaśca krīḍāsaktāḥ parasparam .. 6.88.30 ..
ūrdhvakeśā vikeśāśca gātrakeśāśca bhūriśaḥ ..
laṃbakeśā vikeśāśca vājikeśāstathaiva ca ..3...
5.88.d:
कूर्मकुक्कुटसर्पादिसमारूढाः सहस्रशः ..
प्रकुर्वंत्यो रुदन्त्यश्च गायन्त्यश्च तथा पराः ..
नृत्यंत्यश्च हसंत्यश्च क्रीडासक्ताः परस्परम् .. 6.88.30 ..
ऊर्ध्वकेशा विकेशाश्च गात्रकेशाश्च भूरिशः ..
लंबकेशा विकेशाश्च वाजिकेशास्तथैव च ..3...
5.88.m:
thousands rode on tortoises, cocks, snakes, and the like, / crying out, weeping, and others singing, / dancing, laughing, and engaged in mutual play. 30
Some had hair standing erect, some were hairless, and many had hair on their limbs; / some had long hair, some were bald, and likewise some had horse-like manes; 31

5.88.s:
hrasvadantyo vidaṃtyaśca dīrghadantyo vibhīṣaṇāḥ ..
gajadaṃtyastathaivānyā lohadaṃtyobhayāvahāḥ .. 32 ..
5.88.d:
ह्रस्वदन्त्यो विदंत्यश्च दीर्घदन्त्यो विभीषणाः ..
गजदंत्यस्तथैवान्या लोहदंत्योभयावहाः .. 32 ..
5.88.m: some had short teeth, some were toothless, and others had long, terrifying teeth; / others had elephant tusks, and iron-toothed ones inspiring fear; 32

5.88.s:
laṃbakarṇyo vikarṇyaśca śūrpakarṇyastathā parāḥ ..
śaṃkukarṇyaḥ kukarṇyaśca bahukarṇyaḥ sukarṇikāḥ .. 33 ..
5.88.d:
लंबकर्ण्यो विकर्ण्यश्च शूर्पकर्ण्यस्तथा पराः ..
शंकुकर्ण्यः कुकर्ण्यश्च बहुकर्ण्यः सुकर्णिकाः .. 33 ..
5.88.m: some had pendulous ears, some were earless, and others had winnowing-basket ears; / some had peg-like ears, bad ears, many ears, or beautiful ears; 33

5.88.s:
ekavastrā vivastrāśca bahuvastrāstathā parāḥ ..
carmaprāvaraṇāścaiva kathāprāvaraṇānvitāḥ .. 34 ..
5.88.d:
एकवस्त्रा विवस्त्राश्च बहुवस्त्रास्तथा पराः ..
चर्मप्रावरणाश्चैव कथाप्रावरणान्विताः .. 34 ..
5.88.m: some wore a single garment, some were naked, and others wore many garments; / some were clad in hides, and some covered with rags; 34

5.88.s:
khaṅgahastāḥ śarāhastāḥ kuṃtahastāśca bhīṣaṇāḥ ..
pāśahastāstathaivānyāḥ prāsacāpakarāḥ parāḥ ..
śūlamudgarahastāśca bhuśuṃḍikarabhūṣitāḥ .. 35 ..
5.88.d:
खङ्गहस्ताः शराहस्ताः कुंतहस्ताश्च भीषणाः ..
पाशहस्तास्तथैवान्याः प्रासचापकराः पराः ..
शूलमुद्गरहस्ताश्च भुशुंडिकरभूषिताः .. 35 ..
5.88.m: frightful, holding swords, holding arrows, and holding spears; / others holding nooses, others holding darts and bows, / holding tridents and mallets, and adorned with bhusuṇḍi-clubs in hand. 35

5.88.s:
atha tābhyāṃ tathā''karṇya tāḥ sarvā harṣasaṃyutāḥ ..
prasthitāstatra tā yatra te kālayavanāḥ sthitāḥ ..36..
5.88.d:
अथ ताभ्यां तथा'ऽकर्ण्य ताः सर्वा हर्षसंयुताः ..
प्रस्थितास्तत्र ता यत्र ते कालयवनाः स्थिताः ..36..
5.88.m: Then, having thus heard from the two [goddesses], all of them, filled with joy, / set out to where those Kālayavanas were stationed. 36

5.88.s:
tataste tatsamālokya balaṃ devīsamudravam ..
raudra rūpadharaṃ tīvraṃ vikṛtaṃ vikṛtairmukhaiḥ ..37..
5.88.d:
ततस्ते तत्समालोक्य बलं देवीसमुद्रवम् ..
रौद्र रूपधरं तीव्रं विकृतं विकृतैर्मुखैः ..37..
5.88.m: Then, beholding that army arisen from the goddess, / bearing a fierce form, ferocious, deformed with hideous faces, 37

5.88.s:
viṣaṇṇavadanāḥ sarve bhayabhītā samaṃtataḥ ..
dhāvato bhakṣitāstābhirdevatābhiḥ sunirdayam .. 38 ..
5.88.d:
विषण्णवदनाः सर्वे भयभीता समंततः ..
धावतो भक्षितास्ताभिर्देवताभिः सुनिर्दयम् .. 38 ..
5.88.m: all having dejected faces and terrified with fear on all sides, / as they ran away, they were consumed by those deities completely without mercy. 38

5.88.s:
bālavṛddhasamopetaṃ teṣāṃ rāṣṭraṃ durātmanām ..
strībhiśca sahitaṃ tābhirdevatābhiḥ prabhakṣitam ..39..
5.88.d:
बालवृद्धसमोपेतं तेषां राष्ट्रं दुरात्मनाम् ..
स्त्रीभिश्च सहितं ताभिर्देवताभिः प्रभक्षितम् ..39..
5.88.m: Together with children and the elderly, the realm of those evil-minded ones, / along with the women, was devoured by those deities. 39

5.88.s:
evaṃ nirvāsya tadrāṣṭraṃ sarvāstā harṣasaṃyutāḥ ..
bhūya eva nijaṃ sthānaṃ saṃprāptā dvijasattamāḥ .. 6.88.40 ..
tataḥ procuḥ praṇamyoccaistābhyāṃ vinayapūrvakam ..
hatāste yavanāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ saputrapaśubāṃdhavāḥ ..4...
5.88.d:
एवं निर्वास्य तद्राष्ट्रं सर्वास्ता हर्षसंयुताः ..
भूय एव निजं स्थानं संप्राप्ता द्विजसत्तमाः .. 6.88.40 ..
ततः प्रोचुः प्रणम्योच्चैस्ताभ्यां विनयपूर्वकम् ..
हतास्ते यवनाः कृष्णाः सपुत्रपशुबांधवाः ..4...
5.88.m:
Having thus depopulated that kingdom, all of them, filled with joy, / returned once again to their own place, O best of brahmins. 40
Then, having bowed low with humility, they said to the two [goddesses]: / "Those black Yavanas have been slain together with their sons, cattle, and kinsmen, 41

5.88.s:
udvāsitastathā sarvo deśasteṣāṃ sa vai mahān ..
sāṃprataṃ dīyatāṃ kaścidāhārastṛptihetave ..
nivāsāya tataḥ sthānaṃ kiṃciccāvedyatāṃ hi naḥ .. 42 ..
5.88.d:
उद्वासितस्तथा सर्वो देशस्तेषां स वै महान् ..
सांप्रतं दीयतां कश्चिदाहारस्तृप्तिहेतवे ..
निवासाय ततः स्थानं किंचिच्चावेद्यतां हि नः .. 42 ..
5.88.m: and that entire great country of theirs has been laid waste. / Now let some food be granted for our satisfaction, / and indeed make known to us some place for our dwelling." 42

5.88.s:
.. devyāvūcatuḥ.. ..
martyaloke'tra yā nāryo garbhavatyaḥ svapaṃti ca ..
saṃdhyākālaprakāśe ca tāsāṃ garbho'stu vo drutam .. 43 ..
5.88.d:
.. देव्यावूचतुः.. ..
मर्त्यलोकेऽत्र या नार्यो गर्भवत्यः स्वपंति च ..
संध्याकालप्रकाशे च तासां गर्भोऽस्तु वो द्रुतम् .. 43 ..
5.88.m: The two goddesses said: / "In this mortal world, whatever pregnant women sleep / during the light of the twilight hour, let their foetus immediately belong to you. 43

5.88.s:
rudaṃtyo yā viniryāṃti catvareṣu trikeṣu ca ..
tāsāṃ garbhastu yuṣmākaṃ saṃpradattaḥ prabhujyatām .. 44 ..
5.88.d:
रुदंत्यो या विनिर्यांति चत्वरेषु त्रिकेषु च ..
तासां गर्भस्तु युष्माकं संप्रदत्तः प्रभुज्यताम् .. 44 ..
5.88.m: Those who go out weeping in public squares and crossroads, / their foetus is handed over to you; let it be consumed! 44

5.88.s:
ucchiṣṭā yāḥ prasarpaṃti ramante ca svapaṃti ca ..
tāsāṃ garbhaḥ samastānāṃ yuṣmākaṃ bhoja nāya vai .. 45 ..
5.88.d:
उच्छिष्टा याः प्रसर्पंति रमन्ते च स्वपंति च ..
तासां गर्भः समस्तानां युष्माकं भोज नाय वै .. 45 ..
5.88.m: Those who roam about, make love, or sleep while polluted by food remnants, / the foetus of all of them is indeed for your food. 45

5.88.s:
sūtikābhavane yasminnucchiṣṭaṃ copajāyate ..
sa bālakastu yuṣmākaṃ bhojanāya prakalpitaḥ .. 46 ..
5.88.d:
सूतिकाभवने यस्मिन्नुच्छिष्टं चोपजायते ..
स बालकस्तु युष्माकं भोजनाय प्रकल्पितः .. 46 ..
5.88.m: In whichever lying-in chamber food remnants are produced, / that infant is assigned for your food. 46

5.88.s:
na ṣaṣṭhījāgaro yasya bālakasya bhaviṣyati ..
sa bhaviṣyati bhojyāya yuṣmākaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 47 ..
5.88.d:
न षष्ठीजागरो यस्य बालकस्य भविष्यति ..
स भविष्यति भोज्याय युष्माकं नात्र संशयः .. 47 ..
5.88.m: The infant for whom no sixth-night vigil is held / shall become food for you; there is no doubt about this. 47

5.88.s:
nāśaṃ yāsyati vā yatra pāvakaḥ sūtikāgṛhe ..
sa bhaviṣyati bhojyāya yuṣmākaṃ bālarūpadhṛk .. 48 ..
5.88.d:
नाशं यास्यति वा यत्र पावकः सूतिकागृहे ..
स भविष्यति भोज्याय युष्माकं बालरूपधृक् .. 48 ..
5.88.m: Or where the fire goes out in the lying-in chamber, / that one bearing the form of an infant shall become food for you. 48

5.88.s:
māṃgalyaiḥ saṃparityaktaṃ yadbhavetsūtikāgṛham ..
tasminyastiṣṭhate bālaḥ sa yuṣmākaṃ prakalpitaḥ ..49..
5.88.d:
मांगल्यैः संपरित्यक्तं यद्भवेत्सूतिकागृहम् ..
तस्मिन्यस्तिष्ठते बालः स युष्माकं प्रकल्पितः ..49..
5.88.m: Whichever lying-in chamber is devoid of auspicious rites, / the infant who remains in it is assigned to you. 49

5.88.s:
saṃdhyāyāṃ bālakā ye vā svapaṃtyākāśadeśagāḥ..
te sarve bhojanārthāya yuṣmākaṃ saṃniveditāḥ .. 6.88.50 ..
5.88.d:
संध्यायां बालका ये वा स्वपंत्याकाशदेशगाः..
ते सर्वे भोजनार्थाय युष्माकं संनिवेदिताः .. 6.88.50 ..
5.88.m: Or whatever infants sleep in the open air during twilight, / all of them are offered for your food. 50

5.88.s:
yasya janmadine prāpte varṣāṃte kriyate na ca ..
māṃgalyaṃ tasya yadgātraṃ tadyuṣmākaṃ prakalpitam .. 51 ..
5.88.d:
यस्य जन्मदिने प्राप्ते वर्षांते क्रियते न च ..
मांगल्यं तस्य यद्गात्रं तद्युष्माकं प्रकल्पितम् .. 51 ..
5.88.m: When a person's birthday arrives at the end of a year, and no auspicious rite / is performed, his body is assigned to you. 51

5.88.s:
tailābhyaṃgaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā yaśca snānaṃ karoti na ..
sa datto bhojanārthāya yuṣmākaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 52 ..
5.88.d:
तैलाभ्यंगं नरः कृत्वा यश्च स्नानं करोति न ..
स दत्तो भोजनार्थाय युष्माकं नात्र संशयः .. 52 ..
5.88.m: A man who performs an oil massage and does not bathe, / he is given for your food; there is no doubt about this. 52

5.88.s:
ucchiṣṭo yaḥ pumāṃstiṣṭhedyo vā catvaramadhyagaḥ..
bhakṣaṇīyaḥ sa sarvābhirnirvikalpena cetasā ..53 ..
5.88.d:
उच्छिष्टो यः पुमांस्तिष्ठेद्यो वा चत्वरमध्यगः..
भक्षणीयः स सर्वाभिर्निर्विकल्पेन चेतसा ..53 ..
5.88.m: A man who remains polluted by food remnants, or who stands in the middle of a square, / should be devoured by all of you without hesitation of mind. 53

5.88.s:
rajasvalāṃ vrajedyo vā puruṣaḥ kāmamohitaḥ..
nagnaḥ śete tathā snāti bhakṣaṇīyaḥ sa satvaram .. 54 ..
5.88.d:
रजस्वलां व्रजेद्यो वा पुरुषः काममोहितः..
नग्नः शेते तथा स्नाति भक्षणीयः स सत्वरम् .. 54 ..
5.88.m: Or a man who, deluded by lust, approaches a menstruating woman, / sleeps naked, or bathes naked, should be devoured swiftly. 54

5.88.s:
dakṣiṇābhimukho rātrau yaśca snāti vimūḍhadhīḥ ..
śete ca śayane so'pi bhakṣaṇīyaśca satvaram ..55..
5.88.d:
दक्षिणाभिमुखो रात्रौ यश्च स्नाति विमूढधीः ..
शेते च शयने सोऽपि भक्षणीयश्च सत्वरम् ..55..
5.88.m: And the foolish-minded one who bathes at night facing south / and lies down to sleep, he too should be devoured swiftly. 55

5.88.s:
udaṅmukhaśca yo rātrau divā vā dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ..
mūtrotsargaṃ purīṣa vā prakuryādbhakṣya eva saḥ .. 56 ..
5.88.d:
उदङ्मुखश्च यो रात्रौ दिवा वा दक्षिणामुखः ..
मूत्रोत्सर्गं पुरीष वा प्रकुर्याद्भक्ष्य एव सः .. 56 ..
5.88.m: And he who discharges urine or faeces facing north at night / or facing south by day, he is certainly fit to be eaten. 56

5.88.s:
yaḥ kuryādrajanīvaktre dadhisaktuprabhakṣaṇam ..
aṃtyajābhigamaṃ cātha bhakṣaṇīyo drutaṃ hi saḥ .. 57 ..
5.88.d:
यः कुर्याद्रजनीवक्त्रे दधिसक्तुप्रभक्षणम् ..
अंत्यजाभिगमं चाथ भक्षणीयो द्रुतं हि सः .. 57 ..
5.88.m: He who eats curd and barley meal at nightfall / and has intercourse with an outcaste woman, he must indeed be devoured swiftly." 57

5.88.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ tābhyāṃ tadā proktā devatāstāḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
parivārya tadā tasthuḥ saṃprahṛṣṭena cetasā .. 58 ..
5.88.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं ताभ्यां तदा प्रोक्ता देवतास्ताः समंततः ..
परिवार्य तदा तस्थुः संप्रहृष्टेन चेतसा .. 58 ..
5.88.m: Sūta said: / Having been addressed thus at that time by the two, those deities / surrounded them on all sides and then remained with delighted minds. 58

5.88.s:
etasminnaṃtare rājā camatkāraḥ pratāpavān ..
prāsādaṃ nirmame tābhyāṃ kailāsaśikharopamam .. 59 ..
5.88.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे राजा चमत्कारः प्रतापवान् ..
प्रासादं निर्ममे ताभ्यां कैलासशिखरोपमम् .. 59 ..
5.88.m: In the meantime, the glorious King Camatkāra / built a palace for the two, resembling the peak of Kailāsa. 59

5.88.s:
tataḥ prabhṛti te khyāte kṣetre tatra mahodaye ..
aṃbāvṛddhābhidhāne ca purarakṣāpare sadā .. 6.88.60 ..
5.88.d:
ततः प्रभृति ते ख्याते क्षेत्रे तत्र महोदये ..
अंबावृद्धाभिधाने च पुररक्षापरे सदा .. 6.88.60 ..
5.88.m: From then on, in that sacred field of great prosperity, the two became famous / under the names Ambā and Vṛddhā, always intent on protecting the city. 60

5.88.s:
yaḥ pumānprātarutthāya tābhyāṃ paśyati cānanam ..
tasya saṃvatsaraṃyāvanna ca cchidraṃ prajāyate .. 61 ..
5.88.d:
यः पुमान्प्रातरुत्थाय ताभ्यां पश्यति चाननम् ..
तस्य संवत्सरंयावन्न च च्छिद्रं प्रजायते .. 61 ..
5.88.m: A man who, rising in the morning, looks upon their face, / for a full year no misfortune befalls him. 61

5.88.s:
vṛddhyādau vātha cāṃte vā tābhyāṃ pūjāṃ karoti yaḥ ..
na tasya jāyate cchidraṃ kathaṃcidapi bhūtale .. 62 ..
5.88.d:
वृद्ध्यादौ वाथ चांते वा ताभ्यां पूजां करोति यः ..
न तस्य जायते च्छिद्रं कथंचिदपि भूतले .. 62 ..
5.88.m: Whoever performs worship to them at the beginning or at the end of an auspicious ceremony, / no misfortune whatever arises for him on the earth. 62

5.88.s:
yātrākāle pumānyaśca tābhyāṃ pūjāṃ samācaret ..
sa vāṃchitaphalaṃ prāpya śīghraṃ svagṛhamāpnuyāt .. 63 ..
5.88.d:
यात्राकाले पुमान्यश्च ताभ्यां पूजां समाचरेत् ..
स वांछितफलं प्राप्य शीघ्रं स्वगृहमाप्नुयात् .. 63 ..
5.88.m: And the man who performs worship to them at the time of a journey, / having attained his desired fruit, shall quickly reach his own home. 63

5.88.s:
sadāṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ yastābhyāṃ balimāharet ..
sa kāmānāpnuyādiṣṭāniha pretya ca sadgatim .. 64 ..
5.88.d:
सदाष्टम्यां चतुर्दश्यां यस्ताभ्यां बलिमाहरेत् ..
स कामानाप्नुयादिष्टानिह प्रेत्य च सद्गतिम् .. 64 ..
5.88.m: Whoever constantly offers an oblation to the two of them on the eighth and the fourteenth days / shall attain desired wishes here and a good destination after death.

5.88.s:
yo mahānavamīsaṃjñe divase śraddhayānvitaḥ ..
tābhyāṃ samācaretpūjāṃ sa sadā syādakaṇṭakī .. .. 65 ..
5.88.d:
यो महानवमीसंज्ञे दिवसे श्रद्धयान्वितः ..
ताभ्यां समाचरेत्पूजां स सदा स्यादकण्टकी .. .. 65 ..
5.88.m: He who, endowed with faith, performs worship to the two / on the day named Mahānavamī shall always remain free from thorns.

5.88.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmyeṃ'bāvṛddhāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 88 ..
5.88.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्येंऽबावृद्धामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टाशीतितमोऽध्यायः .. 88 ..
5.88.m: Thus ends the eighty-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Ambā and Vṛddhā', in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvarakṣetra, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.89.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ tatra sthite nityaṃ tasminmātṛgaṇe dvijāḥ ..
bālakānāṃ kṣayo jajñe brāhmaṇānāṃ gṛhegṛhe .. 1 ..
5.89.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं तत्र स्थिते नित्यं तस्मिन्मातृगणे द्विजाः ..
बालकानां क्षयो जज्ञे ब्राह्मणानां गृहेगृहे .. 1 ..
5.89.m: Sūta said: / When that group of Mothers was thus stationed there constantly, O twice-born ones, / destruction of children occurred in house after house of the brahmins,

5.89.s:
taruṇānāṃ viśeṣeṇa camatkārapurottare ..
chidramanveṣamāṇāstā bhramaṃtyakhiladevatāḥ .. 2 ..
5.89.d:
तरुणानां विशेषेण चमत्कारपुरोत्तरे ..
छिद्रमन्वेषमाणास्ता भ्रमंत्यखिलदेवताः .. 2 ..
5.89.m: especially of youth, to the north of Camatkārapura. / Searching for vulnerability, all those goddesses roamed about.

5.89.s:
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve jñātvā chidrasamudbhavam ..
vighātaṃ bālakānāṃ ca devatābhirvinirmitam .. 3 ..
5.89.d:
ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे ज्ञात्वा छिद्रसमुद्भवम् ..
विघातं बालकानां च देवताभिर्विनिर्मितम् .. 3 ..
5.89.m: Then all those brahmins, recognizing the destruction of their children / arising from vulnerability, caused by the deities,

5.89.s:
ambāvṛddhe samāsādya pūjayitvā prayatnataḥ ..
procuśca duḥkhasantaptā vinayāvanatāḥ sthitāḥ .. 4 ..
5.89.d:
अम्बावृद्धे समासाद्य पूजयित्वा प्रयत्नतः ..
प्रोचुश्च दुःखसन्तप्ता विनयावनताः स्थिताः .. 4 ..
5.89.m: approached Ambā and Vṛddhā, worshipped them diligently, / and, burning with sorrow, bowing down in humility, said:

5.89.s:
rakṣārthaṃ sarvaviprāṇāṃ camatkāreṇa bhūbhujā ..
bhavadbhyāṃ nirmitaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ prāsādo'yaṃ manoharaḥ .. 9 ..
hriyaṃte bālakā rātrau chidraṃ prāpya sahasraśaḥ ..
yuṣmadīyābhiretābhirdevatābhiḥ samantataḥ .. 6 ..
prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ tasmādbrāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām ..
no cetpuraṃ parityajya yāsyāmo'nyatra bhūtale .. 7 ..
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tatoṃ'bā kṛpayānvitā ..
hatvā pādaprahāreṇa bhūmiṃ cakre guhāṃ tataḥ .. 8 ..
tasyāṃ sve pāduke nyasya tataḥ provāca devatāḥ ..
sarvāstā natasarvāṃgīrvinayena samanvitāḥ .. 9 ..
5.89.d:
रक्षार्थं सर्वविप्राणां चमत्कारेण भूभुजा ..
भवद्भ्यां निर्मितः श्रेष्ठः प्रासादोऽयं मनोहरः .. 9 ..
ह्रियंते बालका रात्रौ छिद्रं प्राप्य सहस्रशः ..
युष्मदीयाभिरेताभिर्देवताभिः समन्ततः .. 6 ..
प्रसादः क्रियतां तस्माद्ब्राह्मणानां महात्मनाम् ..
नो चेत्पुरं परित्यज्य यास्यामोऽन्यत्र भूतले .. 7 ..
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ततोंऽबा कृपयान्विता ..
हत्वा पादप्रहारेण भूमिं चक्रे गुहां ततः .. 8 ..
तस्यां स्वे पादुके न्यस्य ततः प्रोवाच देवताः ..
सर्वास्ता नतसर्वांगीर्विनयेन समन्विताः .. 9 ..
5.89.m:
"For the protection of all the vipras, by King Camatkāra / this excellent, delightful palace was built for both of you.
Finding an opening, children by the thousands are carried off at night / on all sides by these deities belonging to you.
Therefore let favor be shown to the noble-minded brahmins; / otherwise, abandoning the city, we will depart elsewhere on earth."
Hearing their word, Ambā, filled with compassion, / struck the ground with a blow of her foot and then created a cave.
Placing her two wooden sandals therein, she then addressed all those deities / who bowed their whole bodies and were endowed with humility:

5.89.s:
ime matpāduke divye guhāmadhyagate sadā ..
sarvābhiḥ sevanīye ca na gantavyaṃ bahiḥ kvacit .. 6.89.10 ..
5.89.d:
इमे मत्पादुके दिव्ये गुहामध्यगते सदा ..
सर्वाभिः सेवनीये च न गन्तव्यं बहिः क्वचित् .. 6.89.10 ..
5.89.m: "These two divine wooden sandals of mine, staying always within the cave, / are to be served by all [of you], and you must never go outside.

5.89.s:
yā kācillaulyamāsthāya niṣkramiṣyati mohataḥ ..
sā divyabhāvanirmuktā śṛgālī saṃbhaviṣyati .. 11 ..
5.89.d:
या काचिल्लौल्यमास्थाय निष्क्रमिष्यति मोहतः ..
सा दिव्यभावनिर्मुक्ता शृगाली संभविष्यति .. 11 ..
5.89.m: Whichever [goddess], resorting to greed, should go out through delusion / shall be deprived of her divine nature and become a female jackal."

5.89.s:
.. devatā ūcuḥ .. ..
atra sthāne mahādevi ko'smākaṃ prakariṣyati ..
pūjāṃ ko vātra cāhārastasmādbrūhi sureśvari .. 12 ..
5.89.d:
.. देवता ऊचुः .. ..
अत्र स्थाने महादेवि कोऽस्माकं प्रकरिष्यति ..
पूजां को वात्र चाहारस्तस्माद्ब्रूहि सुरेश्वरि .. 12 ..
5.89.m: The deities said: / "O great goddess, who will perform worship for us in this place? / Or what shall be our food here? Therefore tell us, O ruler of the gods!"

5.89.s:
.. ambovāca .. ..
atrāgatya vinirmuktā yogino dhyānacintakāḥ ..
pūjāṃ samyakkariṣyaṃti sarvāsāṃ bhaktisaṃyutāḥ .. 13 ..
5.89.d:
.. अम्बोवाच .. ..
अत्रागत्य विनिर्मुक्ता योगिनो ध्यानचिन्तकाः ..
पूजां सम्यक्करिष्यंति सर्वासां भक्तिसंयुताः .. 13 ..
5.89.m: Ambā said: / "Yogins, liberated and contemplating in meditation, coming here, / filled with devotion, will duly perform worship for you all.

5.89.s:
pāduke me prapūjyādau māṃsa madyādibhiḥ kramāt ..
avāpsyaṃti ca saṃsiddhiṃ durlabhāmamarairapi .. 14 ..
5.89.d:
पादुके मे प्रपूज्यादौ मांस मद्यादिभिः क्रमात् ..
अवाप्स्यंति च संसिद्धिं दुर्लभाममरैरपि .. 14 ..
5.89.m: Having first duly worshipped my two wooden sandals with meat, wine, and the like, in order, / they will attain perfection difficult to obtain even by the immortals."

5.89.s:
tatastatheti tāḥ procya guhāmadhye vyavasthitāḥ ..
parivārya śubhe tasyāḥ pāduke mokṣadāyike .. 15 ..
5.89.d:
ततस्तथेति ताः प्रोच्य गुहामध्ये व्यवस्थिताः ..
परिवार्य शुभे तस्याः पादुके मोक्षदायिके .. 15 ..
5.89.m: Then, saying 'So be it', they stayed inside the cave, / surrounding those auspicious sandals of hers that bestow liberation.

5.89.s:
tatastatra samāgatya puruṣā api dūrataḥ ..
prapūjya pāduke samyaṅmātṝstāśca tataḥ param..
prayāṃti ca parāṃ siddhiṃ janma mṛtyuvivarjitām .. 16 ..
5.89.d:
ततस्तत्र समागत्य पुरुषा अपि दूरतः ..
प्रपूज्य पादुके सम्यङ्मातॄस्ताश्च ततः परम्..
प्रयांति च परां सिद्धिं जन्म मृत्युविवर्जिताम् .. 16 ..
5.89.m: Then, coming there even from afar, / men, having thoroughly worshipped the two wooden sandals and thereafter those Mothers, / go to supreme perfection, freed from birth and death.

5.89.s:
etasminnaṃtare naṣṭā agniṣṭomādikāḥ kriyāḥ ..
tīrthayātrāvratānyeva saṃyamā niyamāśca ye 17 ..
5.89.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे नष्टा अग्निष्टोमादिकाः क्रियाः ..
तीर्थयात्राव्रतान्येव संयमा नियमाश्च ये 17 ..
5.89.m: In the meantime, the rites such as the Agniṣṭoma perished, / as did pilgrimages to sacred fords, observances, restraints, and rules.

5.89.s:
ye cāpi brāhmaṇāḥ śāṃtāḥ sadā madyasya dūṣaṇam ..
prakurvaṃti svahastena te'pi madyaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ .. 18 ..
5.89.d:
ये चापि ब्राह्मणाः शांताः सदा मद्यस्य दूषणम् ..
प्रकुर्वंति स्वहस्तेन तेऽपि मद्यैः पृथग्विधैः .. 18 ..
5.89.m: Even those calm brahmins who always censured wine / themselves, with their own hands, with various kinds of wine

5.89.s:
tarpayaṃti tathā māṃsaistyaktāśeṣamakhakriyāḥ ..
pāduke mātṛbhirjuṣṭe tathā dhūpānulepanaiḥ .. 19 ..
5.89.d:
तर्पयंति तथा मांसैस्त्यक्ताशेषमखक्रियाः ..
पादुके मातृभिर्जुष्टे तथा धूपानुलेपनैः .. 19 ..
5.89.m: gratified [them], and with meat, abandoning all sacrificial rites, / [worshipping] the two wooden sandals attended by the Mothers, and likewise with incense and ointments.

5.89.s:
etasminnaṃtare bhītāḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ ..
dṛṣṭvā yajñakriyocchedaṃ kṣutpipāsā samākulāḥ..6.89.20...
5.89.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे भीताः सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः ..
दृष्ट्वा यज्ञक्रियोच्छेदं क्षुत्पिपासा समाकुलाः..6.89.20...
5.89.m: In the meantime, all the gods, along with Indra, were terrified; / seeing the destruction of sacrificial rites, afflicted by hunger and thirst,

5.89.s:
procurmaheśvaraṃ gatvā vinayāvanatāḥ sthitāḥ ..
stutvā pṛthagvidhaiḥ sūktairvedoktaiḥ śatarudriyaiḥ .. 21 ..
5.89.d:
प्रोचुर्महेश्वरं गत्वा विनयावनताः स्थिताः ..
स्तुत्वा पृथग्विधैः सूक्तैर्वेदोक्तैः शतरुद्रियैः .. 21 ..
5.89.m: they went to Maheśvara and, standing bowed in humility, / having praised him with various sūktas and with the Śatarudriya uttered in the Veda, spoke.

5.89.s:
devā ūcuḥ .. ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre pāduke tatra saṃsthite ..
aṃbāyā mātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ guhāmadhye suguptake .. 22 ..
5.89.d:
देवा ऊचुः .. ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे पादुके तत्र संस्थिते ..
अंबाया मातृभिः सार्धं गुहामध्ये सुगुप्तके .. 22 ..
5.89.m: The gods said: / "In the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, the two wooden sandals of Ambā / remain there along with the Mothers in a very secret cave.

5.89.s:
brāhmaṇā apideveśa madyamāṃsena bhaktitaḥ ..
tābhyāṃ pūjāṃ prakurvaṃti prayāṃti paramāṃ gatim .. 23 ..
5.89.d:
ब्राह्मणा अपिदेवेश मद्यमांसेन भक्तितः ..
ताभ्यां पूजां प्रकुर्वंति प्रयांति परमां गतिम् .. 23 ..
5.89.m: Even brahmins, O Lord of the gods, with devotion and using wine and meat, / perform worship to both of them and attain the supreme state.

5.89.s:
naṣṭā dharmakriyā sarvā martyaloketra sāṃpratam ..
asmākaṃ saṃkṣayo jāto yajñabhāgaṃ vinā prabho..24..
5.89.d:
नष्टा धर्मक्रिया सर्वा मर्त्यलोकेत्र सांप्रतम् ..
अस्माकं संक्षयो जातो यज्ञभागं विना प्रभो..24..
5.89.m: Now all righteous action has perished here in the world of mortals; / our destruction has come about without our sacrificial portion, O Lord!

5.89.s:
tasmāttvaṃ kuru deveśa yathā syātpādukākṣayaḥ..
prabhavaṃti makhā bhūmāvasmākaṃ syuḥ parā mudaḥ ..25..
5.89.d:
तस्मात्त्वं कुरु देवेश यथा स्यात्पादुकाक्षयः..
प्रभवंति मखा भूमावस्माकं स्युः परा मुदः ..25..
5.89.m: Therefore, O Lord of the gods, act so that there may be destruction of the wooden sandals, / so that sacrifices may arise on earth and we may have supreme joy."

5.89.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
yā sā aṃbeti vikhyātā śaktiḥ sā parameśvarī..
jaganmātā'kṣayā sākṣānmamā pi jananī ca sā .. 26 ..
5.89.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
या सा अंबेति विख्याता शक्तिः सा परमेश्वरी..
जगन्माताऽक्षया साक्षान्ममा पि जननी च सा .. 26 ..
5.89.m: The Blessed Lord said: / "She who is known as Ambā is the Śakti, the Supreme Sovereign; / she is the Mother of the Universe, imperishable, manifest, and she is my mother too.

5.89.s:
tatkathaṃ saṃkṣayastasyāḥ kartuṃ kenāpi śakyate ..
manasāpi mahābhāgāḥ pādukānāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 27 ..
5.89.d:
तत्कथं संक्षयस्तस्याः कर्तुं केनापि शक्यते ..
मनसापि महाभागाः पादुकानां विशेषतः .. 27 ..
5.89.m: How, then, can destruction of her be accomplished by anyone, / even in thought, O fortunate ones—especially of her wooden sandals?

5.89.s:
paraṃ tatra kariṣyāmi sukhopāyaṃ sureśvarāḥ ..
yuṣmabhyaṃ pādukāyāṃ ca mahattvaṃ yena jāyate .. 28 ..
5.89.d:
परं तत्र करिष्यामि सुखोपायं सुरेश्वराः ..
युष्मभ्यं पादुकायां च महत्त्वं येन जायते .. 28 ..
5.89.m: However, O rulers of the gods, I shall devise an easy remedy there, / whereby greatness may accrue to you and to the pair of wooden sandals."

5.89.s:
evamuktvā tato dhyānaṃ cakre devo maheśvaraḥ ..
vyāvṛtyakamalaṃ hṛtsthamaṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam .. 29 ..
5.89.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततो ध्यानं चक्रे देवो महेश्वरः ..
व्यावृत्यकमलं हृत्स्थमष्टपत्रं सकर्णिकम् .. 29 ..
5.89.m: Having spoken thus, the divine Maheśvara entered into meditation; / unfolding the eight-petaled lotus with its pericarp situated in the heart,

5.89.s:
tasyāṃtargatamāsīnamaṃguṣṭhāgramitaṃ śubham ..
dvādaśārkaprabhaṃ sūkṣmaṃ svamātmānaṃ vyalokayat .. 6.89.30 ..
5.89.d:
तस्यांतर्गतमासीनमंगुष्ठाग्रमितं शुभम् ..
द्वादशार्कप्रभं सूक्ष्मं स्वमात्मानं व्यलोकयत् .. 6.89.30 ..
5.89.m: he perceived his own self seated within it, auspicious, the measure of a thumb's tip, / subtle, having the radiance of twelve suns.

5.89.s:
tasyaivaṃ dhyāyamānasya tṛtīyanayanāttataḥ ..
śvetāṃbaradharā śubhrā nirgatā kanyakā śubhā .. 31 ..
5.89.d:
तस्यैवं ध्यायमानस्य तृतीयनयनात्ततः ..
श्वेतांबरधरा शुभ्रा निर्गता कन्यका शुभा .. 31 ..
5.89.m: As he was thus meditating, from his third eye then / came forth an auspicious, radiant maiden dressed in white garments.

5.89.s:
atha sā prāha taṃ devaṃ praṇipatya maheśvaram ..
kimarthaṃ deva sṛṣṭāsmi mamādeśaḥ pradīyatām .. 32 ..
5.89.d:
अथ सा प्राह तं देवं प्रणिपत्य महेश्वरम् ..
किमर्थं देव सृष्टास्मि ममादेशः प्रदीयताम् .. 32 ..
5.89.m: Then, bowing down to that god Maheśvara, she said: / "For what purpose, O God, have I been created? Let my command be given!"

5.89.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
hāṭakeśvaraje kṣetre pāduke saṃsthite śubhe ..
śrīmāturjagatāṃ mukhye tābhyāṃ pūjāṃ tvamācara .. 33 ..
5.89.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
हाटकेश्वरजे क्षेत्रे पादुके संस्थिते शुभे ..
श्रीमातुर्जगतां मुख्ये ताभ्यां पूजां त्वमाचर .. 33 ..
5.89.m: The Blessed Lord said: / "In the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, the two auspicious wooden sandals of the glorious Mother of the worlds, / the foremost one, are situated; do you perform worship to them.

5.89.s:
kanyakāṃ saṃparityajya tavānvayavivarddhitām..
yaḥ kariṣyati tatpūjāmāhāraḥ syātsa mātṛṣu .. 34 ..
5.89.d:
कन्यकां संपरित्यज्य तवान्वयविवर्द्धिताम्..
यः करिष्यति तत्पूजामाहारः स्यात्स मातृषु .. 34 ..
5.89.m: Excepting a maiden born and raised in your lineage, / whoever else performs their worship shall become food for the Mothers.

5.89.s:
kaumārabrahmacaryyeṇa tvayāpi ca subhaktitaḥ ..
tābhyāṃ pūjā prakartavyā no cennāśamavāpsyasi .. 35 ..
5.89.d:
कौमारब्रह्मचर्य्येण त्वयापि च सुभक्तितः ..
ताभ्यां पूजा प्रकर्तव्या नो चेन्नाशमवाप्स्यसि .. 35 ..
5.89.m: With lifelong celibacy and with great devotion, / worship must be performed by you to the two of them; otherwise you will suffer destruction.

5.89.s:
tava pūjā kariṣyanti ye narā bhaktitatparāḥ ..
mātṝṇāṃ saṃmatāste syuḥ sarvadaiva sukhānvitāḥ .. 36 ..
5.89.d:
तव पूजा करिष्यन्ति ये नरा भक्तितत्पराः ..
मातॄणां संमतास्ते स्युः सर्वदैव सुखान्विताः .. 36 ..
5.89.m: Those men intent on devotion who will perform your worship / shall be favored by the Mothers and always endowed with happiness."

5.89.s:
evamuktvā tatastasyā maṃtramārgaṃ yathocitam ..
pūjāmārgaṃ viśeṣeṇa kathayāmāsa vistarāt .. 37.
5.89.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततस्तस्या मंत्रमार्गं यथोचितम् ..
पूजामार्गं विशेषेण कथयामास विस्तरात् .. 37.
5.89.m: Having spoken thus, he then explained to her properly the path of mantras / and particularly in detail the path of worship.

5.89.s:
tato visarjayāmāsa dattvā chatrādibhūṣaṇam ..
pratipattiṃ mahādevastāṃśca sarvānsureśvarān .. 38 ..
5.89.d:
ततो विसर्जयामास दत्त्वा छत्रादिभूषणम् ..
प्रतिपत्तिं महादेवस्तांश्च सर्वान्सुरेश्वरान् .. 38 ..
5.89.m: Then, having given an umbrella and other ornaments, and honors, / Mahādeva dismissed her and all those rulers of the gods.

5.89.s:
.. kumāryuvāca .. ..
tvayetatkathitaṃ deva tvadanvayasamudbhavāḥ ..
kanyakāḥ pūjayiṣyaṃti pāduke te suśobhane .. 39 ..
5.89.d:
.. कुमार्युवाच .. ..
त्वयेतत्कथितं देव त्वदन्वयसमुद्भवाः ..
कन्यकाः पूजयिष्यंति पादुके ते सुशोभने .. 39 ..
5.89.m: The Maiden said: / "O God, you have said this: maidens born of your lineage / shall worship those two very splendid wooden sandals.

5.89.s:
kaumārabrahmacaryyeṇa bhaviṣyatyanvayaḥ katham ..
etanme vistarātsarvaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi .. 6.89.40 .. ..
5.89.d:
कौमारब्रह्मचर्य्येण भविष्यत्यन्वयः कथम् ..
एतन्मे विस्तरात्सर्वं यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि .. 6.89.40 .. ..
5.89.m: How will there be a lineage through celibacy from childhood? / You ought to explain all this to me in detail and as it truly is.

5.89.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
yasyāyasyāḥ prasannā tvaṃ kanyakāyā vadiṣyasi ..
maṃtragrāmamimaṃ samyaktvadbhāvā sā bhaviṣyati .. 41 ..
5.89.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
यस्यायस्याः प्रसन्ना त्वं कन्यकाया वदिष्यसि ..
मंत्रग्राममिमं सम्यक्त्वद्भावा सा भविष्यति .. 41 ..
5.89.m: The Blessed Lord said: / Whichever maiden you, being pleased, speak / this aggregate of mantras to properly, she will become of your nature.

5.89.s:
evaṃ cānyā mahābhāge pāraṃparyeṇa kanyakāḥ ..
tava vaṃśodbhavāḥ sarvāḥ prabhaviṣyaṃti maṃtrataḥ .. 42
5.89.d:
एवं चान्या महाभागे पारंपर्येण कन्यकाः ..
तव वंशोद्भवाः सर्वाः प्रभविष्यंति मंत्रतः .. 42
5.89.m: And in this way, O fortunate lady, other maidens in succession, / all born in your lineage, will arise through the mantra.

5.89.s:
tataḥ sā tāṃ samāsādya pādukāsaṃbhavāṃ guhām ..
pūjāṃ cakre yathānyāyaṃ yathoktaṃ tripurāriṇā .. 43 ..
5.89.d:
ततः सा तां समासाद्य पादुकासंभवां गुहाम् ..
पूजां चक्रे यथान्यायं यथोक्तं त्रिपुरारिणा .. 43 ..
5.89.m: Then, having reached that cave where the wooden sandals arose, / she performed worship according to rule, just as spoken by the enemy of Tripura.

5.89.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tadanvayasamutthāyāḥ kanyakāyāḥ kareṇa yaḥ ..
pādukābhyāṃ naraḥ pūjāṃ prakaroti samāhitaḥ ..
iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya sa syātpretya sukhānvitaḥ .. 44 ..
5.89.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तदन्वयसमुत्थायाः कन्यकायाः करेण यः ..
पादुकाभ्यां नरः पूजां प्रकरोति समाहितः ..
इह लोके सुखं प्राप्य स स्यात्प्रेत्य सुखान्वितः .. 44 ..
5.89.m: Sūta said: / That man who, collected in mind, performs worship of the two sandals / through the hand of a maiden born of her lineage, / having obtained happiness in this world, shall be possessed of happiness after death.

5.89.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena kanyāhastena pāduke ..
pūjanīye viśeṣeṇa pūjyā sā cāpi kanyakā .. 45 ..
5.89.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन कन्याहस्तेन पादुके ..
पूजनीये विशेषेण पूज्या सा चापि कन्यका .. 45 ..
5.89.m: Therefore, by every effort, the two sandals are especially to be worshipped / through the hand of a maiden, and that maiden too is to be worshipped,

5.89.s:
vāṃchadbhiḥ śāśvataṃ saukhyamiha loke paratra ca ..
mānavairbhaktisaṃyuktairityuvāca maheśvaraḥ .. 46 ..
5.89.d:
वांछद्भिः शाश्वतं सौख्यमिह लोके परत्र च ..
मानवैर्भक्तिसंयुक्तैरित्युवाच महेश्वरः .. 46 ..
5.89.m: by human beings endowed with devotion who desire eternal happiness / in this world and the next; thus said the Great Lord.

5.89.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ māhātmyaṃ pādukodbhavam ..
śrīmāturanuṣaṃgeṇa aṃbādevyā dvijottamāḥ .. 47 ..
5.89.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं माहात्म्यं पादुकोद्भवम् ..
श्रीमातुरनुषंगेण अंबादेव्या द्विजोत्तमाः .. 47 ..
5.89.m: This entire māhātmya originating from the sandals has been told to you / in connection with Śrīmātā and Ambādevī, O best of the twice-born.

5.89.s:
yaścaitacchṛṇuyādbhaktyā caturdaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ ..
tathāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣeṇa sa prāpnoti paraṃ padam .. 48 ..
5.89.d:
यश्चैतच्छृणुयाद्भक्त्या चतुर्दश्यां समाहितः ..
तथाष्टम्यां विशेषेण स प्राप्नोति परं पदम् .. 48 ..
5.89.m: And whoever hears this with devotion and a concentrated mind on the fourteenth, / and especially on the eighth [day], attains the supreme state.

5.89.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śrīmātuḥ pādukāmāhātmavarṇanaṃnāmaikonanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 89 ..
5.89.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये श्रीमातुः पादुकामाहात्मवर्णनंनामैकोननवतितमोऽध्यायः .. 89 ..
5.89.m: Thus ends the eighty-ninth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Sandals of Śrīmātā', in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara Kṣetra in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
